Conclusion: TEA以零推理开销和少量微调步骤实现了高效的概念擦除，兼顾了鲁棒性、生成质量与可扩展性，并将概念擦除首次扩展到此前方法尚未探索的Rectified Flow Transformer架构（SD v3.5）。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can be misused to generate harmful content through adversarial or paraphrased prompts that bypass built-in safety mechanisms. Existing concept erasure methods often suffer from limited robustness against adversarial prompts, degradation of benign generation quality, or reliance on inference-time interventions that introduce persistent computational overhead. To address these limitations, we formulate concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text representation space. We propose a lightweight Text Encoder Alignment framework (TEA) that fine-tunes only the text encoder while keeping the generative backbone fully frozen. Given concept--anchor prompt pairs, our method trains a discriminator to distinguish token-level representations of concept-containing prompts from those of safe anchor prompts, while updating the text encoder to make these representations indistinguishable. TEA introduces zero inference-time overhead and requires only a small number of fine-tuning steps, making it highly efficient to deploy at scale. Despite this efficiency, TEA achieves state-of-the-art erasure robustness against black-box and white-box adversarial attacks on Stable Diffusion v1.4, while preserving generation quality on benign prompts. Furthermore, TEA is model-agnostic and achieves the lowest attack success rate on Stable Diffusion v3.5, extending concept erasure to a Rectified Flow Transformer architecture with T5 conditioning where prior methods remain largely unexplored. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/alirezafarashah/TEA.git}{https://github.com/alirezafarashah/TEA.git}

</details>


### [82] [Feed-Forward Hierarchical Gaussian Diffusion for Extreme CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15343)
*Yuezhe Yang,Li Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出HiGDiff，一种前馈分层高斯扩散框架，用于从极端受限投影中重建三维CT图像。该方法在空间和结构-细节两个维度上分解重建任务：物理条件化的解剖锚点和前景容量场分配可学习高斯原语到信息区域；结构扩散阶段恢复全局衰减几何，其学习表示再条件化细节扩散阶段以恢复残余边界和组织过渡。在三个CT基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能，包括LDCT-PD上PSNR提升5.81 dB，SSIM提升0.113。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT重建在严重受限投影（稀疏角度采样、受限角度覆盖、低光子计数，可单独或联合出现）下是高度病态的。现有学习方法大多针对单一主导退化定制，而扩散和高斯方法通常在同一共享表示中恢复全局结构和局部细节，难以同时处理多种退化的联合情况。

Method: HiGDiff采用前馈分层高斯扩散框架：1) 通过物理条件化的解剖锚点和前景容量场将可学习高斯原语分配到信息丰富区域；2) 结构扩散阶段先恢复全局衰减几何；3) 结构扩散学到的表示条件化细节扩散阶段，用于恢复残余边界和组织过渡；4) 生成的高斯图集渲染为衰减场，再由梯度隔离的残差模块进一步细化。

Result: 在三个不同CT基准数据集上，HiGDiff在孤立、配对和联合退化设置下均达到最先进的重建性能。在LDCT-PD数据集上，宏平均PSNR提升5.81 dB，SSIM提升0.113。

Conclusion: 通过将CT重建在空间和结构-细节两个维度上分层分解，HiGDiff能够有效应对多种退化单独或联合出现的情况，证明分层高斯扩散框架在处理高度病态的CT重建问题上具有显著优势。代码已开源。

Abstract: Reconstructing three-dimensional computed tomography (CT) from severely constrained projections is highly ill-posed. Sparse angular sampling, restricted angular coverage, and low photon counts can occur individually or jointly, obscuring global anatomy and local tissue detail. Many learned CT reconstruction methods are tailored to a single dominant degradation. Existing diffusion and Gaussian approaches commonly recover global structure and local detail within a shared representation. We propose HiGDiff, a feed-forward hierarchical Gaussian diffusion framework that decomposes reconstruction both spatially and from structure to detail. Physics-conditioned anatomical anchors and a foreground capacity field allocate learnable Gaussian primitives to informative regions. A structure diffusion stage first recovers global attenuation geometry, and its learned representation conditions a detail diffusion stage for residual boundaries and tissue transitions. The resulting Gaussian banks are rendered as attenuation fields and further refined by a gradient-isolated residual module. Experiments on three distinct CT benchmark datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction performance across isolated, paired, and joint degradation settings, including improvements of 5.81 dB in macro-average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and 0.113 in structural similarity index measure (SSIM) on the Low Dose CT Image and Projection Data (LDCT-PD) collection. Code and experimental configurations are openly available at https://github.com/Bean-Young/HiGDiff.

</details>


### [83] [ENAF: A Multi-Exit Network with an Adaptive Patch Fusion for Large Image Super Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15349)
*Duong M. Nguyen,Tuan Nghia Nguyen,Xuan Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ENAF是一种用于单图像超分辨率（SISR）的动态网络，通过自适应补丁融合和多个早期出口（EEs）来加速大尺寸图像（2K-8K）的超分辨率处理。它利用一个微型网络估计PSNR分数，将数据纹理与计算成本关联，从而为图像补丁动态分配执行路径，提升质量-复杂度权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态SISR网络依赖手工设计的评估分数（如边缘检测）来衡量补丁难度，这种分数与SISR模型的计算复杂度关联较弱，无法准确反映补丁纹理与计算需求之间的关系。

Method: ENAF在骨干网络基础上集成多个早期出口（EEs）来解决SISR模型过度参数化的问题；关键创新是插入一个微型网络来估计PSNR，将数据纹理与EE处的计算成本关联起来；基于估计的分数，ENAF为图像补丁动态分配出口，实现了自适应的补丁融合。

Result: 在常见数据集和流行的SISR骨干网络上的大量实验验证了ENAF在各种设置下的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过基于PSNR估计的动态路径分配，ENAF显著改善了SISR任务中的质量-复杂度权衡，代码已开源。

Abstract: To accelerate single image super-resolution (SISR) networks on large images (2K-8K), many recent approaches decompose an image into small patches and dynamically determine an execution path according to its difficulty (referred to as a dynamic network). To quantify the hardness of a patch, they mainly rely on a handcrafted assessment score, e.g., edge, which weakly associates a patch's texture with the computational complexity of a SISR model. To address the problem, we introduce ENAF - a dynamic network for SISR with an adaptive patch fusion. Built on top of a backbone, ENAF incorporates multiple early exits (EEs) to tackle the over-parameterized SISR model. More importantly, ENAF plugs a tiny network that estimates PSNR to associate data texture with a computation cost at an EE. Based on the scores, ENAF effectively assigns image patches to an exit, enhancing the quality-complexity trade-off. Extensive experiments on common datasets with popular SISR backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of ENAF in various settings. The source code is provided in https://github.com/nmduonggg/ENAF

</details>


### [84] [Decomposing Whole Slide Image Report Generation with Graph-Constrained Multiple Instance Learning Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15353)
*Antony Gitau,Martyna Borak,Bjørn-Jostein Singstad,Martin Paulson,Karl Thomas Hjelmervik,Ola Marius Lysaker,Veralia Gabriela Sanchez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个分解式的全切片图像（WSI）报告生成框架：使用冻结的Virchow2块嵌入，通过多实例学习（MIL）分类头回答器官特定诊断问题，再由器官条件图将答案组装为结构化推理链，最后由语言模型生成病理报告。在REG2026的2028张幻灯片上，链式Jaccard得分为0.702，优于各种消融变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接的视觉-文本模型虽能生成流畅的报告，但掩盖了视觉识别、结构化推理和语言生成各自的贡献与失败模式。作者希望建立可分解的框架，以便进行阶段级别的错误定位和组件归因。

Method: 1) 用冻结的Virchow2嵌入提取切片块特征；2) MIL分类头聚合特征并回答器官特定的诊断问题；3) 器官条件图约束答案组装成结构化推理链；4) 语言模型将推理链转化为病理报告。消融实验对比了无图构建、单一器官无关图、以及语言模型自由构建链条等变体。

Result: REG2026测试集上链式Jaccard得分0.702；去掉图的链条得分降至0.420，替换为器官无关图降至0.398，语言模型自由构建降至0.371。图结构链条使报告得分从0.330提升到0.495。外部TCGA测试中，正确器官图在64.0%情况下被选中，86.6%位列前三；提供正确器官图使粗粒度诊断标签一致性从61.8%提高到92.6%，识别出器官路由是域偏移下的主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 器官条件、图约束的链组装能够改善结构化推理和报告生成，同时实现阶段级错误定位，揭示器官路由是跨域泛化的关键瓶颈。

Abstract: Whole-slide image (WSI) report generation requires recognizing spatially distributed pathological features and organizing them into a coherent diagnostic narrative. Although direct vision-to-text models can yield fluent reports, they obscure the contributions and failure modes of visual recognition, structured reasoning, and language generation. We propose a decomposed framework in which frozen Virchow2 tile embeddings are aggregated by multiple-instance learning (MIL) classification heads that answer organ-specific diagnostic questions. An organ-conditioned graph constrains the assembly of these answers into a structured reasoning chain, which a language model realizes as a pathology report. On the REG2026 held-out set of 2,028 slides, the proposed workflow achieved a chain-Jaccard score of 0.702. Performance fell to 0.420 without graph-based chain construction, 0.398 when the organ-specific graphs were replaced by a single organ-agnostic graph, and 0.371 when the language model constructed the chain freely from MIL predictions. Using the same report generator, graph-structured chains improved the report score from 0.330 to 0.495. On 350 external TCGA WSIs spanning the seven REG organs without fine-tuning, the expected organ graph was selected in 64.0% of cases and ranked among the top three in 86.6%. Providing the correct organ graph increased agreement with coarse TCGA primary-diagnosis labels from 61.8% to 92.6%, identifying organ routing as a main bottleneck under domain shift. Overall, organ-conditioned, graph-constrained chain assembly improves structured reasoning and report generation while enabling stage-specific error localization.

</details>


### [85] [A Multi-Annotator Study of Segmentation Noise and Uncertainty in Turbid Underwater Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15363)
*Galadrielle Humblot-Renaux,Vasiliki Ismiroglou,Malte Pedersen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地对真实水下场景分割任务进行了多标注者研究，涉及100多名参与者，并在不同受控浊度水平下进行。研究发现水下数据集面临与一般视觉任务类似的标注挑战，且浊度会引入额外系统性误差，并探讨了改善浊水环境下标注质量的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标注不确定性和标注者分歧是计算机视觉中的常见挑战，但相关研究多局限于医学领域或通用图像识别数据集。水下数据集由于需要领域专业知识、能见度退化以及难以建立可靠地面真值，特别容易受到这些问题影响，然而水下图像的标注不确定性此前几乎未被探索。

Method: 进行了首次针对真实水下场景分割的多标注者系统研究，招募超过100名参与者，在可控的多种浊度水平下进行标注实验。此外，研究了驱动标注噪声的主要因素，并探索改进浊水下标注质量的途径，包括特权信息、个人努力和标注者集成等方法。

Result: 研究表明水下数据集面临与其他视觉任务类似的标注挑战，同时浊度会引入额外的系统性错误。通过分析标注噪声的主要驱动因素，提出了在浊水环境中改善标注质量的多种策略。

Conclusion: 水下图像标注不确定性是一个此前被忽视但至关重要的问题，本工作通过大规模多标注者研究填补了这一空白。所收集的数据和元数据将公开发布，为该领域的进一步研究提供基础资源。

Abstract: Label uncertainty and annotator disagreement are common challenges in the field of computer vision, yet their study has largely been confined to the medical domain or to generic image-recognition datasets. Underwater datasets are particularly susceptible to these issues due to the need for domain expertise, degraded visibility conditions, and the inherent difficulty of establishing reliable ground truth in inaccessible environments. Despite these challenges, annotation uncertainty in underwater imagery remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic multi-annotator study of segmentation in real underwater scenes, with over 100 participants, and across varying, controlled levels of turbidity. We show that underwater datasets face many of the same annotation challenges as other vision tasks, while turbidity introduces additional systematic errors. We further investigate the main factors driving label noise and explore ways to improve annotation quality in turbid underwater environments, including privileged information, individual effort and annotator ensembles. All (meta-) data collected in this study will be available on the project page: https://vap.aau.dk/tubcertainty

</details>


### [86] [JoLT: Joint Latent Trajectories for Context-Guided High-Resolution Tiled Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15395)
*Mathis Koroglu,Guillaume Jeanneret,Hugo Caselles-Dupré,Matthieu Cord,Arnaud Dapogny*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT)方法，通过双流协同去噪低分辨率和超高分辨率潜变量图像，解决文本到图像生成模型在高分辨率细节生成上的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本到图像生成模型在生成高分辨率、细节丰富的图像时表现不佳，现有方法采用低到高分辨率的级联方式，先生成低分辨率图再上采样，这种方式存在信息丢失和细节不足的问题。

Method: JoLT采用双流架构，在每一步采样过程中同时去噪低分辨率和高分辨率的潜变量图像。低分辨率潜变量控制整体布局，高分辨率潜变量控制细节，两个分支相互连接以联合整合信息，实现协同生成。

Result: 通过大量实验验证，JoLT在生成高分辨率图像方面优于现有的竞争基线方法，生成的图像细节丰富且视觉效果好。

Conclusion: JoLT为高分辨率文本到图像生成提供了新的思路，解决了现有级联方法的信息瓶颈问题，为艺术创作开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Although text-to-image generative models produce impressive results, they struggle to generate densely detailed, high-resolution (HR) images. Current literature addresses this issue with a low-to-high-resolution approach. First, a low-resolution (LR) image is generated. Then, an upsampled version is generated using the LR image as an additional cue. In this paper, we present Joint Latent Trajectories (JoLT). To generate an image, JoLT uses two streams that jointly denoise LR and HR latent images at each sampling step. The LR latent controls the overall layout, while the HR latent controls the details. We interconnect both branches to jointly integrate their information. We extensively validate our method, demonstrating its advantages over competing baselines. The resulting images are not only richly detailed but also visually pleasing, opening new avenues for artistic creation.

</details>


### [87] [CBX-Bench: A Human-Aligned MLLM Council for Benchmarking Concept Bottleneck Model Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15404)
*Yusuf Meric Karadag,Gulay Oklan,Seref Baris Cagliyan,Umut Ozdemir,Emre Akbas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了CBX-Bench，一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评议会来定量评估概念瓶颈模型（CBM）解释质量的基准和排行榜。通过人类研究建立解释质量的真值参考，五模型评议会能恢复70%以上的人类严格偏好排序（在人类一致同意的条目上达83%），为超越准确率和孤立定性示例的CBM解释评估提供了可扩展且与人类对齐的度量标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的核心动机是可解释性，但长期以来仅通过下游分类准确率进行评价，辅以孤立的定性示例。由于大规模真实概念标注不可行、概念列表缺乏共识，亟需一种量化的解释质量评估方法。

Method: 开发一个由五个开源权重MLLM组成的评议会，给定图像及其CBM解释，生成解释质量评分。首先进行人类研究（2700条评判，900个图像对比项，覆盖CUB-200、ImageNet-100和Places365），让标注者比较LF-CBM、VLG-CBM和CBM-Suite的解释并选择更有用者，建立真值参考；然后验证评议会与人类偏好的一致性；最终构建CBX-Bench公开基准和排行榜。

Result: 五模型评议会恢复了超过70%的人类严格偏好排序，在人类标注者一致同意的条目上达到83%。基于此验证，发布了CBX-Bench作为公共基准和排行榜，供CBM作者提交解释并获取数据集级别的解释质量排名。

Conclusion: CBX-Bench提供了与人类对齐的、可扩展的CBM解释质量评估方法，弥补了传统仅依赖准确率和定性示例的评估不足，推动CBM在可解释性方向上的量化研究。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to make visual classification interpretable by expressing predictions through human-understandable concepts. Although interpretability is the central motivation for CBMs, they are still largely evaluated as predictive models by downstream classification accuracy, supplemented by isolated qualitative examples. This highlights a pressing need for quantitative measures, a challenge complicated by the infeasibility of ground-truth concept annotation at scale and the open nature of concept lists due to a lack of consensus. To fill this gap, we develop a multimodal large language model (MLLM) council that, given an image and its CBM explanation, produces an explanation quality score. To ground and validate the council, we first conduct a human study to establish a ground-truth reference for CBM explanation quality: for an image, annotators compare explanations from two of LF-CBM, VLG-CBM, and CBM-Suite and choose the more useful one, or mark them as equally good or equally bad, yielding 2700 judgments over 900 image-comparison items on CUB-200, ImageNet-100, and Places365. Against this human reference, our five-model council, consisting of open-weight MLLMs, recovers over 70% of strict human preference rankings, rising to 83% on items where human annotators unanimously agree. Building on this validated council, we introduce CBX-Bench, a public benchmark and leaderboard: authors of new CBMs can submit their model's explanations, and CBX-Bench scores them with the council and maintains dataset-level rankings of explanation quality. CBX-Bench thus provides a human-aligned, scalable evaluation of CBM explanations beyond accuracy and isolated qualitative examples. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/meric-karadag/cbx-bench.

</details>


### [88] [ArtLang: Structured Language-to-Kinematics Grounding for Articulated 3D Actuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15419)
*Sylvia Yuan,Dan Wang,Ravi Ramamoorthi,Xinrui Cui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ArtLang是一个用于开放词汇语言控制可重构铰接资产的框架。它通过语义-运动学铰接图表示资产，融合语言特征和图约束运动，将开放词汇提议绑定到重构零件上，并通过类型化解析器和全局图到图的匹配求解实现语言指令到连续关节目标的转换，最终通过正向运动学执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的铰接物体重建虽然能恢复显式几何和运动学信息，但零件通常是语义匿名的，只能通过零件索引和数值关节参数来控制，缺乏直观、语义化的交互方式。

Method: 1) 将资产表示为语义-运动学铰接图，表面增强语言特征和图约束运动；2) 开放词汇提议绑定到重建零件，允许不确定零件保持未命名；3) 类型化解析器将命令转换为包含指代表达、动作、幅度、参考系和关系的指令图；4) 求解全局图到图的匹配问题，综合推理语义、空间、关系和运动学兼容性，支持空分配和歧义弃权；5) 接受的指令转换为连续关节目标并通过正向运动学执行。

Result: 在合成重建、基于网格的资产和真实捕获上的实验表明，ArtLang在重复零件、空间指代、关系命令和歧义指令下展现出可靠的语言绑定和连续铰接控制能力。

Conclusion: ArtLang通过语义-运动学铰接图和图到图匹配求解，实现了对重建铰接资产的开放词汇语言控制，解决了零件语义匿名和交互不直观的问题，并在多种数据源上验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Articulated-object reconstructions recover explicit geometry and kinematics, but their parts often remain semantically anonymous and must be controlled through part indices and numerical joint parameters. We present ArtLang, a framework for open-vocabulary language control of persistent reconstructed articulated assets. ArtLang represents an asset as a semantic-kinematic articulation graph and augments its surface with language features and graph-constrained motion. Open-vocabulary proposals are bound to reconstructed parts while allowing uncertain parts to remain unnamed. A typed parser converts a command into a directive graph containing referring expressions, actions, magnitudes, reference frames, and relations. We then solve a global graph-to-graph grounding problem that jointly reasons about semantic, spatial, relational, and kinematic compatibility, with support for null assignments and abstention under ambiguity. Accepted directives are converted into continuous joint targets within the observed motion range and executed through forward kinematics. Experiments on synthetic reconstructions, mesh-based assets, and real captures demonstrate reliable language grounding and continuous articulated control across repeated parts, spatial references, relational commands, and ambiguous instructions.

</details>


### [89] [HistReNeRF: Historic Image Relocalisation within Contemporary Neural Radiance Field Reconstructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15420)
*Benjamin T. Hughes,Stuart James*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HistReNeRF是一个通过将历史照片与当代NeRF重建场景进行特征匹配来实现6-DoF重定位的框架。它利用领域自适应的DINOv2特征与NeRF中采样的候选光线进行匹配，在嵌入空间而非像素空间进行域适应，相比像素空间方法在三个欧洲地标场景上将平移和旋转误差分别平均降低11%和16%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史档案照片在当代场景中的重定位具有挑战性，因为历史与现代视图在摄影外观、可见物体和空间布局上均存在显著差异。现有方法难以直接处理这种跨时间的外观变化，需要一种能够在特征层面进行域适应并利用连续场景表示的重定位框架。

Method: 1) 使用NeRF作为连续场景表示，提供可查询的场景接口用于采样候选光线；2) 将适配后的DINOv2 patch特征与从NeRF采样得到的候选光线进行匹配；3) 直接在定位所用的特征表示中进行历史摄影与当代图像之间的域适应，而非在像素空间进行。

Result: 在包含10,545张当代街景图像和230张来自三个欧洲地标的档案照片的新跨时间数据集上，嵌入空间域适应相比像素空间方法平均降低平移误差11%、旋转误差16%。

Conclusion: 神经场景重定位为特征空间域适应提供了自然的接口，能够有效减少跨时间外观差异而无需修改查询图像，验证了该方法的有效性并公开了代码和数据集。

Abstract: Relocalising archival photographs within a contemporary scene model is challenging because historic and modern views can differ in photographic appearance, visible objects, and spatial layout. Therefore, we present HistReNeRF, a framework that estimates the 6-DoF pose of a historic photograph by matching adapted DINOv2 patch features to candidate rays sampled from a contemporary Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) reconstruction. The continuous representation of a NeRF provides a queryable scene interface from which candidate rays can be sampled and matched, enabling domain adaptation between historic photography and contemporary images directly in the feature representation used for localisation. We evaluate embedding-space-based domain adaptation against pixel-space methods on a new cross-temporal dataset comprising 10,545 contemporary street-level images and 230 archival photographs from three European landmarks. Embedding-space adaptation reduces translation and rotation errors by an average of 11% and 16%, respectively, across the three scenes. These results show that neural scene relocalisation provides a natural interface for feature-space adaptation, reducing cross-temporal appearance shift without modifying the query image. Code and dataset at https://github.com/ARTUROLab/HistReNeRF.

</details>


### [90] [NumerosityVLM: A Cognitively Inspired Benchmark for Interpreting Numerosity Representations in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15425)
*Yiming Fu,Fangjun Li,Xiujin Liu,Ruidong Ma,Hang Yu,Zhichen Lu,Kanwei He,Alessandro Di Nuovo,Angelo Cangelosi,Zhegong Shangguan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了NumerosityVLM基准，包含10,800张合成图像和六个受控条件，用于解耦评估VLM的数量感知能力。通过对七个VLM的零样本评估发现，模型架构是性能差异的最大来源（部分ω²=0.325），远超视觉条件；逐层探针显示数量信号在视觉编码器早期阶段就已线性可分，而模型间性能差异主要与语言模型组件相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计数基准将数量感知与相关的视觉因素（如物体大小、空间排列）纠缠在一起，无法准确评估VLM的纯数量感知能力。数量感知是人类婴儿在语言习得前就已具备的认知能力，但在当前VLM中尚未得到充分理解。

Method: 构建认知启发的诊断基准NumerosityVLM：包含10,800张合成图像，六个受控条件，正交操控物体大小、空间排列和数量，同时逐步消融纹理、形状和颜色。对七个VLM进行零样本评估，采用多因素分析（部分ω²）归因性能差异来源，并通过逐层探针分析数量信号在视觉编码器中的涌现位置。

Result: 模型架构解释了最大的性能差异比例（部分ω²=0.325），远超视觉条件的影响。逐层探针显示数量信号在视觉编码器早期阶段就一致性地线性可分离，而模型间性能差异主要与语言模型组件相关。

Conclusion: VLM的数量感知瓶颈不在视觉编码阶段（信号早期即可线性分离），而主要受限于语言模型组件。这为改进VLM的数量感知能力提供了明确的方向，即应重点关注语言模型部分的优化。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on high-level multimodal tasks, yet numerosity perception, a cognitive ability that emerges in human infants before language acquisition, remains poorly understood in current models, as existing counting benchmarks entangle numerosity with correlated visual factors. We introduce a cognitively inspired diagnostic benchmark, NumerosityVLM, comprising 10,800 synthetic images across six controlled conditions. The benchmark orthogonally manipulates object size, spatial arrangement, and numerosity, while progressively ablating texture, shape, and color. Evaluating seven VLMs in a zero-shot setting, multi-factor analysis reveals that model architecture explains the largest proportion of performance variance (partial $ω^{2}=0.325$), far exceeding visual conditions. Layer-wise probing further shows that linearly separable numerosity signals consistently emerge at early stages of the vision encoder, while performance differences across evaluated models are primarily associated with the language model component. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/fuy3/NumerosityVLM-Benchmark, and https://huggingface.co/datasets/fuy3/NumerosityVLM.

</details>


### [91] [Spatially-Grounded Flow Matching: Structured Source Distributions for Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15452)
*Arman Zarei,Mahdi M. Kalayeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出StructFlow，通过将空间局部性编码到源噪声分布中（让局部区域像素共享噪声分量），解决了流匹配模型中源分布与图像域归纳偏置不匹配的问题，从而实现更好的局部编辑、结构保持和语义插值能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流匹配模型使用独立的i.i.d.高斯噪声作为源分布，但该分布不具备空间结构的概念。然而图像本质上是局部的——邻近像素高度相关。独立采样的噪声会促使模型在训练中利用噪声较小的邻居作为上下文，部分绕过真正学习图像局部结构的需求。这种源分布与图像域归纳偏置之间的矛盾，限制了模型在精细局部编辑等任务上的能力。

Method: StructFlow的核心思想是将空间局部性直接编码到源分布中：让一个小区域内的像素共享一个共同的噪声分量。这种结构化源分布产生几何上与图像区域对齐的传输路径，使得流匹配能够提供通用方法难以实现的特性——尊重边界的精细局部编辑、稳健的结构保持以及平滑的语义插值。该方法还可通过轻量级后训练阶段集成到大型预训练模型中。

Result: 在多种数据集、多种条件设定（无条件、类别条件、文本条件）以及不同扩散Transformer架构上的综合实验表明，StructFlow不仅保持了有竞争力的图像生成质量，还显著提升了局部可控重建的能力。

Conclusion: 通过重新设计源分布而非修改模型架构，StructFlow以简单而有效的方式弥合了源分布与图像域归纳偏置之间的差距，为流匹配模型带来了更强的空间感知能力和局部控制能力，且可扩展到预训练大模型。

Abstract: Current flow matching models learn to transport the source i.i.d. Gaussian noise into the target distribution of natural images, yet this source distribution carries no notion of spatial structure. Images however are fundamentally local since nearby pixels are strongly correlated. By sampling the noise independently, we hypothesize that models are implicitly encouraged to exploit less noisy neighbors as context during training, partially bypassing the need to properly learn the true local structure of images. The source distribution, in other words, works against the inductive bias of the image domain. To ameliorate this design discrepancy, we propose StructFlow which encodes spatial locality directly into the source by having the pixels within a small region share a common noise component. This structured source produces transport paths that are geometrically aligned with image regions - enabling properties that generic flow matching struggles to provide: fine-grained local editing that naturally respects boundaries, robust structure preservation, and smooth semantic interpolation between images. We show that these benefits also extend to large pre-trained models, demonstrating that StructFlow can even be incorporated through a lightweight post-training phase. Comprehensive experiments on multiple datasets, in unconditional, class and text-conditioned regimes, using different diffusion transformer architectures confirm that StructFlow not only offers competitive image generation quality, but also significantly improves localized controllable re-synthesis.

</details>


### [92] [AlignJEPA: Predictive Vision-Language Alignment for Remote Sensing Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15456)
*Md Aminur Hossain,Omkumar Vaghasiya,Rajeev Ranjan Dwivedi,Vinod Kurmi,Biplab Banerjee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AlignJEPA是一种JEPA启发的预测式视觉-语言对齐框架，用于遥感基础模型。它利用预训练的AnySat视觉编码器和RemoteCLIP文本编码器，仅训练轻量级预测对齐网络，通过掩码视觉token预测遥感文本嵌入，实现参数高效的视觉-语言对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感基础模型在传感器、分辨率和地理区域上提供了可迁移的地球观测表示，但大多数与自然语言的对齐较弱，限制了自然语言档案检索、图像-文本检索和问题条件分析等应用。现有方法依赖全局图像-文本对比对齐，未充分利用掩码预测等自监督信号。

Method: AlignJEPA采用JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）思想，使用预训练的AnySat视觉编码器和RemoteCLIP文本编码器，仅训练轻量级预测对齐网络。核心组件是掩码感知的多尺度预测对齐器，在精细、区域和全局尺度聚合可见token，通过跨尺度Transformer联合建模，并用学习查询池化将表示投影到文本空间。训练结合语义预测和双向对比检索损失。

Result: 在BigEarthNet.txt上进行自然语言Sentinel检索训练和评估，在RSICD上进行跨数据集适应评估，并使用RSVQA作为闭集表示探针。AlignJEPA提供了一种参数高效的对齐遥感基础模型与语言的途径。

Conclusion: AlignJEPA展示了利用JEPA预测框架实现遥感基础模型与语言对齐的有效性，通过掩码视觉token预测文本嵌入并结合多尺度聚合与对比检索，实现了参数高效、跨数据集可适应的视觉-语言对齐方案。

Abstract: Remote sensing (RS) foundation models provide transferable Earth observation representations across sensors, resolutions, and geographies, yet most remain weakly aligned with natural language, limiting natural-language archive search, image-text retrieval, and question-conditioned analysis. We propose AlignJEPA, a JEPA-inspired predictive vision-language alignment framework for remote sensing foundation models. AlignJEPA uses a pretrained AnySat visual encoder and a RemoteCLIP text encoder while training only a lightweight predictive alignment network. Instead of relying on global image--text contrastive alignment alone, the framework predicts remote-sensing text embeddings from masked visual foundation-model tokens. Its mask-aware multi-scale predictive aligner aggregates visible tokens at fine, regional, and global scales, jointly models them with a cross-scale Transformer, and projects the resulting representation into the text space using learned query pooling. Training combines semantic prediction with bidirectional contrastive retrieval. We train and evaluate AlignJEPA on BigEarthNet.txt for natural-language Sentinel retrieval, evaluate cross-dataset adaptation on RSICD, and use RSVQA only as a closed-set representation probe. AlignJEPA provides a parameter-efficient route for aligning Earth observation foundation models with language.

</details>


### [93] [GLaQ: Grounding Latent Queries in Visual Evidence for Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15517)
*Zesheng Yang,Lingling Zhang,Xinyu Zhang,Cheng Zhang,Pengyu Li,Heng Wang,Lin Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GLaQ，一种基于grounded latent-query的框架，通过固定的上下文条件查询直接锚定原始视觉token，取代了传统的自回归潜在推理，在不依赖外部视觉工具的情况下提升了多模态大语言模型的细粒度视觉理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 链式思维推理虽提升了多模态模型的解题能力，但细粒度视觉证据难以在文本推理步骤中被保留和重用。现有两类方案各有局限：外部工具增强方法需要预定义工具和额外推理开销；内部连续视觉潜在推理的自回归构造导致后续潜在状态可能重复已有信息，无法捕捉互补的视觉细节。

Method: GLaQ用一组固定的、基于上下文条件的查询替代顺序潜在展开，这些查询锚定于原始视觉token。锚定的查询被重新注入用于答案生成，从而提供对源视觉证据的直接和协调访问。训练分为两个阶段：局部化视图监督预训练，随后在任务级奖励下进行强化学习。

Result: 在五个细粒度视觉理解和感知基准上，GLaQ-7B相较于基础模型提升5.99%~9.66%，并优于所有对比的视觉潜在方法。

Conclusion: 直接查询到图像的锚定机制能够从完整图像中恢复局部化证据，无需外部视觉操作或自回归潜在展开，为细粒度视觉理解提供了更高效、更有效的内部推理方案。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving capabilities of multimodal large language models. Fine-grained visual evidence, however, remains difficult to preserve and reuse across text-based reasoning steps. To address this limitation, tool-augmented thinking-with-images methods maintain visual access externally by revisiting or manipulating the image, but require predefined tools and additional inference-time processing. As an internal alternative, continuous visual latent reasoning retains intermediate computation in hidden states. However, its prevailing autoregressive construction makes each latent state depend on its predecessors, so later states may repeat information already present in the latent sequence rather than capture complementary visual details. We introduce GLaQ, a grounded latent-query framework that replaces sequential latent rollout with a fixed set of context-conditioned queries grounded in the original visual tokens. The grounded queries are reinjected for answer generation, providing direct and coordinated access to source visual evidence. We train GLaQ with localized-view supervision followed by reinforcement learning under task-level rewards. Across five benchmarks for fine-grained visual understanding and perception, GLaQ-7B gains 5.99--9.66\% over its base model and leads all compared visual latent methods, suggesting that direct query-to-image grounding can recover localized evidence from the full image without external visual operations or autoregressive latent rollouts.

</details>


### [94] [Efficient Audio-Visual Generation via Synchrony-Aware Cross-Modal Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15522)
*Shengchuan Gao,Teng Hu,Bohao Feng,Luchen Li,Wenqiang Wang,Hongqian Deng,Ran Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个同步感知的加速框架，用于高效的音视频生成。通过观察双向音视频交叉注意力中高响应集中在少数与声音相关的视觉和时间区域，设计了一种受保护的稀疏注意力策略，在稀疏化冗余注意力交互的同时，保留同步关键令牌的高保真计算，从而在提升推理效率的同时保持视频质量、音频质量和音视频同步性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频生成模型推理成本高昂，因为长视频令牌序列需要跨去噪步骤重复计算注意力。虽然已有针对视频生成模型的加速技术（低比特量化、注意力稀疏化、特征缓存），但这些方法是为视频生成设计的，直接应用于音视频模型会忽略音频与视频分支之间的交互，可能破坏音视频同步。

Method: 提出同步感知加速框架。核心观察是双向音视频交叉注意力揭示了两个分支之间的结构化交互，高响应集中在少数与声音相关的视觉和时间区域。基于该交互模式，引入受保护的稀疏注意力策略：对同步关键令牌保留高保真计算，同时稀疏化冗余的注意力交互，从而在加速过程中显式考虑跨模态依赖。

Result: 该方法在提升推理效率的同时，保持了视频质量、音频质量和音视频同步性。

Conclusion: 通过显式考虑跨模态依赖进行加速，本文方法在提高推理效率的同时维持了生成质量与音视频同步性能，表明在加速音视频生成模型时，跨模态交互的模式应当被纳入优化考量。

Abstract: Recent audio-visual generation models can synthesize synchronized video and sound in a unified diffusion process, but their inference cost remains high because long video token sequences require repeated attention computation across denoising steps.A variety of acceleration techniques have been developed for video generation models, including low-bit quantization, attention sparsification, and feature caching.However, since these methods are originally designed for video generation, directly applying them to audio-visual models overlooks the interactions between the audio and video branches and may therefore disrupt audio-video synchronization.We present a synchronization-aware acceleration framework for efficient audio-visual generation.Our key observation is that bidirectional audio-video cross-attention reveals structured interactions between the two branches, with high responses often concentrated on a few sound-related visual and temporal regions.Guided by this interaction pattern, we introduce a protected sparse attention strategy that preserves high-fidelity computation for synchronization-critical tokens while sparsifying redundant attention interactions.By explicitly accounting for cross-modal dependence during acceleration, our method improves inference efficiency while keeping video quality, audio quality, and audio-video synchronization.

</details>


### [95] [EA-LiteUNet: An Edge-Adaptive and Resource-Efficient U-Net for Boundary-Sensitive Dermoscopic Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15537)
*Wang Jiangtao,Nur Intan Raihana Ruhaiyem,Fu Panpan,Yang Yu,Huang Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EA-LiteUNet，一种面向边界敏感的医学图像分割的边缘自适应轻量级U-Net变体，通过边界感知表征学习、注意力引导特征调制和资源自适应推理三大机制，在三个皮肤镜数据集上实现了优越的边界精度（ISIC 2018上HD95降至12.89像素，Dice达92.08%），且仅需0.29M参数和1.17 GFLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤镜图像分割中边界轮廓准确描绘仍具挑战，因为病灶边界属于高频成分，极易受混叠、噪声放大和信息丢失影响；传统卷积架构的反复下采样和特征变换导致边界表征严重退化。

Method: 提出EA-LiteUNet架构，集成三大核心机制：(1)边界感知表征学习，抑制混叠并保留高频结构细节；(2)注意力引导特征调制，在多尺度特征中选择性增强边界相关响应；(3)资源自适应推理策略，动态平衡分割精度与计算效率。

Result: 在三个公开皮肤镜数据集上一致取得优越边界精度。ISIC 2018上HD95降至12.89像素，Dice达92.08%，且仅需0.29M参数和1.17 GFLOPs的超轻量配置。消融实验验证了各组件互补效应。

Conclusion: EA-LiteUNet通过针对高频边界信息保留的专门设计，在保持极低计算成本的同时显著提升了皮肤镜图像分割的边界保真度，证明了边界敏感架构设计在医学图像分割中的有效性。

Abstract: Accurate boundary delineation remains a persistent challenge in dermoscopic image segmentation because of blurred lesion margins, heterogeneous textures, and complex background artifacts. From a signal-processing perspective, lesion boundaries represent high-frequency components that are highly susceptible to aliasing, noise amplification, and information loss. Consequently, repeated downsampling and feature transformations in conventional convolutional architectures often lead to severely degraded boundary representations. To address these limitations, we propose EA-LiteUNet, an edge-adaptive and computationally efficient U-Net variant specifically designed for boundary-sensitive medical image segmentation. The architecture integrates three core mechanisms: (1) boundary-aware representation learning to suppress aliasing and preserve high-frequency structural details; (2) attention-guided feature modulation to selectively enhance boundary-relevant responses across multi-scale features; and (3) a resource-adaptive inference strategy to dynamically balance segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations across three public dermoscopic datasets demonstrate that EA-LiteUNet consistently achieves superior boundary precision. Specifically, on the ISIC 2018 dataset, the method significantly reduces the 95% Hausdorff Distance (HD95) to 12.89 pixels while maintaining a robust Dice score of 92.08%. Notably, this strong performance is achieved with an ultralightweight configuration of merely 0.29M parameters and 1.17 GFLOPs. Ablation studies further validate the complementary effects of these components, confirming their contribution to enhanced boundary fidelity and stable optimization.

</details>


### [96] [CrossView: Can Vision-Language Models Reason Across Cameras?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15539)
*Sahil Shah,S P Sharan,Harsh Goel,Manvik Pasula,Adithya Hebbalae,Minkyu Choi,Sandeep P. Chinchali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CrossView，一个多摄像头视频问答基准，涵盖自动驾驶、安防监控、自我/外部视角视频和机器人领域。评估显示包括GPT-5.2在内的专有模型和Qwen3-VL等开源模型在此基准上准确率均较低，开源模型差距更大，且性能与模型联合处理多视角的能力密切相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准集中于单摄像头设置，但真实世界依赖多摄像头网络（自动驾驶、安防、机器人等）。多摄像头推理与单摄像头问题本质不同，需要处理随视角数量扩展的上下文、解决仅部分摄像头可见的遮挡问题、判断哪些视角重要，并整合可能重叠或分化的多视角证据。然而现有模型在这些挑战上表现不佳，且缺乏系统性针对该问题的基准。

Method: 作者构建了CrossView基准，一个跨多领域的多摄像头视频问答数据集，覆盖自动驾驶、安防监控、自我/外部视角视频和机器人四大场景。该基准专门设计用于测试模型在多视角条件下的推理能力，包括视角选择、遮挡处理、跨视角证据整合等核心挑战。

Result: 对专有模型（如GPT-5.2）和开源模型（如Qwen3-VL）的评估显示，所有模型在CrossView上准确率均较低，其中开源模型与专有模型差距明显。研究还发现模型性能与其联合处理多视角的能力高度相关。

Conclusion: 多摄像头视频推理是当前多模态语言模型面临的重要缺口，CrossView作为首个系统性的多摄像头视频QA基准，能够有效区分模型的多视角联合推理能力，为该方向研究提供了严格的评估框架。代码和数据集已开源。

Abstract: Video understanding benchmarks have long centered on single-camera settings, where modern multi-modal language models achieve strong performance across image and video tasks. Yet, the real world runs on multi-camera networks: autonomous vehicles, security systems, and robots all gather data across many simultaneous views. We argue that this is not simply "more" of the single-camera problem; it is fundamentally different. Multi-camera reasoning requires handling context that scales with the number of views, resolving occlusions visible from only a subset of cameras, judging which views matter, and integrating evidence across perspectives that may overlap or diverge. Current models struggle with exactly these challenges, yet no benchmark systematically targets them. We introduce CrossView, a multi-camera video question-answering benchmark spanning autonomous driving, security surveillance, egocentric/exocentric video, and robotics. Evaluation of proprietary models, such as GPT-5.2, and open-source models, like Qwen3-VL, reveals consistently low accuracy, with open-source models trailing by a wide margin. Performance scales strongly with a model's ability to jointly process multiple viewpoints, positioning CrossView as a rigorous benchmark for multi-camera video. We open-source our code and dataset at https://utaustin-swarmlab.github.io/CrossView.

</details>


### [97] [RigidBench: Evaluating Rigid-Body Physics in Video Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15555)
*Swarnim Jain,Shangzhe Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RigidBench，一个基于模拟器构建的视频预测基准，通过五个刚体任务和十个独立测量指标来分别评估运动、几何、身份、背景稳定性和视觉相似性，并利用5,000个带精确模拟状态的训练视频对Wan 2.2进行微调与分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频模型评估指标（如SSIM）混合了多种误差来源，无法区分运动、几何、身份、背景稳定性等不同维度是否独立失效，导致模型性能排名严重依赖于所用指标。

Method: 构建RigidBench基准：五个刚体任务涵盖不同物体、材质、视角及室内外场景，提供逐帧掩码、深度、6-DoF轨迹和接触信息用于独立评分；同时提供5,000个具有精确模拟状态的训练视频，用于微调Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B并进行教师强制探测和定向干预分析。

Result: 在100个示例上评估八个模型和十项测量指标，结果显示排名强烈依赖测量维度，没有任何模型在所有十项指标上领先；跨模型均值中，更高SSIM伴随更大的3D轨迹误差（r=0.89）。对Wan 2.2进行全量微调使3D轨迹误差降低约20%且SSIM几乎不变；探测实验表明物体位置在整个扩散Transformer中被表征并用于去噪计算。

Conclusion: RigidBench揭示了现有视频预测评估中指标的混杂问题，证明需要将不同误差维度分开测量；同时展示了对视频生成模型内部物体位置表征进行机制性分析的可行性，为模型评估和改进提供了新的工具和方法。

Abstract: Video models are increasingly used to predict what happens next in a scene, yet the metrics commonly used to compare their outputs say little about whether the predicted objects move correctly. Motion, geometry, identity, background stability, and visual similarity can fail independently, but whole-frame scores often mix these errors together. We introduce RigidBench, a simulator-grounded benchmark that compares a generated continuation with a reference rollout from the same initial frame and motion description. Its five rigid-body tasks vary objects, materials, viewpoints, and indoor and outdoor scenes, with per-frame masks, depth, 6-DoF trajectories, and contacts available for scoring. We evaluate eight models on the same 100 examples with ten measurements that keep these aspects separate. The resulting rankings depend strongly on what is measured: no model leads on all ten, and across model means, higher SSIM accompanies larger 3D trajectory error (r = 0.89). RigidBench also includes 5,000 training videos with exact simulator state, which we use to fine-tune and analyze Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B. Full fine-tuning reduces 3D trajectory error by about 20% with almost no change in SSIM, while teacher-forced probes and targeted interventions show that object position is represented throughout Wan's diffusion transformer and used by its denoising computation.

</details>


### [98] [Catching Hallucinated Citations in Video-LLM Question Answering: A Self-Verification Pipeline and Verifier Ablation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15574)
*Yogesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个闭环的视频问答管线，通过检索增强语言模型生成带时间戳引用的答案，并在显示给用户前独立重新检查每个被引用的帧，以解决视频QA中"时间戳暗示接地但实际未接地"的欺骗性幻觉问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型驱动的视频问答系统常常产生带时间戳的高置信度声明，但这些声明可能并不被所引用的帧支持。时间戳的存在给人一种接地（grounding）的错觉，增加了用户信任但并未提高准确性，这种欺骗性幻觉需要被解决。

Method: 提出一个完整管线：检索增强语言模型先生成带逐条声明时间戳引用的答案，然后每个被引用的帧在展示给用户之前被独立重新检查。作者比较了普通基线，并消融了三种验证设计：直接询问视觉模型（失败，0%捕获率，因谄媚效应）、盲重述+通用LLM评判（不稳定，0%-100%波动）、盲重述+小型自然语言推理模型（稳定、可解释，79%捕获率）。

Result: 直接询问视觉模型因谄媚效应完全失败（40条声明中0%捕获率）；盲重述加通用LLM评判受提示词措辞影响剧烈波动；用小型NLI模型替代评判者后，在对抗性错误前提问题上可捕获79%的捏造声明，同时不影响真实声明。系统在Apple Silicon (MLX)和Google Colab (CUDA)两平台均完成评估。

Conclusion: 小型自然语言推理模型作为验证器是稳定且可解释的方案，能有效捕获大部分捏造声明而不误伤真实内容。作者发布了完整管线、评估框架及两个平台的实现代码。

Abstract: Video question answering systems built on vision-language models often produce timestamped claims with high confidence even when unsupported by the cited frame. This deceptive hallucination arises because timestamps imply grounding without ensuring correctness, increasing user trust but not accuracy. We introduce a pipeline that closes this loop. A retrieval-augmented language model drafts answers with per-claim timestamp citations, and each cited frame is independently re-examined before being shown to the user. We compare against a plain baseline and ablate three verification designs, evaluated on both Apple Silicon (MLX) and Google Colab (HF Transformers, CUDA). Directly asking the vision model whether a frame supports a claim fails completely (0% catch rate on 40 claims) due to sycophancy. Blind re-captioning plus a general LLM judge improves results but is unstable, oscillating between 0% and 100% flagged depending on prompt phrasing. Replacing that judge with a small natural language inference model yields a stable, interpretable verifier that catches 79% of fabricated claims on adversarial false-premise questions while leaving true claims untouched. We release the full pipeline, evaluation harness, and implementations for both Apple Silicon and Colab. Code is available at https://github.com/yogesh-iitj/grounded-video-qa.

</details>


### [99] [PoseAdapter: Dual-Stream 2.5D Controllable Image Generation for Complex Multi-Object Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15583)
*Yufeng Chi,Huimin Ma,Fan Gao,Zhice Niu,Keqin Li,Jianmin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了PoseAdapter，一种轻量级框架，通过使用物体描述、2D边界框和3D角度作为条件锚点，实现高保真的2.5D可控图像生成，解决了多物体场景中空间和方向控制难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的T2I扩散模型在多物体场景中难以实现精确的空间和方向控制，已有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的密集3D地图，要么存在属性泄漏和"剪切粘贴"伪影问题。

Method: 提出Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation，通过并行掩码和非掩码路径将局部物体token和关系增强的场景token注入现代MM-DiT架构的视觉流中；同时构建OrientLayout数据集，包含标准化2.5D注释和实例级解耦语义。

Result: 大量实验表明PoseAdapter在空间准确性、方向精度和多物体视觉保真度方面均优于现有最先进基线。

Conclusion: PoseAdapter以轻量级方式实现了高保真的2.5D可控图像生成，有效解决了属性泄漏和全局连贯性之间的生成权衡问题。

Abstract: While Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable success, precise spatial and orientational control in multi-object scenes remains a persistent challenge. Existing methods either rely on computationally expensive dense 3D maps or suffer from severe attribute leakage and "cut-and-paste" artifacts. To address these limitations, we propose PoseAdapter, a lightweight framework for high-fidelity 2.5D controllable image generation. Instead of dense spatial maps, it establishes precise spatial-angular anchors using an efficient condition layout: individual object captions, 2D bounding boxes, and 3D angles. To resolve the generative trade-off between strict instance isolation and global coherence, we introduce a Context-Aware Dual-Stream Representation. By injecting local object tokens and relation-enriched scene tokens into the visual stream of modern MM-DiT architectures via parallel masked and unmasked pathways, PoseAdapter eliminates attribute leakage while preserving natural inter-object relationships and scene-level coherence. To support this paradigm, we construct OrientLayout, a high-quality dataset featuring standardized 2.5D annotations and instance-level decoupled semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PoseAdapter outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in spatial accuracy, orientational precision, and multi-object visual fidelity. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/cyf23/PoseAdapter.

</details>


### [100] [AlloEgo-VLM: Disambiguating Allocentric and Egocentric Reference Frames in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15605)
*Kuan-Lin Chen,Tzu-Ti Wei,Chao-Chi Liao,Yu-Chee Tseng,Jen-Jee Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AlloEgo-VLM框架，旨在解决视觉语言模型（VLMs）在理解空间语义时面临的歧义问题，通过构建AlloEgo-View数据集（包含自我中心和他人中心视角的三元组），训练模型能够消除空间参考框架歧义，并在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中部署到具身机器人平台验证其实际可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs在理解空间关系时，由于自然语言描述常省略明确的参考框架，导致语义歧义。现有VLMs缺乏对参考框架和物体朝向的训练，对具身AI机器人可能产生严重错误。空间认知受认知心理学、空间科学和文化背景影响，物体常被赋予方向性，这使得歧义问题更加突出。

Method: 1) 构建新数据集AlloEgo-View，包含（图像、查询、视角特定答案）三元组，从自我中心（egocentric）和他人中心（allocentric）两个视角捕捉关键物体关系；2) 视角特定描述采用结构化空间表示，标注详细场景描述、参考与目标物体、朝向、参考框架和视角类型；3) 基于该数据集开发AlloEgo-VLM框架，通过监督微调可轻松集成到现有VLMs中，即使面对歧义查询也能消除参考框架歧义；4) 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中部署到具身机器人平台，验证开放目标搜索任务中的实际可行性。

Result: 实验揭示了当前VLMs在处理视角特定查询时的局限性，并展示了AlloEgo-VLM强大的消歧能力。同时，在具身机器人平台上验证了该框架在开放目标搜索任务中的实际可行性。

Conclusion: AlloEgo-VLM通过结构化空间表示和专门的数据集训练，有效解决了VLMs在空间参考框架方面的歧义问题，并能集成到现有模型及部署到具身机器人系统，为空间认知增强的具身AI提供了可行方案。

Abstract: This study investigates the challenge of ambiguity faced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in understanding spatial semantics. Spatial cognition, shaped by cognitive psychology, spatial science, and cultural context, often assigns directionality to objects. However, natural language descriptions of spatial relations frequently omit explicit reference frames, leading to semantic ambiguity and potentially serious errors for embodied AI robots. Existing VLMs, due to insufficient training on reference frames and object orientations, often produce inconsistent responses. To address this issue, we construct a new dataset, AlloEgo-View, comprising (image, query, view-specific answer) triplets that capture key object relations from both allocentric and egocentric perspectives. The view-specific descriptions follow a structured spatial representation that annotate detailed scene descriptions, reference and target objects, their orientations, reference frames, and view types. Building on AlloEgo-View, we develop AlloEgo-VLM, a framework to disambiguate allocentric and egocentric reference frames, even under ambiguous queries, and to be easily integrated into existing VLMs via supervised fine-tuning. Furthermore, we deploy our framework onto an embodied robotic platform within NVIDIA Isaac Sim to validate its real-world feasibility in open-ended object searching tasks. Experiments highlight the limitations of current VLMs in handling view-specific queries and demonstrate the strong disambiguation ability of AlloEgo-VLM.

</details>


### [101] [EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15614)
*Matteo Stoiber,Niels Buus Lassen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoGazeLite是一个轻量级双过程注视预测器，用于在无需眼动追踪硬件的情况下，为多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的自我中心视频理解提供注视条件裁剪。该模型仅用15.7M参数和6.71 GFLOPs，在消费级加速硬件上实现21.6ms/帧的端到端实时运行，且预测注视裁剪与真实注视裁剪在两项MLLM、三项自动指标和两项LLM评判下均无显著差异（十个案例全部确认等价）。这一成果消除了MLLM基于注视的token高效视频理解对专用眼动追踪硬件的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在可穿戴设备上进行自我中心视频理解受限于token预算，高分辨率视频的传输和处理成本高昂。先前的GazeLLM通过围绕佩戴者注视方向裁剪视频来减少约十倍视觉token，但该方法依赖专用眼动追踪硬件，而消费级智能眼镜不具备该硬件。因此需要一个纯软件的注视预测器，既要足够准确以保持下游描述质量，又必须足够轻量以在智能手机的功耗和计算预算内运行。

Method: EgoGazeLite采用轻量级双过程（dual-process）架构进行注视预测，用于自我中心视频。它作为一种纯软件替代方案，替代眼动追踪硬件，在端到端流水线中完成注视预测和视频裁剪，从而将裁剪后的视频输入给MLLM生成描述。

Result: 在两项MLLM、三项自动指标和两项LLM评判的评估下，预测注视裁剪与真实注视裁剪之间无显著差异，所有十个案例均确认等价性。模型规模为15.7M参数、6.71 GFLOPs，在消费级加速硬件上实现端到端实时运行（21.6ms/帧）。

Conclusion: EgoGazeLite成功消除了MLLM进行token高效、注视条件的自我中心视频理解时对眼动追踪硬件的需求，使该技术可部署于无专用硬件的消费级智能眼镜和智能手机平台。

Abstract: The use of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for egocentric video understanding with wearable devices is constrained by the token budget. Memory and compute cost scale with the number of visual tokens, and high-resolution video quickly becomes expensive to transmit and process at scale. Prior work (GazeLLM) addresses this by cropping the video around the camera wearer's gaze. This reduces the number of visual tokens by about tenfold while maintaining or improving the quality of full-resolution descriptions. However, this compression strategy depends on dedicated eye-tracking hardware, which is unavailable on consumer smart glasses. Building a software-only substitute poses a joint constraint: the predictor must be accurate enough to preserve downstream description quality, yet light enough to run on-device, within the power and compute budget of a smartphone. We address this with EgoGazeLite, a lightweight dual-process gaze predictor for egocentric video. Across two MLLMs, three automated metrics, and two LLM judges, predicted-gaze crops show no significant difference from ground-truth-gaze crops. Equivalence is confirmed in all ten cases. EgoGazeLite achieves this at 15.7M parameters, 6.71 GFLOPs, and runs the full gaze-and-crop pipeline end-to-end in real time (21.6 ms/frame) on consumer accelerator hardware. Together, these results remove the need for eye-tracking hardware for token-efficient, gaze-conditioned egocentric video understanding with MLLMs.

</details>


### [102] [Hierarchical Adaptive Feature Refinement Network for VHR Remote Sensing Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15647)
*Shuaishuai Cao,Meng Tang,Shuwei Peng,Xuan Liu,Min Huang,Jie Chen,Jiacheng Niu,Yong Chen,Edore Akpokodje,Hui Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HAFR-Net，一种渐进式细化框架，通过自适应组织和保守细化分层表示而非用单片解码器替换，在多个VHR遥感分割基准上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VHR遥感影像分割受益于预训练分层编码器，但多阶段表示利用困难：不同区域需要不同的细节-语义平衡、激进的特定任务变换会扰动预训练特征、常规语义监督缺乏结构引导。

Method: 三个组件：1) HG-SAF根据局部特征变异预测稠密阶段权重实现自适应融合；2) FRA通过有界零初始化残差分支注入频率信息，以融合表示为其参考；3) CATP用边界、目标性、类别关系三个先验正则化预测。

Result: 在匹配Swin-B训练和单尺度推理下，ISPRS Vaihingen、Potsdam、LoveDA、OpenEarthMap上mIoU分别为84.12%、87.86%、55.17%、67.70%，比匹配UPerNet基线提升0.55、0.95、1.55、1.84个百分点。

Conclusion: 控制实验表明空间重加权优于纯内容路由、边界和细结构精度优于匹配的空间和光谱替代方案、预声明类别对上的混淆减少。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation of very-high-resolution (VHR) remote sensing imagery increasingly benefits from strong pretrained hierarchical encoders, yet exploiting their multi-stage representations remains difficult. Nearby regions demand different balances between fine detail and semantic context, aggressive task-specific transformations perturb useful pretrained features, and conventional semantic supervision provides limited structural guidance. We present HAFR-Net, a progressive refinement framework that adaptively organizes and conservatively refines hierarchical representations instead of replacing them with a monolithic decoder transformation. Heterogeneity-Guided Stage-Adaptive Fusion (HG-SAF) predicts dense stage weights conditioned on local feature variation. A Frequency-Residual Adapter (FRA) then injects frequency information through a bounded, zero-initialized residual branch that keeps the fused representation as its reference. A Confusion-Aware Tri-Prior Decoder (CATP) finally regularizes the prediction with boundary, objectness, and training-derived class-relation cues. Under a matched Swin-B training and single-scale inference protocol, HAFR-Net attains 84.12%, 87.86%, 55.17%, and 67.70% mIoU on ISPRS Vaihingen, ISPRS Potsdam, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap, improving the matched UPerNet baseline by 0.55, 0.95, 1.55, and 1.84 percentage points, respectively. Controlled analyses further show consistent spatial reweighting beyond content-only routing, improved boundary and thin-structure accuracy over matched spatial and spectral alternatives, and reduced confusion on pre-declared class pairs.

</details>


### [103] [Gaussian-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for 3D Gaussian Splats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15651)
*Bin Ren,Qi Ma,Yue Li,Zongyan Han,Yidi Li,Yuqian Fu,Rao Muhammad Anwer,Theo Gevers,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gaussian-JEPA，一种针对 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）表示的自监督预训练方法。它通过从可见的高斯 token 块预测被遮蔽 token 块的潜在表示（而非重建高斯属性）来学习可复用的 3D 表示，利用了指数移动平均编码器和多尺度目标，相比重建式预训练在重采样一致性、部分观测保留和形状补全方面表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 自监督方法（如重建遮蔽高斯属性）将监督信号绑定到单一采样实现，需要输入空间解码器；而潜在预测应用于高斯 token 时，需要解决耦合属性和异构空间支持带来的目标构建难题。作者希望开发一种不依赖属性重建、能获得可复用高斯表征的自监督目标。

Method: Gaussian-JEPA 采用在线编码器处理可见上下文，并用共享的指数移动平均（EMA）编码器为多尺度目标提供 stop-gradient 特征。通过互补的目标投影和特征空间接地（feature-space grounding）提供潜在监督，避免直接重建高斯属性。整体遵循 JEPA 式（联合嵌入预测架构）的潜在预测范式。

Result: 与匹配的重建式预训练相比，Gaussian-JEPA 在重采样输入下特征更一致，部分观测下保留更多实例信息，并为高斯补全提供更强的冻结特征。在零件分割和物体分类等迁移任务上也取得良好表现。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，潜在预测是学习可复用 3D 高斯表示的有效目标，Gaussian-JEPA 提供了一种无需属性重建、更具泛化性的 3DGS 自监督预训练框架。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) represents 3D content with anisotropic primitives that jointly encode geometry and appearance. Fixed-budget encoders consume sampled observations of Gaussian assets, so the same object may be observed through different primitive realizations. Existing self-supervised methods mainly reconstruct masked Gaussian attributes, tying supervision to one sampled realization and requiring an input-space decoder. Latent prediction offers an alternative, but its application to Gaussian tokens requires targets that accommodate coupled attributes and heterogeneous spatial support. We introduce Gaussian-JEPA, which predicts representations of held-out Gaussian token blocks from visible context. An online encoder processes the context, while a shared exponential-moving-average encoder supplies stop-gradient features for multi-scale targets. Complementary target projections and feature-space grounding provide latent supervision without reconstructing Gaussian attributes. We evaluate the features under Gaussian resampling, partial observations, and renderable shape completion, together with transfer to part segmentation and object classification. Compared with matched reconstruction pretraining, Gaussian-JEPA is more consistent across resampled inputs, retains more instance information under partial observations, and provides stronger frozen features for Gaussian completion. These results support latent prediction as an effective objective for reusable 3D Gaussian representations. Code is on the project page (https://amazingren.github.io/Gaussian-JEPA/).

</details>


### [104] [Scalable Black-Box Model Attribution for Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15652)
*Asaf Livne,Amir Jevnisek,Shai Avidan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RPA（Raw-Patch Attribution）方法，用轻量级CNN在严格黑盒设置下进行图像生成模型的归因，在多个基准上超越现有方法，且具备数据高效、成本与候选模型数量无关、对压缩模糊等鲁棒的特点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型的快速普及带来了模型归因问题：给定一张图像，能否判断它由哪个模型生成？现有方法随着目标生成器日趋复杂而不断复杂化，作者认为这种复杂性假设是错误的，旨在证明简单的轻量级方法就能实现高性能归因。

Method: 提出RPA（Raw-Patch Attribution）方法，使用轻量级CNN在严格黑盒设置下进行归因，直接对原始图像patch进行处理，成本与候选模型数量无关。

Result: 在25类DRAGON上达到98.0%准确率，在27类OpenFake上达到92.9%准确率，超越先前工作；数据高效；对压缩、模糊、缩放等图像退化鲁棒；训练得到的特征提取器具有通用性，可无监督恢复模型谱系、标记和分组未见生成器、通过少样本适配接纳新模型。

Conclusion: 闭合集归因训练产生的特征提取器具有多功能性，简单方法即可实现强大的模型归因能力，挑战了"更复杂的模型需要更复杂的归因器"的假设。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of generative models raises the model attribution problem: given only an image, can we determine which model produced it? Existing methods have grown as elaborate as the generators they target, on the as- sumption that a more sophisticated model demands a more sophisticated attributor. We show it does not. RPA (Raw- Patch Attribution) attributes images in the strictest black- box setting with a lightweight CNN. Despite its simplicity, it attributes more models at higher accuracy than prior work, reaching 98.0% on 25-class DRAGON and 92.9% on 27- class OpenFake; it is data-efficient and runs at a cost inde- pendent of the number of candidate models; and it stays ro- bust to the compression, blur, and resizing images undergo in the wild. Training for closed-set attribution yields a ver- satile feature extractor: the same representation recovers model lineage without supervision, flags and groups unseen generators, and admits new models through few-shot adap- tation rather than retraining.

</details>


### [105] [WorldRover: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15659)
*Xiaojie Xu,Zhengyuan Lin,Runyi Li,Yihao Liu,Kaipeng Zhang,Yongtao Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldRover是一个数据引擎，用于生成大规模、带丰富标注的虚拟环境长程探索数据。它基于Unreal Engine渲染分钟级遍历路线，同时提供RGB、深度、相机轨迹、动作信号（第一/第三人称及360全景），以及稠密光流、2D/3D点跟踪和角色轨迹等标注，为可探索世界建模提供高质量监督信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习生成或重建可探索世界需要视频配对的多种信号（如相机运动、场景几何、时间对应及控制信号），但真实采集难以同时获得稠密几何和长程对应，而现有合成数据资源很少在同一帧上同时提供这些信号并支持视点和外观的可控变化。

Method: WorldRover由两部分组成：(1) WorldRover-Engine——基于Unreal Engine的离线渲染管线，执行分钟级遍历路线并保留完整轨迹和场景几何，可切换第一/第三人称及360全景视角和环境状态；(2) WorldRover-10M——由引擎生成的大规模数据集，RGB与度量深度、相机轨迹及动作信号配对，第三人称子集额外提供稠密光流、长程2D/3D点跟踪（含可见性）和独立于相机的角色轨迹。

Result: 构建了WorldRover-10M数据集，提供了多视角（第一/第三人称、360全景）下配对的RGB、深度、轨迹和动作信号，以及第三人称下额外的稠密光流、长程点跟踪和角色轨迹等丰富标注。

Conclusion: WorldRover将长时程世界探索转化为可扩展的数据生成问题，为需要构建、维护和回访可探索世界一致表示的模型提供了监督信号。

Abstract: Learning to generate or reconstruct explorable worlds requires video paired with more than RGB: camera motion, scene geometry, temporal correspondence and, for interactive models, control signals. Real capture can provide some of these signals, but dense geometry and long-range correspondence usually rely on estimation or specialised instrumentation. Rendering provides these quantities directly, yet existing synthetic resources rarely combine them on the same frames while also supporting controlled changes of viewpoint and appearance. We introduce WorldRover, a data engine for generating richly annotated, long-range explorations of artist-built environments. At its core, WorldRover-Engine is an Unreal Engine pipeline that executes and offline-renders minute-scale routes while preserving their full trajectories and scene geometry. The same exploration can be replayed from first-person, third-person, and 360 panoramic cameras under different environmental states. Using WorldRover-Engine, we construct WorldRover-10M, whose sequences pair RGB with metric depth, camera trajectories, and trajectory-derived action signals throughout each exploration. Third-person subsets additionally provide dense optical flow, long-range 2D/3D point tracks with visibility, and a character trajectory distinct from the camera trajectory. The engine can render a traversal from first-person, third-person and 360 panoramic viewpoints, under different environmental states or with a neutral white material, while preserving the route and scene geometry. WorldRover therefore turns long-horizon world exploration into a scalable data-generation problem, providing supervision for models that must build, maintain, and revisit coherent representations of an explorable world.

</details>


### [106] [BASeg: Boundary-Aware Remote Sensing Segmentation with Structural Penalties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15683)
*Yuexi Song,Kailai Sun,Zhuoyu Wang,Mingyi He,Paul Pu Liang,Shenhao Wang,Jinhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于马氏距离-角度边界损失（MABL）的边界感知遥感分割框架BASeg，并构建了全球10城市基准数据集GCD-25k，在四个遥感基准上取得了最高2.8%的mIoU提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感语义分割方法难以捕捉细粒度物体特征和边界细节，且当前主流数据集缺乏城市形态多样性，生成图像上的分割也尚未被充分探索。这些局限阻碍了分割精度的进一步提升。

Method: 1) 提出MABL损失函数，通过马氏距离加权和角度感知惩罚联合建模结构重要性与边界方向；2) 提出BASeg框架，集成全局视觉状态空间模块（GSM）与跨特征融合模块（CFM），同时捕获长程上下文依赖和细粒度局部细节；3) 构建全球10城市基准数据集GCD-25k，用于建筑和道路分割。

Result: 在四个遥感分割基准上，BASeg一致优于现有方法，mIoU最高提升2.8%，并生成更精确的物体边界分割。MABL可灵活集成到多种现有分割架构中并稳定提升性能，验证了其鲁棒性和广泛适用性。

Conclusion: 通过引入边界感知的损失函数与融合长程/局部信息的框架设计，结合更具多样性的数据集，为遥感语义分割提供了一种有效且通用的改进方案，在边界精度和整体分割性能上均取得了显著提升。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation is a core computer vision task in the remote sensing field, accelerating advancements in ur- ban development, agriculture, ecology, water resources, and environmental monitoring. However, recent methods usually struggle to capture fine-grained object features and bound- ary details. Besides, current widely used datasets often lack city morphology diversity and segmentation on generative im- ages remains largely unexplored. To address these issues, we propose a Mahalanobis-Angle Boundary Loss (MABL) that explicitly enhances boundary and shape consistency. MABL jointly models structural importance and boundary orientation through Mahalanobis distance-based weighting and angle- aware penalty. It can be readily integrated into diverse seg- mentation architectures and consistently improves their accu- racy. Built upon MABL, we introduce BASeg, a boundary- aware remote sensing segmentation framework with Struc- tural Penalties. BASeg integrates a Global Visual State Space module (GSM) with a Cross-Feature Fusion module (CFM) to capture both long-range contextual dependencies and fine- grained local details. Additionally, we establish a global 10- city benchmark dataset (GCD-25k) to facilitate accurate build- ing and road segmentation. Extensive experiments on four remote-sensing benchmarks demonstrate that BASeg consis- tently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to a 2.8% improvement in mIoU while producing more accurate object boundary segmentation across diverse scenes. Moreover, integrating MABL into multiple existing segmentation archi- tectures consistently improves performance across datasets, demonstrating its robustness and broad applicability.

</details>


### [107] [Counterfactual Sensitivity Is Not Repairability: Auditing Replay Probes for Video Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15685)
*Rama AlHamidi,Rasul Khanbayov,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CARVE是一种黑盒反事实探针，用于测试工具使用视频智能体是否真正依赖检索到的视觉证据。通过匹配的SHAM和DESTROY重放对比答案变化，发现DESTROY比SHAM多改变答案29.3个百分点，并可作为路由信号提升准确率3.26点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用视频智能体虽然会检索视觉证据，但最终答案并不强制依赖检索内容。作者希望能验证智能体是否真正"使用"了检索到的证据，而不是仅仅进行检索这一动作。

Method: 提出CARVE，一种黑盒反事实探针。核心方法是：(1) 摧毁智能体检索到的帧的语义内容（DESTROY）；(2) 在同一帧上重执行相同流水线作为匹配对照（SHAM）；(3) 比较两种情况下答案变化的差异，以此判断智能体是否真实依赖检索证据。使用独立的k次重放（k=3和k=10）来评估稳定性。

Result: 在冻结的VideoExplorer风格智能体上，k=3时DESTROY比SHAM多改变答案29.3个百分点，聚合效应显著且可复现。CARVE在LVBench的1,258个问题中筛选出538个问题，提升准确率3.26点，优于多数随机子集。问题级别分数稳定性较低，k增大虽减少平局但削弱路由策略。

Conclusion: CARVE分数与标注的时间覆盖度仅有弱关联，因此它更适合作为路由信号（决定哪些问题需要检索）而非直接的基础事实（grounding）分类器。实现已开源。

Abstract: Tool-using video agents retrieve visual evidence before answering, but the final answer is not forced to depend on what was retrieved. The natural black box test is counterfactual: destroy the semantic content of the frames the agent retrieved and check whether the answer changes, against a matched sham that re-executes the identical pipeline on those same frames. We introduce CARVE, a black-box counterfactual probe that compares answer changes under matched SHAM and DESTROY replays. Across three independent k=3 runs on a frozen VideoExplorer-style agent, DESTROY changes the answer 29.3 percentage points more often than SHAM, yielding a large and reproducible aggregate effect. Question-level scores are less stable, and increasing the replay budget from k=3 to k=10 reduces ties but weakens the original zero-threshold routing policy. At k=3, CARVE selects 538 of 1,258 LVBench questions and improves accuracy by 3.26 points, with higher fallback yield than most matched random subsets. The score shows only a weak association with annotated temporal coverage, so CARVE is best understood as a routing signal rather than a direct grounding classifier. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/CARVE.

</details>


### [108] [Training-Free Long-Term Multi-Object Tracking for Sports Video Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15688)
*Tomasz Stanczyk,Seongro Yoon,Francois Bremond*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: McByte++是一个无需训练的跟踪-by-检测框架，通过轻量级掩码传播、条件相机运动补偿和在线重识别，在提升运行时效率的同时显著增强了身份保持能力，在SoccerNet-tracking和SportsMOT基准上相比原版McByte实现了最高+3.0 HOTA和+6.1 IDF1的提升，并获得了数量级的速度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体育场景中的长期多目标跟踪面临频繁遮挡、快速相机运动以及球员反复重现等严峻挑战，现有方法在这些场景下表现不佳，需要更高效且能保持身份一致性的解决方案。

Method: McByte++采用统一的无需训练跟踪-by-检测框架，核心包含三个模块：轻量级掩码传播（替代重型分割组件）、条件相机运动补偿（优化运动建模）以及在线重识别（增强身份保持），三者协同工作于同一流水线中。

Result: 在SoccerNet-tracking和SportsMOT基准上，在线设置下较原版McByte实现最高+3.0 HOTA和+6.1 IDF1的提升；结合离线全局关联可进一步提升；通过替换重型分割组件和优化运动建模，速度提升高达一个数量级。

Conclusion: McByte++证明了通过轻量化组件替换和针对性优化，可以在无需检测器重训练或数据集特定调参的情况下，同时实现跟踪精度和速度的显著提升，为体育场景长期多目标跟踪提供了高效且实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Long-term multi-object tracking in sports remains challenging due to frequent occlusions, rapid camera motion, and repeated player reappearances. We introduce McByte++, a training-free tracking-by-detection framework that integrates lightweight mask propagation, conditional camera motion compensation, and online re-identification within a unified pipeline. Compared to its predecessor, McByte++ substantially improves runtime efficiency while enhancing identity preservation. On SoccerNet-tracking and SportsMOT benchmarks, McByte++ achieves up to +3.0 HOTA and +6.1 IDF1 improvements over the original McByte in the online setting, with further gains when combined with offline global association. Replacing heavy segmentation components and optimizing motion modeling yields up to an order-of-magnitude speed increase. All results are obtained without detector retraining or dataset-specific tuning. Code will be made available at https://github.com/tstanczyk95/McBytePlusPlus.

</details>


### [109] [Automated Fetal Brain MRI Biometry in Healthy and Pathological Cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15692)
*Ema Masterl,Tina Vipotnik Vesnaver,Nejc Šubič,Žiga Špiclin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建并评估了一个自动化胎儿脑MRI生物计量分析流程，该流程在NeSVoR重建的3D体积上定位22个解剖标志点并推导出11项临床相关测量指标。在122个采集（涵盖健康对照和多种病理）的异质性队列中，H3DE-Net在标志点定位误差上显著优于SCN（均值1.36 mm vs 3.58 mm在健康组，1.90 mm vs 4.13 mm在病理组，p<0.001），并在11项测量中7项优于基于GA的回归基线，且在所有诊断组的分类AUC上表现更佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的胎儿脑MRI自动化生物计量分析方法通常局限于少数测量指标或仅在健康案例上评估，缺乏在异质性病理队列上的系统性验证，因此需要一种能够在多样临床场景中可靠工作的自动化分析流程。

Method: 组装自动化生物计量分析流程：在NeSVoR重建的3D体积上定位22个解剖标志点，推导11项涵盖幕上、脑室、小脑和中线结构的临床测量。比较两种标志点定位模型（H3DE-Net和SCN），使用线性混合效应模型评估定位精度，用校准百分位图评估与正常生长轨迹的一致性，并用决策树对VM严重度进行分类。

Result: H3DE-Net在所有标志点上定位误差显著低于SCN（健康组1.36 mm vs 3.58 mm，病理组1.90 mm vs 4.13 mm，p<0.001）；在11项测量中7项优于GA回归基线；所有诊断组的分类AUC均更高，在区分健康对照与VM时优势最明显；脑室宽度决策树阈值接近临床10 mm和15 mm的VM定义和分级截断值。

Conclusion: H3DE-Net驱动的自动化生物计量分析流程在异质性胎儿队列中展现出卓越的定位精度和临床测量可靠性，其脑室宽度阈值与临床标准一致，验证了该流程在胎儿脑MRI定量评估中的诊断效用和临床转化潜力。

Abstract: Automated biometric analysis of fetal brain MRI enables reproducible, observer-independent quantitative assessment, yet existing methods are often restricted to few measurements or evaluated only on healthy cases. We assemble and evaluate an automated biometric analysis pipeline that localizes 22 anatomical landmarks on NeSVoR-reconstructed 3D volumes and derives 11 clinically relevant measurements spanning supratentorial, ventricular, cerebellar, and midline structures. We compare two landmark localization models, H3DE-Net and SCN, on a heterogeneous cohort of 122 acquisitions (both healthy controls and range pathologies). Localization accuracy was assessed with a linear mixed-effects model, agreement with normative growth trajectories with calibrated centile charts, and diagnostic utility with a decision tree classifying VM severity. H3DE-Net achieved significantly lower localization error than SCN across all landmarks (mean 1.36 mm vs. 3.58 mm in HC and 1.90 mm vs. 4.13 mm in PC; p < 0.001), and outperformed a GA-based regression baseline in 7 of 11 measurements. H3DE-Net measurements yielded higher classification AUC in every diagnostic group, with the clearest advantage in separating healthy controls from VM. Decision tree thresholds for ventricular width fell near the clinical 10 mm and 15 mm cut-offs used to define and grade VM.

</details>


### [110] [RRFC: Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning for Iterative Image-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15694)
*Kareem Hassani,Chaymaa Abbas,Hadi Al Mubasher,Mariette Awad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RRFC（递归精化反馈条件框架），通过将模型上一次的预测作为额外通道反馈回生成器，使其能够迭代地改进自身输出，无需重新设计生成器架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的条件图像到图像生成器是单次前向的，输出后无法再改进；作者认为如果模型能够自适应地基于自身先前输出进行迭代修正，仍有提升空间。

Method: RRFC框架将生成器最近的预测作为辅助通道与原始输入一起反馈回模型，修改条件输入接口及相应训练/推理流程，可附加到现有生成器而无需重构。在六种基线（对抗、均衡、扩散模型）和三个配对图像翻译任务上共18个架构-任务组合中进行评估。

Result: 18个设置中，7个经Holm校正的显著提升，7个显著退化，4个无显著变化。提升集中在重建保真度和身份保持任务，7个退化中有5个出现在语义布局任务上。

Conclusion: 反馈式精化在目标与评估属性重叠时有效，增益集中在任务目标与评估指标一致的任务上；语义布局任务中所有模型均退化，表明该任务不适合此方法。

Abstract: Conditional image-to-image generators are single-shot: they map input features to an output in one forward pass and treat it as final, with no opportunity to improve on it. Although trained to produce the best possible result in one step, such a model leaves room for improvement if it can adaptively revise its own output over iterations. We propose Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning (RRFC), a novel feedback-conditioning framework for iterative output refinement that teaches a model to adaptively revise its output by conditioning on a new signal, namely its most recent previous prediction, which is fed back as an auxiliary set of channels alongside the original input. This preserves the generator's core architecture while modifying its conditioning interface and, depending on the model family, its training or inference procedure, so RRFC can be attached to existing generators without redesign. We evaluate RRFC across six baselines spanning adversarial, equilibrium, and diffusion-based models and three paired image-to-image translation tasks. Across 18 architecture-task settings, RRFC yields seven Holm-corrected improvements, seven degradations, and four non-significant changes. The gains concentrate on reconstruction-fidelity and identity settings, while five of the seven degradations fall on the single semantic-layout task, where every model declines. These results indicate that feedback-based refinement helps when its objective overlaps with the evaluated property, and that its gains concentrate on the tasks where that overlap holds.

</details>


### [111] [Bitstream Action Recognition is Byte Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15695)
*Fangcheng Li,Chaoran Huang,Tianyi Liu,Wenyang Liu,Kejun Wu,Qiong Liu,You Yang,Zhengguo Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BRACE框架，用于比特流动作识别（BAR），在比特流损坏时无需解码即可进行鲁棒的动作识别。BRACE采用双分支字节建模架构，通过Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment（IARA）将损坏比特流表示对齐到完好表示，并引入Unreliable-Anchor Suppression（UAS）抑制不可靠锚点。同时提出Real-world Bitstream Corruption Simulator（RBCS）模拟真实世界比特流损坏，构建了首个大规模BAR数据集（BAR-D），并在14种方法上进行了基准测试，实验证明BRACE具有优越的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统动作识别依赖比特流的成功像素解码，但比特流在存储或传输过程中可能损坏，导致视觉伪影甚至解码失败，严重影响动作识别的可靠性。因此需要克服对解码的依赖和对损坏的脆弱性，直接在损坏的比特流上进行动作识别。

Method: 提出BRACE框架：1）双分支字节建模架构，将损坏比特流与完好比特流视为同一动作的两种字节实现；2）Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment（IARA），在嵌入和决策层面将损坏表示对齐到完好锚点；3）Unreliable-Anchor Suppression（UAS）抑制不可靠锚点的影响；4）Real-world Bitstream Corruption Simulator（RBCS）四参数模拟器，复现传输和存储中的比特翻转和字节丢失错误；5）构建首个大规模BAR数据集（BAR-D）。

Result: 在BAR-D数据集上对14种来自像素域、压缩域和比特流域的方法进行基准测试，BRACE在比特流损坏下表现出优于所有对比方法的鲁棒性。消融实验验证了RBCS数据增强和IARA的有效性。

Conclusion: BRACE通过纯表示空间的对齐策略，在不修复比特流的情况下实现了对比特流损坏的鲁棒动作识别。RBCS模拟器和BAR-D数据集的构建填补了比特流动作识别领域数据稀缺的空白，为该领域的后续研究提供了基础设施和基准。

Abstract: Conventional action recognition typically relies on successful pixel decoding of the bitstream. However, bitstream corruption during storage or transmission may cause severe visual artifacts or even decoding failure, posing a significant challenge to reliable action recognition. Bitstream Action Recognition (BAR) aims to overcome the dependency on decoding and the vulnerability to corruption. In this paper, we propose a novel BAR framework, Bitstream Recognition via Anchoring Corrupted Embeddings (BRACE). BRACE is a dual-branch byte-modeling architecture that treats a corrupted bitstream and its intact counterpart as two byte realizations of the same action. This guides the generation of rich and stable representations for robustness to corruption through Intact-Anchored Representation Alignment (IARA). The intact representation serves as a stable anchor, and the corrupted one is aligned to it at the embedding and decision levels under Unreliable-Anchor Suppression (UAS), entirely in representation space and without repairing the bitstream. To address the scarcity of corrupted bitstreams in practice, we introduce the Real-world Bitstream Corruption Simulator (RBCS), a four-parameter simulator that reproduces bit-flip and byte-loss errors arising in transmission and storage. Building on RBCS, we construct the first large-scale BAR dataset (BAR-D), which comprises the BAR-Stanford40 and BAR-PPMI subsets and spans diverse corruption types and severity levels. Finally, we build a large benchmark on BAR-D involving 14 action recognition methods from the pixel, compressed, and bitstream domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BRACE has superior robustness to bitstream corruption than all comparison methods. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed RBCS augmentation and IARA.

</details>


### [112] [ConceptFormer: Learning Adaptive Latent Concepts for Query-Document Alignment in Visual Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15698)
*Peng Chunyi,Xu Zhipeng,Yan Yukun,Liu Zhenghao,Yu Shi,Mei Sen,Sun Yubo,Zhang Yongheng,Zhou Jie,Gu Yu,Yu Ge,Sun Maosong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ConceptFormer，一种用于视觉文档检索的潜在概念表示学习框架。它通过连续、查询条件下的潜在概念token来桥接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，无需文本中间表示或原始视觉标注。在多个基准上，相比最强视觉检索基线和OCR文本检索基线，平均NDCG@10分别提升16.7%和22.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉文档检索细粒度监督方法主要依赖文本描述或局部视觉区域作为证据代理，但这些信号可能忽略复杂的视觉结构，或提供不完整、不准确的证据表示，导致检索效果不佳。

Method: ConceptFormer将查询相关的证据建模为连续的、查询条件下的潜在概念，显式桥接局部视觉证据与语义相关性。训练时使用强大的视觉语言模型动态确定潜在概念token的数量，并将这些概念作为中间表示来弥合查询与文档之间的语义差距，引导嵌入空间的学习。

Result: 在多样化的视觉文档检索基准上，ConceptFormer相比最强视觉检索基线和最强OCR文本检索基线，平均NDCG@10分别实现16.7%和22.1%的相对提升。进一步分析显示潜在概念能有效连接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，同时捕获细粒度文本线索和复杂的文档级视觉结构。

Conclusion: ConceptFormer通过潜在概念表示学习有效解决了视觉文档检索中监督信号不完整的问题，在无需文本中间表示或原始视觉标注的情况下实现了显著的检索性能提升，并保持了强大的检索对齐能力。

Abstract: Visual document retrieval is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, aiming to identify query-relevant pages from document collections where evidence is distributed across text, layout, charts, and visual structures. Recent efforts toward finer-grained supervision primarily rely on textual descriptions or localized visual regions as evidence proxies. However, such supervision signals may either overlook complex visual structures or provide incomplete and inaccurate representations of the underlying evidence. To address these limitations, we propose ConceptFormer, a latent concept representation learning framework for visual document retrieval. ConceptFormer models query-relevant evidence as continuous, query-conditioned latent concepts that explicitly bridge localized visual evidence and semantic relevance, without requiring either textual intermediate representations or direct reliance on raw visual annotations. During training, ConceptFormer employs a strong vision-language model to dynamically determine the number of latent concept tokens and uses these concepts as an intermediate representation to bridge the semantic gap between queries and documents, thereby guiding the learning of the embedding space. Experiments on diverse visual document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that ConceptFormer achieves 16.7\% and 22.1\% relative improvements in average NDCG@10 over the strongest visual retrieval baseline and the strongest OCR-based text retrieval baseline, respectively. Further analysis reveals that latent concepts effectively connect localized visual evidence with semantic relevance, enabling the retriever to capture both fine-grained textual cues and complex document-level visual structures while preserving strong retrieval alignment. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/Neuir/ConceptFormer.

</details>


### [113] [PixelControl: Fine-Grained Condition Fidelity in Text-to-Image Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15705)
*Xin Lin,Haodong Li,Zhifei Zhang,Yutong Yang,Haitian Zheng,Juanxi Tian,Zhe Lin,Truong Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PixelControl，一种基于像素空间的受控扩散生成框架，用于改善细粒度条件保真度。它基于PixelDiT骨干架构避免潜在空间瓶颈，并通过结构感知控制注入（增强敏感区域控制残差）和多尺度金字塔循环损失（多分辨率验证生成图像）两个互补设计，在深度、分割和边缘控制任务上显著提升结构保真度与视觉质量，尤其在边界和中小尺度条件区域表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可控文本到图像扩散模型虽然能大致遵循空间条件的全局布局，但在对象边界、细轮廓和中小尺寸条件区域等细粒度结构上仍存在违反。对于基于VAE的潜在扩散模型，空间压缩会削弱高频和低面积的条件信号，这一问题尤为严重。

Method: PixelControl基于PixelDiT风格骨干，规避潜在瓶颈。两种互补设计：1) 结构感知控制注入——推导条件结构图并增强空间敏感区域的控制残差；2) 多尺度金字塔循环损失——在多个分辨率上对生成图像与条件推导结构进行验证，平衡全局布局一致性与局部边界细节精度。通过模态特定控制分支和轻量门控融合支持深度、分割、边缘及其组合。

Result: 在深度、分割和边缘控制实验上，PixelControl相较于现有可控生成方法，在结构保真度和视觉质量上均有提升，尤其在边界和中小尺寸条件区域取得了显著增益。

Conclusion: PixelControl证明了像素空间可控扩散框架配合结构感知注入和多尺度循环损失，可以有效解决可控生成中细粒度结构保真度不足的问题，为高精度条件控制生成提供了新思路。

Abstract: Controllable text-to-image diffusion models can often follow the global layout of spatial conditions, yet still violate fine-grained structures such as object boundaries, thin contours, and medium/small conditioned regions. This limitation is especially problematic for VAE-based latent diffusion, where spatial compression can weaken high-frequency and low-area condition signals. We propose PixelControl, a pixel-space controllable diffusion framework for fine-grained condition fidelity. Built on a PixelDiT-style backbone, PixelControl avoids the latent bottleneck and introduces two complementary designs. First, Structure-Aware Control Injection derives a condition structure map and uses it to strengthen injected control residuals around spatially sensitive regions. Second, Multi-Scale Pyramid Cycle Loss verifies generated images against condition-derived structures across multiple resolutions, balancing global layout consistency with local boundary and detail accuracy. PixelControl supports depth, segmentation, edge, and their combinations through modality-specific control branches with lightweight gated fusion. Experiments across depth, segmentation, and edge control show that PixelControl improves structural fidelity and visual quality over existing controllable generation methods, with especially strong gains on boundaries and medium/small conditioned regions. The project page can be found at: https://linxin0.github.io/pixelcontrol_homepage/pixelcontrol-site/

</details>


### [114] [What You Ask is What You Ground: Bridging Question Intent to Temporal Evidence for Grounded VideoQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15708)
*Jinhwan Seo,Kyubeom Han,Jumin Lee,Junhyug Noh,Sung-eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了接地视频问答(Grounded VideoQA)中一个被忽视的失败模式："问题不变接地"（即模型对不同问题预测出几乎相同的时间片段）。作者提出GroundFormer，通过可学习的通信令牌在定位前用问题意图调节视频特征，并结合因子化MIL交叉注意力、高斯平滑和层次化多模态对比损失，在NExT-GQA和STAR上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Grounded VideoQA模型存在"问题不变接地"问题，即对同一视频的不同问题预测几乎相同的时间段，根源在于两个结构缺陷：(i)模态隔离——视频表示在接收问题语义前就被固定；(ii)接地模块内问题注入过弱，导致模型无法区分不同问题对应的不同时间证据。

Method: 提出GroundFormer，包含三个关键组件：1) 通过可学习通信令牌介导有向的视觉-语言交互，在定位前用问题意图调节视频特征；2) 因子化MIL交叉注意力，在候选级监督下将答案选择与时间证据耦合；3) 高斯平滑将峰值注意力转换为时间上连贯的片段。此外引入层次化多模态对比损失，配合两阶段训练流程对齐视频、问题和答案嵌入。

Result: GroundFormer在NExT-GQA和STAR基准上达到最先进的接地VideoQA性能，显著提升了问题判别性的时间接地能力，即对不同问题能产生更有区分度的定位结果。

Conclusion: 通过解决模态隔离和弱问题注入这两个结构缺陷，GroundFormer有效克服了"问题不变接地"失败模式，证明了在定位前用问题意图调节视频特征、并通过对比学习和候选级监督增强问题-时间证据关联的有效性。

Abstract: We study a critical yet overlooked failure mode in Grounded Video Question Answering: question-invariant grounding, where models predict nearly identical temporal segments for different questions about the same video. We trace this behavior to two structural limitations in prior common designs: (i) modality isolation that fixes video representations before they receive question semantics, and (ii) weak question injection inside the grounding module. To address this, we propose GroundFormer, which conditions video features on question intent before localization via learnable communication tokens that mediate directed visuo-lingual interaction. On top of the question-conditioned features, a factorized MIL cross-attention couples answer selection with temporal evidence under candidate-level supervision, while Gaussian smoothing converts peaked attention into temporally coherent segments. We further introduce a hierarchical multi-modal contrastive loss that aligns video, question, and answer embeddings across a two-pass training pipeline. GroundFormer achieves state-of-the-art grounded VideoQA performance on NExT-GQA and STAR, substantially improving question-discriminative temporal grounding.

</details>


### [115] [Beyond Single Object: Learning 3D Relations with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15710)
*Kohsuke Ide,Ryousuke Yamada,Yue Qiu,Xianzheng Ma,Yoshihiro Fukuhara,Hirokatsu Kataoka,Yutaka Satoh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向多物体3D细粒度推理的框架，包含MO3D指令数据集、Multi-3DLLM模型（采用最小化补丁交互Transformer）以及两个应用驱动的基准（Shape Mating和Change Captioning），解决了现有3D-LLM缺乏跨物体比较和几何推理能力的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D-LLM主要聚焦于单物体或单场景描述，缺乏对多个物体之间细粒度、关系型比较的能力，这是3D视觉语言模型中的一个关键空白。
