Method: 提出三组件框架：(1) MO3D指令数据集，要求细粒度的多物体比较；(2) Multi-3DLLM，采用最小化补丁交互Transformer（PIT）建模物体间/物体内关系，同时保持局部几何信息；(3) Mini-apps，包含Shape Mating和Change Captioning两个应用驱动的基准来测试几何理解能力。

Result: Multi-3DLLM在MO3D数据集上超越所有基线方法，并能正向迁移到单物体分类任务；相比之下，现有3D-LLM和2D-VLM在这些任务上表现较差，缺乏比较中心设计和几何感知能力。

Conclusion: 通过将比较中心设计与几何感知结合，Multi-3DLLM展示了多物体3D推理的可行性，并证明了此类训练对单物体任务也有正向迁移效果。

Abstract: We address a fundamental gap in 3D-LLMs: existing models focus on single-object/scene description, struggling with detailed, inter-object comparison. We propose a framework for detailed object-level reasoning across multiple objects with three components: (1) MO3D (Multi-Object in 3D), an instruction dataset requiring fine-grained multi-object comparison; (2) Multi-3DLLM, using a minimal Patch-Interaction Transformer (PIT) that models inter-/intra-object relationships while preserving local geometry; (3) Mini-apps, two application-driven benchmarks (Shape Mating, Change Captioning) that probe geometric understanding for practical use. Recent 3D-LLMs and 2D-VLMs perform poorly on these tasks, lacking both comparison-centric design and geometric awareness. In contrast, Multi-3DLLM trained on our mixture data learns geometric reasoning, surpasses all baselines on MO3D, and provides positive transfer to single-object classification.

</details>


### [116] [YOLO26-RD: An End-to-End Road Damage Detection Network With Learnable Contrast Enhancement and Edge-Guided Downsampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15713)
*Sompote Youwai,Pawarotorn Chaipetch,Hathairat Samaikul,Theerayut Yonseng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出YOLO26-RD，一个基于YOLO26的无NMS端到端路面病害检测器，包含两个轻量级模块（LearnableContrast和EdgeSPD）。通过数据优先审计发现路面病害并非小目标问题（92%为COCO-large），据此精简P2检测头而保留其特征融合，提升mAP50达2.8点并减少8%训练时间，最终达到0.787 mAP50。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路面病害检测常被视为小目标问题，导致采用高分辨率P2/4检测头和保损降采样。作者希望通过数据驱动的审计验证这一前提的真实性，并挑战'模块堆砌'的惯例做法，主张以测量驱动的减法替代模块累积。

Method: 构建YOLO26-RD（含LearnableContrast：494参数的CLAHE可微模拟；EdgeSPD：基于Sobel门控的space-to-depth降采样）。在7,618张路面图像的审计数据集中，首先进行数据优先审计（实例尺寸分布、长宽比、失败模式分解），据此移除P2检测层但保留P2特征融合路径，最后从零训练并对比多个基线。

Result: 审计推翻了小目标前提：92%实例属于COCO-large，线性裂缝为中位10:1的极端宽高比结构。精简P2检测头使mAP50提升2.8点并减少8%训练时间。最佳配置达0.787 mAP50（基线0.771），最稀有类别patching提升最显著（较基线2.6点，较未修改的YOLO26-RD对照组9.4点）。瓶颈类（crack）残余误差归因于训练/验证分布偏移、亚像素裂缝宽度和标签不完整性。

Conclusion: 路面影像检测中，测量驱动的模型减法优于模块累积。作者发布了审计协议和模型，证明通过数据优先分析可以更有效地指导架构设计决策。

Abstract: Automated pavement-distress detection is commonly framed as a small-object problem, motivating high-resolution P2/4 detection heads and lossless downsampling. We present YOLO26-RD, an end-to-end (NMS-free) detector built on YOLO26 with two lightweight novel modules (LearnableContrast, a 494-parameter differentiable analogue of CLAHE that adapts contrast per tile inside the network, and EdgeSPD, a Sobel-gated space-to-depth downsampler adding only 2 parameters over SPD-Conv), and we subject the design to a data-first audit on a 7,618-image road-survey dataset (alligator crack, linear crack, patching). The audit falsifies the small-object premise: 92% of instances are COCO-large, and linear cracks are extreme-aspect structures (median 10:1) whose difficulty is sensitivity, not localization. Guided by this analysis, we remove the P2 detection level while retaining P2 features in the fusion path, which improves mAP50 by 2.8 points over the full YOLO26-RD model and reduces epoch time by 8%. Trained from scratch at 640x640, our best screening configuration reaches 0.787 mAP50 on the validation split versus a 0.771 project baseline (a stock YOLO26-s of uncontrolled recipe), with the largest per-class gain on the rarest class (patching, 2.6 points over baseline; 9.4 over the unmodified YOLO26-RD control under an identical recipe). A failure-mode decomposition further attributes the residual error of the bottleneck class (crack, approximately 0.74 across all architectures tested) to train/validation distribution shift on crack orientation and length, sub-pixel crack width at 640x640, and label incompleteness, factors no architecture change can address. We argue that for pavement imagery, measurement-driven subtraction outperforms module accretion, and we release our audit protocol alongside the model.

</details>


### [117] [Anatomical and Physical Supervision for CT-less PET Attenuation Correction: BIC-MAC 2026 Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15721)
*Petros Chatzitoulousis,George K. Matsopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了BIC-MAC 2026挑战赛的CT-less PET衰减校正方案，基于nnU-Net架构，结合解剖监督（TotalSegmentator特征提取器）和物理监督（可微分衰减校正因子投影损失），并利用SynthRAD数据集的预训练权重初始化，实现了伪CT合成与PET重建性能的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT-less PET衰减校正需要高质量的伪CT合成，传统方法往往仅关注图像质量，忽视了解剖结构和衰减物理特性对下游PET重建的影响。作者希望通过引入解剖监督与物理监督，在保持nnU-Net高效架构的同时提升伪CT质量和PET重建精度。

Method: 1) 基于标准nnU-Net架构，最小化架构修改；2) 解剖监督：使用冻结的TotalSegmentator特征提取器，引入解剖引导的结构约束和补丁采样策略；3) 物理监督：基于多角度衰减投影的可微分衰减校正因子（ACF）投影损失；4) 预训练初始化：使用SynthRAD Challenge MR-to-CT数据集训练的权重进行网络初始化；5) 对整个nnU-Net流程（预处理、plans、监督设计等）进行优化。

Result: 最终提交方案证明了解剖监督、衰减物理与高效nnU-Net扩展相结合的有效性，在CT-less PET衰减校正任务上取得了良好的伪CT合成和PET重建性能。

Conclusion: 结合解剖监督、物理监督和nnU-Net高效扩展是CT-less PET衰减校正的有效策略，无需大幅修改架构即可通过多维度监督和预训练获得性能提升。

Abstract: This report describes our submission to the Big Cross-Modal Attenuation Correction (BIC-MAC) 2026 Challenge for CT-less PET attenuation correction through multimodal pseudo-CT synthesis. We build upon a standard nnU-Net architecture and combine anatomical and physical supervision to improve both pseudo-CT quality and downstream PET reconstruction. Anatomical supervision is introduced through a frozen TotalSegmentator feature extractor, anatomy-guided structural constraints and patch sampling, while physical supervision is achieved using a differentiable attenuation correction factor projection loss based on multi-angle attenuation projections. Furthermore, the network is initialized with pretrained weights obtained from training on the SynthRAD Challenge MR-to-CT dataset. Minimal architectural modifications are applied, while performance improvements are pursued across the nnU-Net pipeline, including preprocessing, plans, and supervision design, among other components. Our final submission demonstrates the effectiveness of combining anatomical supervision, attenuation physics, and efficient nnU-Net scaling for CT-less PET attenuation correction.

</details>


### [118] [Identifying Confusion Trends in Concept-based XAI for Multi-Label Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15731)
*Haadia Amjad,Ronald Tetzlaff*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在MS-COCO数据集上使用VGG16和ResNet50进行多标签分类，并应用CRP和CRAFT两种概念可解释AI方法生成概念级解释，发现CXAI能揭示DNN学习弱点、概念区分度与混淆的关系，以及数据集诱导的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险领域（如医疗、自动驾驶）中的深度神经网络不仅需要准确，还需要可理解以建立用户信任。现有CXAI方法在复杂图像和多标签分类场景中的适用性和问题解决能力尚未得到充分评估。

Method: 在MS-COCO数据集的20个最常用标注类别上训练VGG16和ResNet50两个深度神经网络，应用CRP（概念相关性传播）和CRAFT（概念递归激活因子分解）两种CXAI方法生成概念级解释，并评估其整体表现。

Result: 三个关键发现：(1) CXAI揭示了DNN的学习弱点；(2)更高的概念区分度可减少标签和概念混淆；(3)环境概念暴露了数据集诱导的偏差。结果表明CXAI有潜力增强对模型泛化能力的理解并诊断数据集引起的偏差。

Conclusion: CXAI不仅能提升模型的透明度，还能作为诊断工具来识别模型学习缺陷和数据集偏差，从而提升对模型泛化能力的理解，促进高风险场景下的用户信任。

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) deployed in high-risk domains, such as healthcare and autonomous driving, must be not only accurate but also understandable to ensure user trust. In real-world computer vision tasks, these models often operate on complex images containing background noise and are heavily annotated. To make such models explainable, Concept-based Explainable AI (CXAI) methods need to be assessed for their applicability and problem-solving capacity. In this work, we explore CXAI use cases in multi-label classification by training two DNNs, VGG16 and ResNet50, on the 20 most annotated labels in the MS-COCO dataset (Microsoft Common Objects in Context). We apply two CXAI methods, CRP (Concept Relevance Propagation) and CRAFT (Concept Recursive Activation FacTorization), to generate concept-level explanations and investigate the overall evaluations. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) CXAI highlights learning weaknesses in DNNs, (2) higher concept distinctiveness reduces label and concept confusion, and (3) environmental concepts expose dataset-induced biases. Our results demonstrate the potential of CXAI to enhance the understanding of model generalizability and to diagnose bias instigated by the dataset.

</details>


### [119] [ES3D: Embedding Semantics into 3D Space for Component-Aware Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15749)
*Xuancheng Jin,Rengan Xie,Jiayuan Lu,Wenting Zheng,Rui Wang,Yuchi Huo,Lincheng Li,Yingfeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ES3D是一个将语义直接嵌入3D空间的编辑框架，支持基于多张局部参考图像和可选文本查询的组件感知检索与编辑，通过3D语义嵌入构建、特征相似度计算检索以及预训练3D生成模型修复机制，实现几何一致且语义连贯的3D编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D编辑方法主要依赖文本驱动，难以表达用户期望的细粒度视觉变化；同时许多方法需要手动提供3D掩码，或会意外修改不应改变的区域。这些限制源于缺乏细粒度语义理解，难以检索或修改特定的3D组件。

Method: ES3D首先通过将多视角语义特征投影到资产的体素化空间来构建3D语义嵌入；然后通过计算3D语义嵌入与图像或文本查询语义嵌入之间的特征相似度进行3D组件检索；最后使用带有修复机制的预训练3D生成模型，在用户提供图像的引导下修改检索到的组件，同时保留资产的其他部分。

Result: 大量实验表明ES3D能够产生几何一致且语义连贯的编辑，实现对3D编辑的稳健图像驱动和文本辅助控制。

Conclusion: ES3D是一种基于语义线索检索可编辑区域并以多图像为条件的3D编辑框架，有效克服了现有方法在细粒度语义理解和精确组件编辑方面的不足。

Abstract: Existing 3D editing methods have made notable progress in controllability, yet they remain limited in several important ways. Most approaches rely on text-driven editing, which struggles to express fine-grained visual changes intended by the user. Moreover, many methods require manually supplied 3D masks or introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain untouched. These limitations largely arise from the absence of fine-grained semantic understanding, making it difficult for existing models to retrieve or modify specific 3D components.
  We introduce ES3D, a framework that embeds semantics directly into 3D space, enabling component-aware retrieval and editing of a 3D asset conditioned on multiple local reference images and optional text queries. We first construct a 3D semantic embedding by projecting multi-view semantic features into the voxelized space of the asset. We then perform 3D component retrieval by computing feature similarity between the 3D semantic embedding and the semantic embeddings of image or text queries. For editing, we employ a pretrained 3D generative model with an inpainting mechanism to modify the retrieved components guided by user-provided images while preserving the rest of the asset. Overall, ES3D is a 3D editing framework that retrieves editable regions based on semantic cues and uses multiple images as conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ES3D produces geometrically consistent and semantically coherent edits, enabling robust image-based and text-assisted control for 3D editing.

</details>


### [120] [Beyond Independence: Learning Correlated Views for Variational Incomplete Multi-View Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15757)
*Zheming Xu,Aiyue Tang,Shidi Chen,Xuechao Zou,Congyan Lang,Rogelio A. Mancisidor,Michael Kampffmeyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种超越条件独立性假设的变分不完全多视图聚类（IMVC）框架，通过学习视图间协方差结构（基于后验估计误差的协方差矩阵，经归一化Cholesky分解参数化）来显式建模跨视图相关性，在多个基准数据集上以极少的额外参数超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于变分推断的免插补IMVC方法在后验聚合阶段普遍采用跨视图条件独立性假设，这一假设无法捕捉多视图数据内在的结构化与相关性，限制了聚类性能的上限。

Method: 提出一个变分框架，显式建模并学习视图间相关性。具体地，利用后验估计误差的协方差结构在聚合阶段建模视图相关性；相关性矩阵通过归一化Cholesky分解参数化，保证正定性；整个模型通过统一的变分目标联合训练。

Result: 在多个IMVC基准数据集和多种缺失视图设置下，该方法一致性地优于现有最先进方法，且仅引入极少量（可忽略的）可学习参数。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明自适应相关性建模在变分IMVC中的有效性，证明了在IMVC中超越独立性假设的必要性。

Abstract: Incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) aims to uncover shared cluster structures from data with partially observed views. Although recent imputation-free methods based on variational inference demonstrate robustness to missing views, they commonly rely on a conditional independence assumption across views in the posterior aggregation stage, which fails to capture the inherently structured and potentially correlated nature of multi-view data. In this paper, we propose a variational framework that explicitly goes beyond this assumption by introducing a learnable cross-view correlation structure. Specifically, we explicitly model and learn correlations between views by utilizing the covariance structure of posterior estimation errors during aggregation. To facilitate robust and efficient learning, the correlation matrix is parameterized through a normalized Cholesky decomposition, ensuring positive definiteness and enabling the entire model to be trained jointly through a unified variational objective. Extensive experiments on multiple IMVC benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse missing-view settings while introducing only a negligible number of learnable parameters. These results highlight the effectiveness of adaptive correlation modeling in variational IMVC, demonstrating the need to go beyond the independence assumption in IMVC. The code is available at https://github.com/zmxu196/ACOVA.

</details>


### [121] [RoofGS: Roofline-Guided End-to-End Acceleration of 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15785)
*Yang Luo,Yan Gong,Yongsheng Gao,Jie Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RoofGS是一个基于Roofline模型分析的3D Gaussian Splatting渲染框架，通过识别前端内存带宽瓶颈和后端指令吞吐瓶颈，分别设计针对性的优化策略，在RTX 4090上实现4K分辨率下10.1倍的端到端加速（61→616 FPS），仅损失0.028 dB PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS虽然能实现实时新视角合成，但在高分辨率GPU上性能受限。现有优化方法通常采用通用内核加速，未针对不同阶段的具体硬件瓶颈进行特异性优化，导致优化效果有限。

Method: 首先通过分阶段Roofline分析识别两个硬件瓶颈：前端的全局内存流量瓶颈和光栅化的指令吞吐瓶颈。针对内存受限的前端，设计分辨率自适应的量化深度排序键（压缩至32位）；针对计算受限的光栅化器，引入基于范围感知的位级快速指数近似（利用不透明度剔除后的有界指数范围，并推导逐像素误差界）。此外辅以内核融合、紧凑属性存储、裁剪和双像素评估等优化。

Result: 在RTX 4090上于4K分辨率下实现10.1倍的端到端加速，吞吐量从61提升至616 FPS，PSNR仅损失0.028 dB。

Conclusion: 通过Roofline驱动的瓶颈特异性优化而非通用内核加速，可以显著提升3DGS在高分辨率GPU上的渲染性能，同时保持较高的图像质量。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel-view synthesis but remains limited on GPUs at high resolutions. Through a stage-wise Roofline characterization, we identify two distinct hardware bottlenecks: global memory traffic dominates the front end, whereas instruction throughput limits rasterization. Guided by this analysis, we develop RoofGS, a rendering framework that applies bottleneck-specific optimizations rather than generic kernel acceleration. For the memory-bound front end, we design a resolution-adaptive quantized depth sorting key that compresses each key to 32 bits. For the compute-bound rasterizer, we introduce a range-aware bit-level fast exponential approximation tailored to the bounded exponent range after opacity culling, with a derived per-pixel error bound. These two core techniques are complemented by additional optimizations (kernel fusion, compact attribute storage, culling, dual-pixel evaluation) that additionally reduce memory traffic and improve instruction-level parallelism. Experiments show that RoofGS achieves a 10.1$\times$ end-to-end speedup over 3DGS at 4K on an RTX 4090, increasing throughput from 61 to 616 FPS, with only a 0.028 dB PSNR loss.

</details>


### [122] [ChainSpace: A Chained-Reasoning Paradigm for Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15788)
*Xiaohan Zhang,Feng Gu,Xudong Rao,Xuhao Pan,Tao Wei,Zhou Pan,Kun Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ChainSpace，一种链式推理范式，将空间推理组织为状态保持的多轮过程，使后续问题依赖前面建立的空间约束。作者构建了ChainSpace-Bench（人工标注的多轮基准及链感知评估指标）和ChainSpace-Pipeline（基于模拟器的链式监督生成框架），实验表明该范式能暴露单轮问答无法捕捉的链级失败，并以少量链式数据实现高数据效率的训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间智能的数据驱动方法将空间推理视为独立的问答实例，这导致模型可以通过捷径（shortcut）回答问题，且缺乏对持续空间理解的监督信号。这种范式无法支撑基础模型与物理世界交互时所需的连贯空间状态维护能力。

Method: 提出链式推理范式ChainSpace：(1) 将空间问题组织为逻辑约束且联合一致的链，后续问题依赖前期建立的空间约束；(2) 实例化ChainSpace-Bench人工标注真实世界多轮基准，配套Chain-Aware Metric链感知指标；(3) 构建ChainSpace-Pipeline，基于模拟器生成链式结构化监督数据用于模型训练。

Result: ChainSpace-Bench能暴露孤立问题准确率无法捕捉的链级失败；使用少量模拟器生成的链式数据训练的模型在ChainSpace-Bench上达到开源模型最佳性能，并能竞争性地迁移到多个外部空间智能基准。

Conclusion: ChainSpace为空间智能提供了更忠实（faithful）的评估方式和更高数据效率的学习范式，证明链式推理是推动空间智能发展的有效途径。

Abstract: Spatial intelligence requires foundation models to maintain coherent spatial state across interactions with the physical world. However, existing data-centric approaches typically treat spatial reasoning as independent question-answer instances, enabling shortcut-based answering and providing limited supervision for persistent spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce ChainSpace, a chained-reasoning paradigm that structures spatial reasoning as a state-preserving multi-round process. In this paradigm, spatial questions are organized into logically constrained and jointly consistent chains, where later questions depend on spatial constraints established in earlier rounds. Following this principle, we instantiate ChainSpace-Bench, a manually annotated real-world multi-round benchmark with a Chain-Aware Metric, and ChainSpace-Pipeline, a simulator-based chain-structured supervision generation framework for spatial intelligence training. Experiments show that ChainSpace-Bench exposes chain-level failures that are not captured by isolated question accuracy. Additionally, with a relatively small amount of simulator-generated chained data, models trained by ChainSpace-Pipeline achieve the best performance among open-source models on ChainSpace-Bench and transfer competitively to multiple external spatial intelligence benchmarks. These results establish ChainSpace as an effective paradigm for more faithful evaluation and more data-efficient learning of spatial intelligence.

</details>


### [123] [Emergent 3D Instance Segmentation from Self-Supervised Point Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15796)
*Ted Lentsch,Santiago Montiel-Marín,Holger Caesar,Julian F. P. Kooij*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究冻结的自监督点云Transformer是否已包含3D实例分割所需的结构信息，无需任何手工几何先验。通过跨三个数据集的系统分析，发现实例信号集中在注意力查询和键中而非值或输出特征中，且主要由旋转位置编码驱动。基于此发现提出TokenGraph3D，一种无需训练的分割器，通过键相似性图的连通分量实现实例分组，在无先验条件下显著优于输出特征基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统无监督3D实例分割依赖密度聚类、运动线索或2D检测等手工几何先验，作者希望探究自监督点云Transformer是否已隐式编码了实例结构信息，从而摆脱对手工先验的依赖。

Method: (1) 使用冻结的自监督点云Transformer作为特征提取器，在SemanticKITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上系统探测其内部表示；(2) 分析注意力查询/键/值以及各编码器层的实例信号分布；(3) 基于分析发现，提出TokenGraph3D——通过键相似性图上的连通分量进行点分组，不使用密度聚类或邻近度先验。

Result: 发现四个核心洞察：实例信号集中在注意力查询和键中而非值或输出特征；输出特征出现语义坍缩，合并了相邻同类对象；实例信号在深度上呈双峰分布，最浅和最深的编码器阶段最强；该信号主要由旋转位置编码（RoPE）驱动，去除RoPE会消除其优势。TokenGraph3D在无先验条件下显著优于输出特征基线。

Conclusion: 冻结的自监督点云Transformer内部已蕴含可提取的3D实例结构信息，通过探测注意力键的相似性即可实现无先验的实例分割，揭示了利用预训练模型内部表示的潜在途径。

Abstract: Unsupervised 3D instance segmentation of outdoor LiDAR scans has traditionally relied on handcrafted geometric priors such as density-based clustering, motion cues, or projected 2D detections. In this work, we investigate whether a frozen, self-supervised point transformer already contains the structural information required to isolate object instances without any handcrafted geometric prior. Using this transformer purely as a feature extractor, we probe its internal representations across the SemanticKITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Perception datasets. Our analysis yields four core insights: (1) the instance signal concentrates in the attention queries and keys rather than in the values or final output features; (2) output features semantically collapse, merging adjacent same-class objects that the queries and keys keep distinct; (3) this instance signal is bimodal in depth, strongest at the shallowest and deepest encoder stages; and (4) this signal is driven predominantly by the rotary position encoding (RoPE), whose removal collapses its advantage. We put these findings into our method TokenGraph3D, a training-free segmenter that groups points via connected components on a key-similarity graph, using neither density-based clustering nor proximity priors. Under identical prior-free conditions, we substantially outperform output-feature baselines, making the emergent 3D instance structure visible.

</details>


### [124] [Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15869)
*Xiaoyu Zhu,Xinke Deng,Suresh Taddewadikar,Arnab Kumar Mondal,Zhongyu Jiang,Ian Fasel,Joerg Liebelt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT)框架，通过训练阶段联合优化文本预测和next-embedding预测，让多模态大模型在推理时无需生成中间图像即可完成视觉推理，相比显式Visual CoT在保持甚至提升性能的同时将端到端延迟降低5倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型使用Visual CoT进行空间、时间和具身环境的推理，虽然通过生成中间推理图像提供了直观的视觉预判机制，但引入了大量推理开销，尤其对主动视频推理问题尤为严重。作者质疑是否可以在训练时学习视觉思考，而在推理时直接推理。

Method: 提出IVT后训练框架，在无标签视频上联合优化文本预测和next-embedding预测。给定部分观察的视频，IVT预测未来帧的潜在表示以及目标文本答案，鼓励模型捕捉运动、物体转换、交互和潜在意图。推理时直接生成答案，无需合成或重新编码未来帧。进行了跨目标表示、解码器设计、预测范围、数据混合、训练课程和预测目标的受控研究。

Result: 在全部六个评估设置上，IVT均优于直接答案微调，同时保持相同推理路径。与显式Visual CoT相比，IVT达到相当或更优性能，并将平均端到端延迟降低超过5倍。

Conclusion: 推理时的显式像素空间生成（如Visual CoT所用）可能并非有效主动视频推理所必需。预测性世界建模可以在训练期间内化，从而产生既更准确又更高效的多模态推理器。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos. Given a partially observed video, IVT predicts latent representations of future frames together with the target textual answer, encouraging the model to capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent. At inference, IVT generates the answer directly without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames. We conduct controlled studies across target representations, decoder designs, prediction horizons, data mixtures, training curricula, and predictive objectives. IVT improves over direct-answer fine-tuning on all six evaluation settings while retaining the same inference pathway. Compared with explicit Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces average end-to-end latency by more than 5x. Together, our findings suggest that explicit pixel-space generation at inference time, as used in visual chain-of-thought, may not be necessary for effective proactive video reasoning. Predictive world modeling can be internalized during training to produce multimodal reasoners that are both more accurate and substantially more efficient.

</details>


### [125] [PWLR: Pairwise Witness Local Rejection for Boundary-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15802)
*Chengyao Jia,Ruixuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PWLR方法，利用多模态大语言模型离线生成区分困难ID类别的局部视觉线索描述，并通过冻结的视觉-语言骨干网络在仅ID数据上筛选可靠验证器，在推理时结合全局类别分数与成对局部证据进行校准，提升OOD检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OOD检测方法（尤其是视觉-语言检测器）虽然利用类别语义、局部提示或LLM生成的外类概念，但很少将语言作为区分混淆ID类别之间的显式边界证据，导致近OOD样本（接近ID类别边界）检测困难。

Method: 1) 离线阶段：使用MLLM生成描述"有利于某个ID类别对抗特定竞争类别"的可见局部线索短语；2) 筛选阶段：在冻结的视觉-语言骨干下用仅ID数据筛选可靠的局部验证器；3) 推理阶段：先保留少量全局可能类别，再检查这些类别是否在其最相关竞争者处获得局部支持，最后通过校准将成对局部证据与全局类别分数结合。

Result: 在ImageNet-100远OOD、干净/挑战性OOD和近OOD基准上，PWLR在多个骨干网络上持续提升强视觉-语言基线的OOD检测性能。

Conclusion: 语言可以作为区分混淆ID类别的显式边界证据，通过成对局部证据与全局评分的融合，能有效提升近OOD检测能力。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging for image classifiers, especially when near-OOD samples lie close to in-distribution (ID) class boundaries. Recent vision-language detectors improve OOD detection through class semantics, local prompting, or LLM-generated outlier concepts, but seldom use language as explicit boundary evidence between confusing ID classes. We propose Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR), which uses an MLLM offline to describe visible local cues that favor one ID class over a specific rival class. These cue phrases are then screened with ID-only data under a frozen vision-language backbone, so that only reliable local verifiers are kept. At inference, PWLR first retains a small set of globally plausible classes, then checks whether any of them is locally supported against its most relevant rivals, and finally combines this pairwise local evidence with the global class score through calibration. Experiments on ImageNet-100 far-OOD, cleaner/challenging OOD and near-OOD benchmarks show that PWLR consistently improves strong vision-language baselines across multiple backbones. Source code will be released.

</details>


### [126] [From Generation to Matching: A Development Report on Personalized Chinese Handwriting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15812)
*Yiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文记录了一个被冻结的中文个性化手写工程项目的完整历程。项目最初以约200张真实手写图片（覆盖197个独特汉字）出发，试图进行少样本生成未见字符，但在反复尝试中暴露了"结构保真"与"个性化保留"之间的根本冲突。项目最终转向基于真实人类汉字等价类别的匹配方法：从多书写者CASIA候选池中寻找与用户兼容的真实手写样本，通过逐字匹配和跨书写者组合构建虚拟书写者，最终在100字符评估子集上达到100/100覆盖，实现了稳定的实用级B级质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化中文手写生成面临根本性矛盾：增加结构约束会使输出趋于规范（丢失个性），而加强个性化又会破坏笔画特征（影响可识别性）。项目试图探索是否有可能在少样本条件下生成用户未见汉字的个性化手写。

Method: 项目经历了路径转变：(1) 最初尝试基于中心的个性化生成路线（few-shot生成未见字符），但因结构-个性冲突而失败；(2) 重置为真实人类字符等价类方案——从多书写者CASIA池中按字符精确匹配用户兼容的候选，使用真实墨水特征、字符级人群百分位数、top-20候选剪枝和贪婪的最难优先整行选择策略，最终组合为虚拟书写者。

Result: 在覆盖目标集上，全部197个用户字符都找到了真实人类候选；100字符评估子集覆盖率达100/100。已知字符的保留对比测试中，某行被判定与真实用户手写几乎无法区分。60集稳定性审计显示所有集合均位于预定义的类机器代理区域，但非独立人类A级判定。最终证据支持稳定的实用B级质量，许多输出接近A级。

Conclusion: 该案例证明生成并非个性化手写任务的必需路径——当真实人类样本池足够丰富时，匹配和组合可以替代合成。但作者明确声明结论不适用于无限制或通用的手写合成场景，项目因达到预期目标而被有意冻结。

Abstract: This paper documents a frozen engineering project on personalized Chinese handwriting. The project started from approximately 200 real handwriting images from one user, covering 197 unique Chinese characters, and was initially formulated as few-shot generation of unseen characters. A sequence of canonical-centered personalization routes repeatedly exposed the same conflict: increasing structural pressure made outputs more canonical, while increasing personalization could damage identity-defining strokes. The project was therefore reset around real-human character equivalence classes. A multi-writer CASIA candidate pool showed that a USER-compatible realization often already existed among valid human samples. The task consequently changed from synthesis to character-wise matching, followed by cross-writer composition into a virtual writer. The frozen system uses real-ink features, character-specific human population percentiles, top-20 candidate pruning, and greedy hardest-first whole-row selection. On the covered target set, all 197 USER characters had real-human candidates, and the 100-character evaluation subset was covered 100/100. Knowncharacter held-out comparisons included a row judged visually almost indistinguishable from genuine USER handwriting. A 60- episode stability audit placed every episode in a predefined A-like machine-proxy region, but these were not independent human A-level judgments. The final evidence supports stable practical B-level quality, with many outputs approaching A-level under the USER-defined criterion. The report records why generation became unnecessary for this case without claiming unrestricted or universal handwriting synthesis.

</details>


### [127] [FlowDance: Music-Driven Dance Video Generation with Parallel Pose and RGB Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15818)
*Genying Li,Boda Lin,Jiachen Li,Zijian Jia,Haojie Zheng,Yiming Wang,Shuchen Weng,Si Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowDance是一个音乐驱动的舞蹈视频生成框架，通过并行姿态和RGB流整合显式运动建模与参考保持的视觉合成，并引入时间步感知姿态注入和持久身份注入，同时构建了带同步音乐、3D运动、相机参数和2D姿态标注的高分辨率野外舞蹈视频数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐驱动的舞蹈视频合成任务具有挑战性，因为它要求模型同时学习音乐到动作的对应关系、身份保持的人体动画、时间连贯性以及视觉上逼真的视频生成，这些目标需要联合优化。

Method: 1) 采用并行姿态流和RGB流的双流架构进行显式运动建模和参考保持的视觉合成；2) 引入时间步感知姿态注入（timestep-aware pose injection）以在去噪步骤中自适应调整结构引导；3) 引入持久身份注入（persistent identity injection）以在长视频中保持参考外观；4) 构建流行度筛选、高分辨率野外舞蹈视频数据集。

Result: 大量实验表明FlowDance在舞蹈动作生成和音乐驱动舞蹈视频合成两方面均取得了强劲的性能表现。

Conclusion: 通过显式运动建模与视觉合成解耦、自适应结构引导和身份保持机制的引入，FlowDance有效解决了音乐驱动舞蹈视频合成中的多项核心挑战，并在基准数据和自建数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Music-driven dance video synthesis aims to animate a reference person according to a given music clip. The task is challenging because it requires a model to jointly learn music-to-motion correspondence, identity-preserving human animation, temporal coherence, and visually realistic video generation. We present FlowDance, a music-driven dance video generation framework that integrates explicit motion modeling with reference-preserving visual synthesis through parallel pose and RGB streams. We further introduce timestep-aware pose injection to adapt structural guidance across denoising steps and persistent identity injection to preserve the reference appearance over long video. To support this task, we further build a popularity-curated, high-resolution in-the-wild dance video dataset with synchronized music, RGB videos, 3D body motion, camera parameters, and projected 2D pose annotations. Extensive experiments show that FlowDance achieves strong performance in both dance motion generation and music-driven dance video synthesis.

</details>


### [128] [Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16316)
*Ao Shen,Yongheng Zhang,Yinghui Li,Manning Wang,Di Yin,Xing Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent-OPD，一种在输出级蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation）基础上增加轨迹级潜在表示蒸馏的方法，用于提升视频推理中的大型多模态模型向小模型的知识蒸馏效果。该方法在轨迹末端进行潜在状态蒸馏，并引入渐进式教师前瞻策略，在六个视频推理基准上优于仅输出级蒸馏的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）进行视频推理时计算成本高昂，因此需要将大模型的推理能力蒸馏到更小、更高效的模型中。现有的 On-Policy Distillation（OPD）仅匹配输出token分布，但视频推理依赖跨多帧累积的证据，输出级监督只能捕获通过token预测表达的信息，无法直接约束推理过程中形成的潜在表示。

Method: 提出 Latent-OPD，它在 OPD 基础上增加轨迹级别的潜在表示蒸馏。具体做法：（1）在每条轨迹的末端位置进行潜在状态蒸馏，因为隐藏状态能有效汇总累积的视觉证据和推理上下文；（2）引入渐进式教师前瞻（progressive teacher-lookahead）策略，将学生中到后期的层与教师越来越深的层对齐。

Result: 在六个视频推理基准上的实验表明，Latent-OPD 始终优于仅输出级的 OPD。尤其在帧数有限、长视频或需要复杂证据聚合的任务中，提升效果尤为显著。

Conclusion: Latent-OPD 被确立为一种高效的帧级视频推理方法，通过潜在表示蒸馏弥补了输出级蒸馏在视频推理场景中的不足，证明了轨迹级潜在蒸馏对视频推理任务的有效性。

Abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.

</details>


### [129] [MITE-Net: SWaP-Optimized 4K Video Tiny Target Perception for Embodied Edge SAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15830)
*Mingshuo Xu,Mu Hua,Jigen Peng,Qi Wang,Shigang Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了MITE-Net，一个面向高分辨率图像实时微小目标感知的SWaP优化级联架构，结合生物启发的无学习运动区域提议网络(TTM-RPN)和亚0.14M参数的R-CNN头部，并在自建的SAR-Tiny数据集（SeaDroneSee-Tiny和UAVID-Tiny）上进行评估。在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier边缘设备上，MITE-Net直接处理4K海上图像达到100%搜索成功率、30.33 FPS和3.19W低功耗；但在城市杂乱场景中暴露了结构性局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备（如UAV）在执行搜索救援任务时面临严格的SWaP约束，但高分辨率图像中的微小目标感知存在瓶颈：传统降采样会导致特征严重丢失，而切片处理又会带来难以接受的延迟。现有方法无法在资源受限条件下同时兼顾速度、精度和功耗。

Method: 提出MITE-Net级联架构，包含两个核心组件：(1)TTM-RPN——生物启发的无学习运动区域提议网络，用于快速筛选候选区域；(2)亚0.14M参数的R-CNN风格轻量头部用于精确定位。同时构建了SAR-Tiny数据集（SeaDroneSee-Tiny和UAVID-Tiny），并在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上进行了硬件级基准测试。

Result: 在4K海上图像上，MITE-Net达到100%搜索成功率、30.33 FPS，仅消耗3.19W（9.51 FPS/W），在目标召回率和能效上大幅优于YOLO基线。然而在UAVID-Tiny城市场景中，无学习的前端难以应对杂乱背景，超轻量头部也缺乏复杂特征的表达容量。

Conclusion: 该工作为边缘端搜索救援提供了高效的在机感知范式，并建立了严格的基准。同时揭示了无学习方法在动态海上场景有效但在城市杂乱场景失效的局限，为未来端到端SAR架构指明了改进方向。

Abstract: Real-time tiny target perception in high-resolution imagery is critical for embodied Search-and-Rescue (SAR) missions. However, strict Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints on edge devices like UAVs create a bottleneck: traditional image downsampling causes severe feature loss, while slice-based processing incurs prohibitive latency. To address this gap, this paper introduces a comprehensive framework encompassing a novel architecture, specialized datasets, and hardware-level benchmarks. First, we propose MITE-Net, a SWaP-optimized cascaded architecture, which couples a bio-inspired, learning-free Tiny Target Motion-Based Region Proposal Network (TTM-RPN) with a sub-0.14M-parameter R-CNN-like head. Second, to standardize 4K tiny target evaluation, we construct the SAR-Tiny Datasets by relabeling two challenging UAV datasets: SeaDroneSee-Tiny (dynamic maritime scenes, tiny targets predominantly of 64-256 pixels ) and UAVID-Tiny (cluttered urban scenes, extremely tiny targets, less than 64 pixels). Third, we benchmark against state-of-the-art YOLO models on an edge device, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier, where MITE-Net directly processes 4K maritime imagery, achieving a 100\% search success rate at 30.33 FPS. Consuming merely 3.19 W (9.51 FPS/W), MITE-Net vastly outperforms YOLO baselines in target recall and energy efficiency. Conversely, UAVID-Tiny evaluations expose a compound structural limitation: the learning-free bionic front-end struggles against urban backgrounds, while the ultra-lightweight head lacks representational capacity for complex features. Ultimately, this work delivers an efficient onboard perception paradigm and a rigorous baseline guiding future end-to-end SAR architectures.

</details>


### [130] [Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16514)
*Mohamed Amine Kerkouri,Marouane Tliba,Aladine Chetouani,Ulas Bagci,Alessandro Bruno*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文比较了三种通用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与人类在目标导向视觉搜索（COCO-Search18）中的眼动扫描路径。通过逐注视点驱动模型通过相同的人类匹配中央凹视觉输入，发现模型在目标存在决策和目标获取效率上达到或超过人类，但注视过程本身与人类不同——模型产生低熵、大幅值、高度自洽的扫描路径，这与人类的序列化搜索机制不符。这种差异存在于过程轴上，而答案对齐和显著性指标无法捕捉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视觉搜索是序列化的：中央凹必须落在候选对象上加以确认，这些落点形成扫描路径。通过给多模态大语言模型相同的中央凹输入，可以检验它们是否像人类一样搜索，这对于将它们用作人类视觉模型以及注意力对齐分数具有重要意义。现有指标可能无法全面评估模型是否真正具有与人类相似的视觉搜索过程。

Method: 使用COCO-Search18目标导向搜索任务，将三种通用MLLMs与人类眼动扫描路径进行比较。逐注视点驱动每个模型通过相同的人类匹配中央凹视觉视图，并从三个维度评估：目标存在性决策、达到目标的效率、以及注视过程本身。

Result: 三个维度出现分离。在决策和目标获取上模型达到或超过人类，检测存在目标接近天花板，且比人类更常在第一次扫视就到达目标。但注视过程不像人类：三种模型都共享单一特征——低熵、大幅值、自一致的扫描路径，模型自身的一致性远高于两个人之间的一致性。这与单通道、非序列化架构一致，而非视力极限所致。匹配的视网膜输入能复现人类看向哪里，但不能复现注视如何随时间展开，且没有任何退化方案能恢复人类般的搜索过程和成功率。

Conclusion: 模型与人类之间的差距位于过程轴上，这是答案对齐和显著性指标无法测量的维度。由于这些指标遗漏了该差距，它们无法认证人类般的视觉能力。零样本模型适合回答结果和空间问题，但不适合时间性、过程层面的问题。

Abstract: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

</details>


### [131] [CardiacMamba: Fair and Robust RGB-RF Fusion for Remote Heart Rate Estimation via State Space Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15831)
*Bo Zhao,Zheng Wu,Yiping Xie,Zitong YU*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CardiacMamba是一个基于状态空间模型的RGB-RF融合框架，用于远程光电容积描记法（rPPG）心率监测，通过融合面部光学线索和射频心脏运动线索，在EquiPleth数据集上达到0.96 bpm MAE、3.06 bpm RMSE和0.97 Pearson相关系数，并将不同肤色MAE差距缩小至0.26 bpm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯RGB方法在rPPG心率监测中易受光照变化、运动伪影和肤色相关光学反射影响，导致性能不稳定且存在公平性问题，需要引入RF信号进行融合以提升鲁棒性和公平性。

Method: 提出三个核心模块：Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM)增强RF细微时间变化；基于双向SSM的交互机制对齐异构RGB-RF动态；Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT)模块实现通道域频谱细化。

Result: 在EquiPleth数据集上达到SOTA性能：MAE 0.96 bpm、RMSE 3.06 bpm、Pearson相关系数0.97，将深浅肤色的MAE差距降至0.26 bpm，并在RGB质量下降和RF缺失条件下保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CardiacMamba通过RGB-RF多模态融合和状态空间建模，有效解决了rPPG在光照变化、运动伪影和肤色偏差方面的挑战，实现了既准确又公平的心率监测。

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart rate (HR) monitoring from facial videos, but RGB-only methods are vulnerable to illumination changes, motion artifacts, and skin-tone-dependent optical reflectance. We propose CardiacMamba, a fair and robust RGB-RF fusion framework that integrates optical facial cues and radio-frequency cardiac motion cues through state space modeling. CardiacMamba introduces a Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM) to enhance subtle RF temporal variations, a bidirectional SSM-based interaction mechanism to align heterogeneous RGB-RF dynamics, and a Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT) module for channel-domain spectral refinement. On the EquiPleth dataset, CardiacMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance with 0.96 bpm MAE, 3.06 bpm RMSE, and 0.97 Pearson correlation, while reducing the observed light-dark skin-tone MAE gap to 0.26 bpm and maintaining robustness under RGB degradation and RF-missing conditions

</details>


### [132] [CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15905)
*Yuchen Zhang,Shuang Dai,Zeyu Fu,Yunfei Long,Ravi Shekhar,Haralambos Mouratidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CLARA，一个基于clip级别的多模态框架用于仇恨视频检测。CLARA将视频建模为细粒度片段序列，通过MoE片段编码器、局部-全局对比学习和VLM推理门控Transformer，在三个数据集上超越SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仇恨视频检测重要但未被充分探索。与文本或静态多模态内容相比，仇恨视频中的恶意信号常源于语音、音频、视觉等多模态线索的复杂交互，且这些信号往往短暂、隐式且具有时间依赖性，传统的视频级表示难以捕捉这些特征。

Method: 1) 将视频建模为细粒度clip序列而非单一实例；2) 引入Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）clip编码器实现自适应多模态对齐；3) 设计局部-全局片段对比目标，联合建模短期线索和长期时间依赖；4) 通过门控Transformer集成VLM生成的推理（rationales）提供高层语义指导。

Result: 在三个仇恨视频数据集上的大量实验表明，CLARA一致性地优于现有最先进方法。消融研究和参数分析验证了各组件（MoE编码器、对比学习、VLM推理门控）的有效性。

Conclusion: CLARA通过clip级细粒度建模和多种新颖组件（MoE、局部-全局对比、VLM推理门控）有效解决了仇恨视频中多模态交互和时间依赖的检测难题，为该领域提供了更精确的解决方案。

Abstract: Hateful video detection has become increasingly important with the rapid growth of video-centric social media platforms, given the serious risks that hate speech poses to both individual well-being and social cohesion. Compared with text or static multimodal content, hateful video detection remains underexplored and significantly more challenging, as hateful meaning often arises from complex interactions among multimodal cues, including speech, audio, and visual content. Moreover, such signals are often brief, implicit, and temporally dependent, making them difficult to capture using conventional video-level representations. In this work, we propose CLARA, a clip-level multimodal framework for hateful video detection. Instead of treating a video as a single instance, CLARA models it as a sequence of fine-grained clips, enabling more precise capture of temporally localized hateful signals. We introduce a Mixture-of-Experts clip encoder for adaptive multimodal alignment, a local-global segment contrastive objective to jointly model short-term cues and long-range temporal dependencies, and VLM-derived rationales integrated via a gated Transformer to provide high-level semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on three hateful video datasets demonstrate that CLARA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Further ablation studies and parameter analyses validate the effectiveness of each component.

</details>


### [133] [Comprehensive Benchmarking of Deep Learning Architectures for Lung Cancer Histopathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15915)
*Hadi Hasan,Safaa Salman,Lama Sleem,Ralph Mouawad,Ali Chehab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段深度学习框架，用于肺癌组织多分类和像素级病理区域分割，并系统比较了各阶段的最先进架构。分类阶段YOLO11表现最佳（准确率98.38%），分割阶段DeepLabV3+取得最高IoU 0.80，而YOLO11-seg以约14倍更少的参数达到相当性能。最终将最佳模型整合为端到端框架，为自动化病理图像分析提供基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的首要原因，而组织病理学诊断常受观察者间差异和手动阅片工作量大等问题影响。虽然深度学习在计算病理学中潜力巨大，但将组织分类和区域分割整合到统一分析框架中的综合基准仍然有限，需要填补这一空白。

Method: 提出两阶段深度学习框架：第一阶段进行多类组织分类（区分腺癌、鳞状细胞癌和正常肺组织），使用39,000张图像（来自LC25000和LungHist700数据集）评估六种模型（自定义CNN、VGG16、DenseNet、MobileNetV3、自定义ViT和YOLO11）；第二阶段进行像素级区域分割，使用GlaS基准评估U-Net、ResNet编码器U-Net、DeepLabV3+和YOLO11-seg四种模型；最后将最佳模型整合为端到端框架。

Result: 分类阶段：YOLO11表现最佳，准确率98.38%，五折交叉验证准确率98.21±0.35%，宏F1分数0.98。分割阶段：DeepLabV3+获得最高IoU 0.80和Dice分数0.89；YOLO11-seg达到可比的IoU 0.79，但参数量减少约14倍。

Conclusion: 所提出的两阶段框架成功整合了最优分类和分割模型，提供了准确、计算高效且可复现的自动化组织病理图像分析基线，有助于缓解肺癌病理诊断中的观察者间变异和工作负担问题。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, while histopathological diagnosis is often affected by inter-observer variability and the substantial workload associated with manual slide examination. Although deep learning has shown considerable potential in computational pathology, comprehensive benchmarks that integrate tissue classification and region segmentation within a unified analytical framework remain limited. This study presents a two-stage deep learning framework for multi-class tissue classification and pixel-level histopathological region segmentation, accompanied by a systematic comparison of state-of-the-art architectures at each stage. For tissue classification, six models, a custom convolutional neural network, VGG16, DenseNet, MobileNetV3, a custom Vision Transformer, and YOLO11, are evaluated on a combined dataset of 39,000 images derived from LC25000 and LungHist700. The models distinguish between adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and normal lung tissue. YOLO11 achieves the best classification performance, with an accuracy of 98.38%, a five-fold cross-validation accuracy of 98.21 +/- 0.35%, and a macro F1-score of 0.98. For region segmentation, U-Net, ResNet-encoder U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and YOLO11-seg are evaluated using the GlaS gland segmentation benchmark. DeepLabV3+ obtains the highest Intersection over Union of 0.80 and a Dice score of 0.89, while YOLO11-seg achieves a comparable Intersection over Union of 0.79 using approximately 14x fewer parameters. The best-performing classification and segmentation models are subsequently integrated into an end-to-end framework, providing an accurate, computationally efficient, and reproducible baseline for automated histopathological image analysis.

</details>


### [134] [BagShift: Measuring How Patch Selection Changes the Evidence Seen by Whole-Slide MIL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15970)
*Ruicheng Yuan,Zhenxuan Zhang,Liwei Hu,Anbang Wang,Haijie Xu,Jiawei Luo,Guang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出BagShift协议，探究全切片多实例学习（MIL）中selector变化对模型表现的影响。通过固定特征和预测器、仅改变patch选择器，在PANDA和CAMELYON16等数据集上发现：即使patch数量相同，选择器的不同（全组织采样vs局部集中采样）会显著改变模型证据和性能（QWK分别下降1.57和17.96分）；在CAMELYON16上局部视图仅保留10%的微转移组织；重复局部观测时，union patches并做一次非线性MIL比平均区域预测提升PANDA QWK 7.87分。结论是patch数量只决定计算量而非观察证据，部署评估应报告选择器保留内容及重复观测的聚合方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MIL评估通常只控制patch数量，但部署时selector可能因计算限制、组织掩膜或区域工作流而改变，即使patch数不变也会改变模型观察到的证据。作者希望隔离selector响应与病例分布，量化selector变化对模型性能的影响。

Method: 提出BagShift配对协议：对同一病例固定特征与预测器，仅改变patch选择器，分别进行统一patch预算下的不同选择（全组织采样vs局部集中采样），比较模型性能差异；同时在CAMELYON16上利用留出病变标注评估局部视图对肿瘤的保留情况；并比较union patches后单次非线性MIL聚合与区域预测平均两种聚合策略。

Result: 在PANDA上，两种视图使QWK分别下降1.57和17.96分（×100尺度）；CAMELYON16上局部视图仅保留10.0%微转移观察中的肿瘤，匹配暴露无法一致恢复损失；外部肺亚型任务对相同固定计数压力响应较小；union patches单次MIL聚合比区域预测平均提升PANDA QWK 7.87分。

Conclusion: Patch数量只规定计算负载，不能作为观察证据的充分代理。部署评估必须同时报告selector保留的内容以及重复观测的聚合方式，才能准确反映MIL系统在真实部署条件下的表现。

Abstract: Whole-slide multiple-instance learning (MIL) observes only the patches admitted by its selector. Deployment can alter this selector through compute limits, tissue masking, or regional workflows, even when the patch count is unchanged. We introduce BagShift, a paired protocol that changes the selector for the same case while holding its features and predictor fixed, thereby isolating selector response from case mix. With equal 128-patch budgets, sampling across the tissue or concentrating around one coordinate exposes markedly different evidence: on PANDA, the two views reduce quadratic weighted kappa by 1.57 and 17.96 points, respectively (QWK reported on the $\times100$ scale). On CAMELYON16, lesion annotations withheld from model development show that localized views retain tumor in only 10.0\% of micrometastatic observations, and matched exposure does not consistently recover the loss. The same fixed-count stressor produces a much smaller response on external lung subtyping, although differences in relative coverage make cross-task severity descriptive. When repeated localized observations are available, unioning their patches before one nonlinear MIL pass improves PANDA QWK by 7.87 points over averaging regional predictions. Patch count specifies computation, not observed evidence; deployment evaluations should report both what a selector preserves and how repeated observations are aggregated.

</details>


### [135] [CM-MAE: A Physics-Guided Cross-Modal Self-Supervised Learning Framework for Vision-Wireless Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15972)
*Yubo Zhang,Yiyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CM-MAE，一种自监督视觉-无线联合预训练框架，用于跨场景表征迁移。通过软对比对齐损失避免将不同样本强制推开，结合掩码联合解码器重建视觉补丁与无线角度簇，在DeepSense 6G数据集上实现了跨未见场景的高准确率迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同步相机与无线测量通过不同物理通道观测同一场景，但单一部署中学到的表征在视点、交通、光照和传播几何变化时会失效，跨场景表征迁移是核心难点。

Method: 1) 软对比对齐损失：基于波束功率谱相似性构建目标分布，避免非相同但方向响应相似的样本被当作假负样本；2) 掩码联合解码器：在模态丢弃下重建隐藏视觉补丁和无线角度簇，提供局部自监督目标；3) 差分率微调规则：新融合头快速适应，编码器缓慢更新。

Result: 序列不相交DeepSense 6G协议下，软对齐损失将线性探测迁移平均从24.88%提升至29.49%；融合微调在未见场景6-8达到77.38% Top-1准确率，转导归一化自适应可提升至78.69%。

Conclusion: CM-MAE证明了视觉-无线跨模态自监督预训练能有效迁移到未见场景，但融合推理依赖当前时刻的64波束功率向量，结果应视为表征迁移诊断而非主动波束预测或减少扫描的证明。

Abstract: Synchronized camera and wireless measurements observe the same scene through different physical channels. The central difficulty is that a representation learned in one deployment can fail when viewpoint, traffic, illumination, and propagation geometry change. This paper presents CM-MAE, a self-supervised vision--wireless pretraining framework for cross-scenario representation transfer. The evaluated real-data model uses only RGB frames and the measured 64-beam received-power vector available in DeepSense 6G; it does not use ray-traced paths, calibrated depth, or beam-index labels during pretraining. Its central pretraining term is a \emph{soft contrastive alignment loss}. Instead of making the synchronized image--wireless pair the only positive pair, this loss builds a target distribution from similarities between measured beam-power profiles, so nonidentical samples with similar directional responses are not forced apart as false negatives. A masked joint decoder provides the complementary local objective by reconstructing hidden visual patches and wireless angular clusters under modality dropout. After pretraining, a differential-rate fine-tuning rule lets a new fusion head adapt quickly while the encoders move slowly. Under a sequence-disjoint DeepSense 6G protocol, adding the soft alignment loss improves a matched linear-probe transfer average from 24.88\% to 29.49\%. Mild fusion fine-tuning reaches 77.38\% Top-1 accuracy on unseen Scenarios 6--8, and optional transductive normalization adaptation reaches 78.69\%. Since the fusion setting uses the contemporaneous 64-beam power vector at inference, these results should be read as representation-transfer diagnostics, not as proactive beam-prediction or reduced-sweeping claims.

</details>


### [136] [A Plug-and-Play 2D Motion Interface for Real-World Motion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15984)
*Kaname Yokoyama,Norimichi Ukita*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种即插即用的2D运动接口，使得3D预训练的运动语言模型（MoLMs）无需修改或微调即可接受2D运动输入，解决了单目视频中获取准确3D运动困难的问题，在多个数据集上取得了与3D输入相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的MoLMs依赖3D运动标记化，但从单目视频中准确获取3D运动非常困难，限制了MoLMs在现实世界中的应用。

Method: 提出一个即插即用的2D运动接口（2D Motion Interface），将2D运动输入转换为3D预训练MoLM可以理解的格式，无需修改或微调原始模型；同时引入了一个针对单目真实视频的运动评估数据集和真实视频适配器。

Result: 在公开数据集上，该方法在多种MoLMs上达到了与3D运动输入相当的性能，并优于从零开始在2D运动上训练MoLMs的效果；在单目姿态估计设置下的真实世界视频评估中，2D运动比3D运动更具实用性。

Conclusion: 2D运动为在现实世界运动理解场景中部署MoLMs提供了一种实用且有效的接口。

Abstract: Motion Language Models (MoLMs) typically understand human motions by tokenizing 3D motion and processing the resulting tokens using a language model. However, obtaining accurate 3D motions from monocular videos is challenging, limiting their real-world applicability. To address this issue, we introduce a plug-and-play 2D Motion Interface that enables 3D-pretrained MoLMs to accept 2D motion inputs without modifying or fine-tuning the original models.
  Experiments on public datasets show that our method achieves performance comparable to 3D motion inputs across multiple MoLMs and outperforms training MoLMs from scratch on 2D motions. We further construct a monocular real-world video motion evaluation dataset and introduce a real-video adapter, demonstrating the usefulness of 2D motions over 3D motions under the evaluated monocular pose-estimation setting. These results suggest that 2D motion provides a practical interface for deploying MoLMs in real-world motion understanding settings. Code is available at https://github.com/irajisamurai/2D-Motion-Interface.

</details>


### [137] [Spatial Temporal Synergy: Balancing Change and Invariance in Text Driven 3D Human Motion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16008)
*Shaohui Lin,Zhenwu Shi,Jingyu Gong,Jiao Xie,Yu Zhou,Baochang Zhang,Lizhuang Ma,Chia-Wen Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CIME（Change and Invariance Motion Editing）框架，用于文本驱动的3D人体动作编辑。该框架从空间姿态和时间节奏两个维度系统解耦"变化"与"不变"：空间上采用全监督正负学习机制（包括层级回顾特征监督、细微动作保持、三元组语义对齐），时间上引入黎曼非均匀积分流形映射（RNIMM）模块，通过运动学感知的非均匀时间戳实现物理节拍的高保真再现。在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的动作编辑方法难以平衡文本响应的"变化"与结构保持的"不变"，通常依赖粗糙的空间约束和刚性的均匀时间假设，导致变长编辑中空间运动扭曲和内在物理节奏被破坏。

Method: 提出统一框架CIME，从两个维度解耦变化与不变：(1) 空间姿态维度：全监督正负学习机制，包含层级回顾特征监督、细微运动保持、三元组语义对齐；(2) 时间节奏维度：RNIMM模块，通过运动学感知的非均匀时间戳实现物理节拍高保真再现。

Result: 在MotionFix和STANCE Adjustment数据集上，CIME在编辑对齐度和结构保真度方面均达到最先进（SOTA）性能。

Conclusion: 实验验证了统一架构的有效性，证明空间与时间两个维度同时解耦"变化"与"不变"是提升文本驱动动作编辑质量的关键。

Abstract: Text-driven human motion editing aims to modify existing motion sequences according to natural language instructions while maintaining the structural consistency of the original motion. Existing diffusion-based approaches struggle to balance text-responsive "change" and inertial "invariance". They often rely on coarse spatial constraints and rigid uniform time assumptions, leading to spatial motion distortions and the destruction of intrinsic physical rhythms during variable-length editing. To handle these challenges, we propose Change and Invariance Motion Editing (CIME), a unified framework that comprehensively decouples change and invariance into spatial pose and temporal rhythm dimensions. For spatial poses, our method integrates an omni-supervised positive-negative learning mechanism comprising hierarchical retrospective feature supervision, subtle motion preservation, and triplet-based semantic alignment. For temporal rhythms, we introduce the Riemannian Non-uniform Integral Manifold Mapping (RNIMM) module, which achieves high-fidelity reproduction of physical beats in the edited text via kinematics-aware non-uniform timestamps. Extensive experiments on the MotionFix and STANCE Adjustment datasets demonstrate that CIME achieves state-of-the-art performance in editing alignment and structural fidelity, validating the effectiveness of our unified architecture. Our source codes and models have been released at: github.com/ZhenwuShi/CIME.git

</details>


### [138] [Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing for HDR Robot Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16014)
*Jinnyeong Kim,Juhyung Choi,Woohyeok Kim,Sunghyun Cho,Seung-Hwan Baek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于多传感器机器人系统HDR感知的大规模基准数据集（包含121个真实场景和20个CARLA合成视频序列），并提出了DMEB（深度引导的多视角曝光包围）方法，通过在不同视角的低位深相机上分配差异极大的曝光，并采用深度引导的置信度感知融合实现单次拍摄HDR成像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端光照条件下的可靠单次HDR成像仍然是一个长期挑战，但目前缺乏用于评估多传感器机器人系统中HDR感知的综合基准数据集。

Method: 构建了基于定制机器人视觉平台和iPhone 13 Pro的大规模数据集（121个真实场景+20个CARLA合成序列），并提出DMEB方法：在不同视角低位深相机上分配差异极大的曝光，通过深度引导的置信度感知融合来实现单次HDR成像。

Result: 在提出的数据集上评估表明，DMEB建立了强参考基准，并展示了该传感器配置在多相机和深度传感器系统中实现鲁棒HDR感知的潜力。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了多传感器机器人系统HDR感知基准的空白，验证了多视角曝光分布+深度引导融合这一传感器配置在HDR成像中的有效性。

Abstract: Achieving reliable single-shot high dynamic range (HDR) imaging under extreme illumination conditions remains a long-standing challenge, yet no comprehensive benchmark exist for evaluating HDR perception in multi-sensor robotic systems. To fill this gap, we introduce a large-scale dataset collected via a custom robotic vision platform and an iPhone 13 Pro: 121 real-world scenes spanning modest and ultra-high dynamic range conditions, alongside 20 synthetic video sequences from the CARLA simulator. As a reference pipeline for this dataset, we propose Depth-guided Multi-view Exposure Bracketing (DMEB), a single-shot HDR method that distributes drastically different exposures across multi-view low-bit-depth cameras and fuses them via depth-guided confidence-aware fusion. Evaluations on our dataset show that DMEB establishes a strong reference point and highlight the promise of this sensor configuration for robust HDR perception in diverse multi-camera and depth sensor system.

</details>


### [139] [Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16015)
*Mingsheng Zheng,Zirui Jiang,Bo Liu,Yupeng Chen,Jun Zhang,Kai Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MDCRNet（多尺度分解卷积精炼网络），通过分层学习模块和联合判别度量损失增强跨模态特征学习和判别度量学习，在SYSU-MM01和RegDB数据集上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可见光-红外行人重识别方法在语义挖掘、跨模态融合和特征约束方面存在局限性，导致跨模态差异大、判别能力有限，识别性能不理想。

Method: 提出MDCRNet，包含两个核心组件：(1)分层学习模块（HLM），由四个分层分解卷积注意力（HDCA）模块组成，每个模块配有轻量级通道注意力和多尺度空间感知模块以捕获多尺度空间依赖；(2)联合判别度量损失（JDML），引入新颖的粒度判别损失（GDL），同时优化身份内紧凑性和跨模态身份间可分性。

Result: 在SYSU-MM01和RegDB两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，MDCRNet在两个基准上均达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: MDCRNet通过多尺度分解卷积精炼机制有效解决了VI-ReID中的跨模态差异和判别能力不足问题，为跨模态行人重识别提供了新的解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) suffers from cross-modal discrepancies and limited discriminative capabilities, leading to suboptimal recognition performance. Current approaches exhibit limitations in semantic mining, cross-modal fusion and feature constraints. To tackle these challenges, we propose MDCRNet, a Multi-scale Decomposed Convolution Refinement Network that enhances cross-modal feature learning and discriminative metric learning. Specifically, we introduce a Hierarchical Learning Module (HLM) containing four Hierarchical Decomposed Convolution Attention (HDCA) modules, each equipped with lightweight channel attention and multi-scale spatial perception blocks to capture multi-scale spatial dependencies. Moreover, we develop a Joint Discriminative Metric Loss (JDML) incorporating a novel Granularity Discriminative Loss (GDL) that simultaneously optimizes intra-identity compactness and inter-identity separability across modalities. Extensive experiments on SYSU-MM01 and RegDB datasets demonstrate that MDCRNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Kevin-zms/MDCRNet.

</details>


### [140] [TR-GS: High-Fidelity Sparse-View CT Volumetric Rendering via t-Distribution Gaussian Splatting and Ray-Confidence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16042)
*Zedong Xiao,Yiren Wang,Zhou Liu,Xiaolin Liu,Zhangji Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TR-GS是一个基于3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的稀疏视角CT体积渲染框架。它用可投影的学生t分布基元替代标准高斯基元，并引入射线置信度模型来调节自由度，同时采用置信度引导的3D小波正则化平衡高频细节保留与噪声抑制。在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，TR-GS在大多数评估设置下优于代表性基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角CT虽然能减少投影需求和辐射暴露，但有限的观测会引入结构伪影和重建不确定性。现有的基于标准高斯基元的CT三维重建方法在稀疏视角采集下对不可靠观测较为敏感，因此需要更稳健的体积渲染表示方法。

Method: TR-GS框架包含三个关键创新：(1)用可投影的学生t分布基元替代标准高斯基元；(2)引入射线置信度模型，根据局部射线可观测性调节基元的自由度；(3)采用置信度引导的3D小波正则化，平衡高频细节保留与噪声抑制。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验显示，TR-GS在大多数评估设置中优于代表性基线方法，在其余情况下也保持竞争力。

Conclusion: TR-GS产生的体积表示可支持下游医学多媒体应用，包括XR可视化、交互式临床渲染等。该工作为稀疏视角CT的高保真重建提供了一种稳健且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: High-fidelity 3D medical visualization supports applications such as clinical assessment and surgical planning. Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) can reduce projection requirements and associated radiation exposure, but limited observations may introduce structural artifacts and reconstruction uncertainty. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient explicit representation for volumetric rendering, existing CT methods based on standard Gaussian primitives may be sensitive to unreliable observations under sparse-view acquisition. We present TR-GS, a Gaussian-splatting framework for sparse view CT volumetric rendering. TR-GS replaces standard Gaussian primitives with projectable Student's t-distribution primitives and introduces a ray-confidence model that regulates their degrees of freedom according to local ray observability. Confidence-guided 3D wavelet regularization is further used to balance high-frequency detail preservation and noise suppression. This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that TR-GS improves over representative baselines in most evaluated settings and remains competitive in the remaining cases. The resulting volumetric representations may support downstream medical multimedia applications, including XR-based visualization and interactive clinical rendering.

</details>


### [141] [SafeGesture: Evaluating Fine-Grained Hand Gesture Understanding in Vision-Language Models through Scenario-Conditioned Safety Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16081)
*Taegang Kim,Saleh Afroogh,Junfeng Jiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SafeGesture基准测试，评估视觉语言模型从手部手势推断场景安全性行动的能力，发现所有模型存在感知-推理解耦现象，主要瓶颈在于场景条件化的安全推理而非手势识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放权重和前沿视觉语言模型在通用图像理解上表现良好，但其在安全关键操作场景中解释细粒度手部手势的能力尚未被考察，这一能力缺口在安全敏感领域具有重要意义。

Method: 构建SafeGesture基准，将6种HaGRID手势与8种操作场景配对，形成4,800个项目，评估Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B、InternVL2-8B、Phi-3.5-Vision和GPT-4o五个模型。通过对比手势准确率与安全准确率、场景多数策略基线以及文字手势输入等条件来系统分析模型表现。

Result: GPT-4o手势准确率98.4%但安全准确率仅53.3%，Qwen2.5-VL分别为84.9%和39.5%，两者差距达45个百分点。四个模型很少使用不确定性标签，失败模式差异显著。场景多数策略无视觉输入即可达58.3%，超过所有被评估模型，仅GPT-4o在宏F1下超过该先验。视觉输入提升安全准确率11.2-30.2个百分点，但提供真实手势文字仅提升0.4-3.2个百分点，无模型超过56.2%。

Conclusion: 模型性能的主要瓶颈在于场景条件化的安全推理而非手势识别；准确率指标掩盖了标签偏置问题，且手势视觉表达的改进对安全推理的帮助十分有限，现有VLM在安全关键场景下的推理能力仍需大幅提升。

Abstract: Open-weight and frontier vision-language models (VLMs) perform well on general image understanding, but their ability to interpret fine-grained hand gestures in safety-critical operational contexts remains largely unexamined. We introduce SafeGesture, a benchmark that evaluates whether a model can infer scenario-appropriate safety actions from hand gestures. It pairs six HaGRID gestures with eight operational scenarios for 4,800 items and evaluates Qwen2.5-VL-7B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B, InternVL2-8B, Phi-3.5-Vision, and GPT-4o. Results reveal a perception-reasoning decoupling: GPT-4o achieves 98.4% gesture accuracy but 53.3% safety accuracy, while Qwen2.5-VL reaches 84.9% and 39.5%, yielding gaps of 45.0 and 45.4 percentage points. Four of five models rarely or never use the uncertainty label, and failure directions differ substantially across models. Accuracy also obscures label bias: a scenario-majority policy with no visual input reaches 58.3%, above every evaluated model, while only GPT-4o exceeds this prior under macro-F1. Visual input improves safety accuracy by 11.2 to 30.2 percentage points, but providing the ground-truth gesture as text improves performance by only 0.4 to 3.2 points, and no model exceeds 56.2%. These results indicate that the main bottleneck is scenario-conditioned safety reasoning rather than gesture recognition.

</details>


### [142] [Representation Is Not Enough: Body-Localized Thermal Evidence for Contactless Stress and Craving Sensing in Opioid Use Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16087)
*Sachin Deb,Harshit Sharma,Asif Salekin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FABLE-Therm，一种弱监督架构，用于从接触式热视频中实现压力/应激检测（聚焦阿片类药物使用障碍OUD场景）。该架构在嵌入层面融合冻结的基础模型编码器，保留身体区域、时间和编码器特定的局部证据直至最终决策，在留出参与者上达到0.938 AUROC，并首次证明可从接触式热视频恢复自我报告的渴望（craving），同时提供参与者级别的部署失败分析框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触式生理监测（可穿戴设备）虽能监测应激，但移除此类设备后也失去了监督信号——不再知道应激反应发生在何时何地。因此接触式应激感知成为一个弱监督的证据定位问题：需要从片段级标签追溯到产生该标签的身体区域和时刻。此外，在OUD患者早期康复中，持续佩戴可穿戴设备很困难，而压力是复发的主要诱因，迫切需要接触式的监测方案。

Method: 提出FABLE-Therm弱监督架构：(1) 在嵌入层面融合多个冻结的基础模型编码器，而非特征拼接或预测平均，并给出理论解释为何局部化融合优于后两者；(2) 保留跨身体区域、时间和编码器特定表征的局部化证据直到最终决策层；(3) 提供模态无关的部署失败分解方法，将人群差距拆分为数据不足部分与个体异质性部分。

Result: (1) 在留出参与者上达到0.938 AUROC；(2) 学习到的表征可迁移至自我报告的渴望，首次证明可从接触式热视频恢复渴望信号；(3) 局部化证据使参与者级别的部署失败分析成为可能：仅改善表征不足以实现公平部署，从服务不足人群补充数据仅能恢复约一半的人群差距，剩余部分反映个体间异质性；(4) 构建了首个队列结构的接触式热OUD基准。

Conclusion: 保留局部化证据既支持准确的应激感知，也支持对模型失败对象及原因的深入分析。该证据保留方法具有模态无关性，适用于具有可识别子群体的各类模型。

Abstract: Removing wearables from physiological monitoring also removes their supervision: the signal indicating where and when a stress response occurred. Contactless stress sensing therefore becomes a weakly supervised evidence-localization problem, where a clip-level label must be traced to the body regions and moments that produced it. We address this with FABLE-Therm, a weakly supervised architecture that preserves localized evidence across body regions, time, and encoder-specific representations until the final decision. FABLE-Therm fuses frozen foundation-model encoders at the embedding level, with theory explaining why localized fusion can outperform feature concatenation and prediction averaging. We study this problem in opioid use disorder (OUD), where stress is a major relapse trigger and sustained wearable use can be difficult during early recovery. Using fixed thermal video, FABLE-Therm achieves 0.938 AUROC on held-out participants, and its learned representation transfers to self-reported craving, providing, to our knowledge, the first evidence that craving can be recovered from contactless thermal video. Localized evidence also enables participant-level analysis of deployment failure. We find that improving representation alone is insufficient for equitable deployment: additional data from the underserved group would recover only about half of the cohort gap, while the remainder reflects person-to-person heterogeneity. This modality-agnostic decomposition applies to models with identifiable subpopulations. Together with the first cohort-structured contactless thermal OUD benchmark, our results show that preserving localized evidence supports both accurate sensing and principled analysis of who a model fails and why.

</details>


### [143] [TISC: A Text-Driven Image Semantic Communication System for Faithful Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16100)
*Feifan Zhang,Yuyang Du,Xiaoyan Liu,Soung Chang Liew*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TISC框架，一种面向忠实图像重建的文本驱动图像语义通信框架，通过树状结构属性语义提取（TSASE）和初始噪声优化（INO）两种关键设计，分别解决图像到文本语义提取中的语义丢失/失真问题，以及文本到图像重建中语义保真度不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式图像语义通信虽具有极低带宽成本的优势，但现有方法面临两个关键瓶颈：(1) I2T语义提取中存在语义丢失和失真，整体的图像描述可能遗漏细粒度物体属性和空间位置信息；(2) T2I语义重建中，即使文本语义一致，不同的初始噪声设置也会导致重建图像与原图的语义一致性程度不同。这些问题共同限制了图像重建的语义保真度。

Method: TISC框架包含两个核心设计：(1) 树状结构属性语义提取（TSASE），将语义提取分解为全局场景、背景和物体级属性描述三层，覆盖每个检测物体的空间位置、形状/姿态、颜色、材质等物理属性；(2) 初始噪声优化（INO）机制，在发射端根据综合考虑视觉和语义一致性的综合相似度分数，选择合适的初始噪声种子。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，TSASE改善了物体位置恢复和语义描述保真度，而INO参数研究支持了所采用的噪声选择配置。

Conclusion: TISC通过细粒度的树状语义提取和初始噪声优化的双重设计，有效提升了生成式图像语义通信中图像重建的语义保真度。

Abstract: Generative image semantic communication converts an image into a text description and then performs text-to-image reconstruction at the receiver via diffusion-based generative models. This paradigm has attracted broad attention due to its extremely low bandwidth cost. However, existing methods still face two critical bottlenecks across image-to-text (I2T) semantic extraction at the transmitter and text-to-image (T2I) semantic reconstruction at the receiver: (i) semantic loss and distortion in I2T, where holistic image descriptions may omit fine-grained object attributes and spatial-position information, causing the generated text to deviate from the original image semantics; and (ii) insufficient semantic faithfulness in T2I, where even with the same semantically faithful text description, different initial noise settings may lead diffusion-based reconstruction to produce images with different levels of semantic consistency with the original image. These issues jointly limit the semantic faithfulness of image reconstruction. To address them, we propose TISC, a text-driven image semantic communication framework tailored for faithful reconstruction. TISC incorporates two key designs: (1) Tree-Structured Attribute Semantic Extraction (TSASE), which decomposes semantic extraction into global scene, background, and object-level attribute descriptions, covering spatial position, shape/pose, color, material, and other physical attributes for each detected object; and (2) an Initial Noise Optimization (INO) mechanism, which selects an initial noise seed at the transmitter according to a comprehensive similarity score that jointly considers visual and semantic consistency. Experiments on multiple datasets show that TSASE improves object-position recovery and semantic description faithfulness, while the INO parameter study supports the adopted configuration for noise selection.

</details>


### [144] [Beyond Similarity Matching: Structured Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Referring Segmentation in 3DGS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16103)
*Yizhao Wang,Xinfa Wang,Jingbo Wang,Jingbo Wang,Guantao Zhang,Yafeng Han,Guohong Gao,Yuhe Xia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QAGaussian是一个面向3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)的开放词汇指代分割框架，通过查询自适应多尺度高斯槽(slot)、关系感知图推理和粒度自适应路由机制，解决现有方法在属性、指代物、空间关系和细粒度部件等查询上的局限性，在无需目标数据集微调的情况下显著超越现有最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS指代分割方法依赖全局文本-区域相似度，面对涉及属性、指代对象、空间关系和细粒度部件的查询时表现薄弱，导致指代对象混淆、粒度不匹配、整体-部分泄漏和关系违反等问题。

Method: QAGaussian包含三个核心组件：(1)查询条件化的多尺度高斯槽学习，以表达式塑造感受野；(2)关系感知槽图，通过语言条件化边权重传播指代目标、属性、部分-整体和上下文证据；(3)粒度自适应路由器，软性组合区域级、对象级、部件级、属性感知和关系感知掩码分支，并进行关系约束细化以保障空间、部分-整体、属性和几何一致性。

Result: 在仅用Mosaic3D-5.6M预训练且不做目标数据集微调的情况下，达到47.2 Avg. mIoU和63.2 Avg. F1，较最强3DGS指代基线分别提升2.7 mIoU和2.9 F1；Part-mIoU从38.6提升至43.4，Rel-mIoU从44.4提升至50.8，目标-指代混淆从10.8降至7.4。

Conclusion: 查询条件化槽学习、关系感知图推理和自适应路由为3DGS开放词汇指代分割提供了有效的神经建模策略。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) requires a neural model to select Gaussian primitives according to free-form language expressions. Existing 3DGS-based methods usually rely on global text-region similarity, which is weak for queries involving attributes, reference objects, spatial relations, and fine-grained parts. This often causes target-reference confusion, granularity mismatch, part-whole leakage, and relation violations. We propose QAGaussian, a query-adaptive neural reasoning framework for language-guided Gaussian primitive selection. QAGaussian first learns query-conditioned multi-scale Gaussian slots as differentiable candidates whose receptive fields are shaped by the input expression. It then builds a relation-aware slot graph with language-conditioned edge weighting to propagate target-reference, attribute, part-whole, and contextual evidence. A granularity-adaptive router softly combines region-level, object-level, part-level, attribute-aware, and relation-aware mask branches, followed by relation-constrained refinement for spatial, part-whole, attribute, and geometric consistency. QAGaussian is pretrained only on Mosaic3D-5.6M for Gaussian-text alignment and evaluated on independent benchmarks without target-dataset fine-tuning. It achieves 47.2 Avg. mIoU and 63.2 Avg. F1, outperforming the strongest 3DGS referring baseline by 2.7 mIoU points and 2.9 F1 points. It also improves Part-mIoU from 38.6 to 43.4, Rel-mIoU from 44.4 to 50.8, and reduces target-reference confusion from 10.8 to 7.4. These results demonstrate that query-conditioned slot learning, relation-aware graph reasoning, and adaptive routing provide an effective neural modeling strategy for open-vocabulary referring segmentation in 3DGS. The code is available at https://github.com/zqeslwyz/QAGaussian.

</details>


### [145] [Nexus: Structured Synergy for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation using Rectified Flow Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16104)
*Yizhao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Nexus是一个集成稀疏架构、线性复杂度和低比特量化的文本到图像生成模型，通过MoE前馈层、门控DeltaNet注意力机制和逐专家低比特训练来降低计算量和内存占用，在保持与SDXL和SD3相当生成质量的同时显著提升推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配模型在文本到图像生成上取得显著进展，但高计算开销、二次复杂度和大内存占用阻碍了高分辨率合成和边缘设备部署，需要更高效的模型架构。

Method: Nexus整合了三种技术：1) MoE（混合专家）前馈层实现稀疏架构；2) 门控DeltaNet注意力实现线性复杂度；3) 逐专家低比特训练实现低比特量化。三者的联合优化在减少计算和内存的同时保持生成质量。

Result: 在COCO和LAION数据集上的实验表明，Nexus在生成质量上可与SDXL和SD3等主流模型相媲美，同时具有显著更高的推理效率。

Conclusion: 通过稀疏架构、线性复杂度和低比特量化的联合优化，Nexus证明了在不牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅提升推理效率的可行性，为高分辨率合成和边缘部署提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models have made significant progress in text-to-image generation, yet high computation, quadratic complexity, and large memory footprint hinder high-resolution synthesis and edge deployment. We propose Nexus, which integrates sparse architecture, linear complexity, and low-bit quantization. It combines MoE feed-forward layers, gated DeltaNet attention, and per-expert low-bit training to reduce computation and memory. Their joint optimization allows Nexus to achieve generation quality comparable to mainstream models such as SDXL and SD3 while delivering markedly higher inference efficiency. Experiments on COCO and LAION validate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [146] [SUGFW+: An Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting Framework for Cold Start Active Adaptation of SAM in Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16110)
*Xiaochuan Ma,Ning Zhu,Jia Fu,Lanfeng Zhong,Hanyu Jiang,Bin Song,Kang Li,Guotai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SUGFW+框架，利用Segment Anything Model（SAM）的预训练嵌入进行医学图像分割的冷启动主动学习（CSAL）。该方法通过补丁级特征与不确定性计算、全局判别表示模块以及贪心选择策略来挑选最具价值的样本进行标注，并通过不确定性提示微调紧密集成样本选择与模型训练两个阶段，在四个公开数据集上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CSAL方法依赖数据集特定的自监督学习（SSL）来映射特征，效率低下且泛化性差。尽管SAM等基础模型提供了强泛化能力的预训练嵌入，但如何系统性地利用SAM的固有嵌入进行低标注预算下的冷启动样本选择仍未被充分探索。

Method: SUGFW+框架包含四个核心组件：(1) 利用SAM进行补丁级特征与不确定性计算（PFUC）；(2) 补丁级全局判别表示模块（PGDR），将补丁级嵌入聚合成具有判别力和不确定性感知的图像级特征；(3) 结合多样性与不确定性的贪心选择策略（GSCU）进行样本选择；(4) 不确定性提示微调（UPFT）过程，将样本选择与SAM模型训练紧密集成。

Result: 在四个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，SUGFW+相比现有CSAL方法取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: SUGFW+证明了基础模型（SAM）的预训练嵌入可以有效替代数据集特定的自监督学习用于冷启动样本选择，且将样本选择与模型训练紧密集成比解耦两个阶段的方法更有效。

Abstract: Cold Start Active Learning (CSAL) is important in improving the performance of a medical image segmentation model with low annotation budget by querying a small subset for annotation from an unlabeled training set. Existing CSAL methods typically rely on inefficient dataset-specific Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) to map the unlabeled images into a feature space for sample selection. Recently, the advent of foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) offer a promising alternative as the pre-trained model can provide strong generalizable feature embeddings, and allow high performance in downstream tasks after fine-tuning (adaptation). However, how to systematically exploit SAM's inherent embeddings for cold-start sample selection during adaptation with low annotation budget remains underexplored. To address this, we propose an extended SAM-based Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting (SUGFW+) framework for CSAL and adaptation of SAM. Specifically, it leverages the SAM for Patch-level Feature and Uncertainty Calculation (PFUC), and introduces a Patch-based Global Distinct Representation (PGDR) module that aggregates patch-level embeddings into highly discriminative, uncertainty-aware image-level features. These features are then utilized by a Greedy Selection with Cluster and Uncertainty (GSCU) strategy to combine diversity and uncertainty during sample selection. Unlike prior CSAL methods that decouple sample selection from model training, SUGFW+ tightly integrates these two stages via an Uncertainty-Prompted Fine-Tuning (UPFT) process of SAM in model training. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that SUGFW+ achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing CSAL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/HiLab-git/SUGFW-plus.

</details>


### [147] [TokenSTFormer: A Tokenized Spatial-temporal Attention Model for Holistic Motion Analysis in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16122)
*Dong Chen,Kenneth M. C. Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了ScoliGait数据集（含1,516个步态视频片段及对应X光记录）和TokenSTFormer模型，通过令牌化时空语义来增强特征表示与收敛，模型在关键指标上超越vanilla Vision Transformer，准确率达0.79，展示了基于步态视频和注意力模型的规模化、低成本青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）筛查潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青少年特发性脊柱侧弯（AIS）是常见的脊柱畸形，若未及时治疗可能导致严重后果。传统筛查方法存在主观解读、依赖专业经验、可扩展性低等问题，亟需开发更客观、可规模化的筛查方案。

Method: 构建了ScoliGait数据集，包含1,516个与X光记录配对的步态视频片段；提出了TokenSTFormer模型，通过令牌化时空语义来增强特征表示和模型收敛能力，利用注意力机制从步态视频中提取整体运动特征。

Result: TokenSTFormer在关键指标上达到最先进水平，超越vanilla Vision Transformer编码器，准确率达0.79。

Conclusion: 该研究证明利用步态视频的整体运动特征和基于注意力的模型可实现可扩展、低成本的AIS筛查，为未来脊柱侧弯检测的临床应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) is a prevalent spinal deformity in adolescents that, if left untreated, can result in severe health outcomes. Traditional screening methods are limited by subjective interpretation, reliance on professional expertise and low scalability. To address these challenges, we present ScoliGait dataset, which comprises 1,516 gait video clips paired with corresponding X-ray records. We also introduce TokenSTFormer, a novel model that tokenizes spatial and temporal semantics to enhance feature representation and convergence. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing vanilla Vision Transformer encoder across key metrics, including accuracy of 0.79. This study highlights the potential of leveraging holistic motion features derived from gait video and attention-based models for scalable, cost-effective AIS screening, paving the way for future clinical applications in scoliosis detection.

</details>


### [148] [Graph Neural Assisted Actor-Critic for Latency-Efficient Edge Vision System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16142)
*Alam Noor,Luis Almeida,Kai Li,Jiyan Wu,Miguel Gutiérrez Gaitán,Eduardo Tovar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种GCN辅助A2C的深度强化学习系统模型，用于无人机视频传输中优化可疑目标的像素相关区域选择，从而降低传输时延，实验证明该方法在降低时延和误检率方面优于其他DRL和最新模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机视觉系统在禁飞区监控中需要将视频流传输到地面服务器供操作员协助，但视频传输时延严重影响操作效率，现有视频传输技术仍存在显著的时延成本。

Method: 提出GCN辅助A2C的深度强化学习系统模型，结合Lagrangian对偶形式和梯度下降防止收敛性问题及约束违反；通过GCN探索像素特征相关组的隐藏表示，并监督A2C模型选择子组像素相关区域进行传输，而非传输整个视频帧。

Result: 实验结果表明，GCN辅助A2C在无人机视觉系统中相比其他DRL和最新模型，显著降低了视频帧传输时延和误检率。

Conclusion: 通过仅传输可疑目标的子组像素相关区域而非完整视频帧，结合GCN辅助A2C的强化学习框架，可以有效提升无人机视频传输效率，降低时延和误检率。

Abstract: UAV on-board vision systems are widely used for different activities, including monitoring in no-fly zones. In this case, the vision-equipped UAV streams a video to a ground server where an operator assists its activities. The latency of video transmission has a profound impact on the effectiveness of the operator assistance. However, most techniques available for video transmission still incur significant latency costs. In this paper, we propose a graph convolutional neural network-assisted (GCN-Assisted A2C) deep reinforcement learning (DRL) system model to find the optimal pixel-correlated area of a suspicious object. We combine the Lagrangian dual form with gradient descent to prevent lack of convergence and over- and under-penalization constraint violation during latency optimization. The proposed system model sends a sub-group pixel-correlated area of the frame from the UAV to the server rather than the transmission of the whole video frame. The proposed framework utilizes the GCN model to explore hidden representations of feature-correlated groups of pixels. Moreover, the GCN supervises the A2C model, which selects a subgroup to enhance transmission latency, thus supervising the training of UAV actions in A2C. Experimental results show that GCN-assisted A2C reduces video frame transmission latency together with false detection rate in UAV vision systems over other DRL and state-of-the-art models.

</details>


### [149] [The Right Prior for the Right Deformation: Rethinking Continuous Deformable Image Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16146)
*Hengjie Liu,Chushu Shen,Dan Ruan,Ke Sheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对连续可变形图像配准方法进行了验证性研究，比较了B-Spline变换（基于控制点结构的隐式先验）与INR-based方法（基于神经参数化的隐式先验）在不同配准任务上的表现。实验发现，配准精度高度依赖于变形先验与目标运动模式是否匹配，多分辨率B-Spline方法（MR-D-BSCP）在跨任务中表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形配准模型通过参数化和优化隐式地编码变形先验，但不同方法（B-Spline vs INR-based）引入的先验如何影响跨任务性能尚缺乏系统性验证。理解这种先验-任务匹配关系对于指导配准方法设计至关重要。

Method: 对比四种连续参数化配准方法：INR-Dense（IDIR，用SIREN直接建模稠密位移场）、INR-BSCP（SINR，用INR预测B-Spline控制点）、D-BSCP（直接优化单尺度B-Spline控制点）、MR-D-BSCP（多分辨率粗到细B-Spline方案）。在OASIS脑MR（中等但局部复杂的形变）和DIR-LAB 4DCT肺CT（大且更一致的呼吸运动）两个数据集上验证。

Result: 在OASIS上D-BSCP匹配或略优于INR-BSCP，说明B-Spline参数化贡献了INR-BSCP大部分有效性；在DIR-LAB上单尺度B-Spline方法较差，而INR-Dense和MR-D-BSCP更有效；MR-D-BSCP在两个任务上均取得最佳性能。

Conclusion: 配准精度强烈依赖于变形先验与目标运动模式的匹配，将先验与变形模式对齐应作为医学图像配准的实用设计原则。多分辨率B-Spline方案提供了一个鲁棒的通用选择。

Abstract: Deformable image registration models implicitly encode deformation priors through their parametrization and optimization. In this work, we conduct a validation study on continuous registration methods to examine how these implicit priors affect performance across different registration tasks. Classic B-Spline transformations impose locality, smoothness, and scale through their control-point structure, whereas recent INR-based methods impose different priors through neural parameterization and optimization.
