<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球有超过100种不同的手语，但针对大多数手语的识别资源严重匮乏。为改善听力障碍者的沟通体验，需要利用资源丰富的语言（如ASL）数据通过迁移学习来帮助资源匮乏的手语识别。

Method: 采用域自适应方法TA3N，该方法利用时间关系网络（TRN）模块对齐源域和目标域之间的多尺度时间关系。实验比较了域自适应与基于神经网络的迁移学习的效果，并分别使用RGB和光流（Optical Flow）两种输入模式进行实验。

Result: 研究发现域自适应方法在识别美国手语（ASL）方面优于基于神经网络的迁移学习；对齐短期时间特征比长期特征更有效；RGB模式在多数情况下优于光流模式。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了域自适应方法在手语识别迁移学习中的优越性，为资源匮乏的手语识别提供了可行方案，最终目标是改善依赖手语作为主要沟通方式的群体的可及性和交流体验。

Abstract: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility and communication for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.

</details>


### [515] [Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16813)
*Steve Brown*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Quipu是一个嵌入式知识图谱存储系统，通过反转人类时代的四大默认设置（接受后清理、单一时间轴、等信任所有作者、治理外包给仪表盘）来适应智能体工作负载。它采用门控写入、双时态数据、以命名图为信任单元的组合格、以及治理规范作为存储在库中的事实，使审计变成了查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的知识图谱存储系统仍然基于人类策划时代的默认设计：接受写入后清理、单一或无时间轴、平等信任所有作者的陈述、治理依赖仪表盘和中间件。在智能体工作负载下，这四个默认设置单独看很方便，但组合起来就不可行，因为没有门控机制、没有双时态、无法区分信任来源、审计也困难。

Method: Quipu反转了所有四个默认：1) 每条事实必须通过门控，门控的谓词评估待提交的后状态；2) 数据、信任标签、裁决和规则本身都是双时态的；3) 命名图是权威和信任的单位，在格下组合，其唯一不变量是组合永不扩大；4) 治理规范Σ、轨迹和签名裁决是所治理存储中的事实，使审计T⊨Σ成为查询。评估使用Census确定性多写入者生命周期基准和DEMM-Bench外部基准。

Result: 在Census基准上：门控存储以0/6的植入缺陷结束，非门控为6/6；所有7个组合探针都满足格合约；50/50的满意裁决按时点忠实重导出，而最新规则集下全部50个都会被误报；SARC参考检查器与库内审计逐裁决一致。在DEMM-Bench上：内容解读在全部8种退化条件下正确回答全部512个治理问题且零过度声称，而容器存在基线在多达87.5%的问题上过度声称。还发现并关闭了拒绝裁决证明中的一个缺口。

Conclusion: Quipu证明了对知识图谱存储的全面重新设计是必要且可行的，使治理内生于存储而非外挂。通过将审计变为查询、治理规范作为存储事实，它能让智能体工作负载下的知识图谱具备可验证的信任和合规性。同时暴露了现有基线在过度声称方面的严重缺陷。

Abstract: Agents now write knowledge graphs, but knowledge-graph stores still carry defaults set when humans curated them: accept writes now and clean later, keep one time axis or none, treat every writer's facts as equally trustworthy, and leave governance to dashboards and middleware. These four defaults are individually convenient and jointly untenable under agent workloads. We present Quipu, an embeddable store that inverts all four: no fact enters except through a gate whose predicates evaluate the pending post-state; data, trust labels, verdicts, and the rules themselves are bitemporal; named graphs are the unit of authority and trust, composed under a lattice whose one invariant is that composition never widens; and the governance specification $Σ$, the trace, and signed verdicts are facts in the store they govern, making the audit $T \models Σ$ a query. We evaluate with Census, a deterministic multi-writer lifecycle whose single seeded run scores every research question against planted ground truth: the gated store ends with 0 of 6 planted defects versus 6 of 6 ungated; all 7 composition probes uphold the lattice contract; 50 of 50 satisfied verdicts re-derive faithfully as of their instant while all 50 would be misreported under a latest-only rule set; and the SARC reference checker agrees with the in-store audit verdict-for-verdict, differing only on coverage semantics. A recorded trace from a governed writer surfaces a live enforcement gap the audit names with its remediation. On DEMM-Bench, an external decision-evidence sufficiency benchmark, a content-only reading of the exported records answers all 512 property-level governance questions correctly with zero overclaim under all eight degradation conditions, while container-presence baselines overclaim on up to 87.5% of them -- and the run surfaced, and led us to close, a gap in what a denial's verdict attests.

</details>


### [516] [What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16852)
*Saisab Sadhu,Aadit Sengupta,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu,Pratinav Seth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现当前法规合规检测器存在"规则盲区"（rule blindness）：删除、置换或替换规则文本不会改变检测结果，检测器依赖场景表面特征而非规则本身。作者提出跨规则基准证实此问题，并引入训练免费的内部合规得分（ICS）用于审计，但ICS在严格标准下未优于朴素基线，仅在排序候选响应时有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法规合规监控在部署语言模型中日益成为法律和审计控制手段，其有效性前提是检测器判定必须依赖明确的规则文本而非场景表面特征。作者旨在检验这一前提是否成立，并指出当前检测器类别普遍失败。

Method: （1）构建跨两条规则×两场景的基准，确保单独任何一方都无法预测标签；（2）提出内部合规得分（ICS），一种训练免费的激活读数，仅用十个标注对校准、单投影打分；（3）采用反事实协议测试规则文本删除/置换/替换对检测器的影响；对ICS进行预注册的严格评判，并与词袋模型对比。

Result: 所有被测试的护栏和激活探针（包括能正确引用规则条款的策略条件护栏）在面对规则文本被替换为允许性对应物时，判定几乎不变。逐步推理是唯一能摆脱规则盲区的方法。ICS未达到超越朴素基线的预注册标准，词袋模型与其池化泛化表现完全一致，但ICS成本低，可审计四个部署护栏、8B零样本裁判和十三个基准；用于排序候选响应时可提高机械验证的通过率，但自适应白盒攻击可消除此增益。

Conclusion: 当前合规检测器普遍存在规则盲区，需要依赖逐步推理才能克服。ICS虽在严格标准下不优于基线，但其低成本特性使其仍具备审计实用性。作者发布反事实协议和跨规则基准，供未来探针和护栏声明测试规则盲区。

Abstract: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [517] [BRA-Audit: Budgeted Runtime Auditing for LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Cumulative-Exposure Audit-Point Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14668)
*Kaixiang Wang,Yidan Lin,Jiong Lou,Jie Li*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出BRA-Audit，一个预算感知的运行时审计框架，通过将多智能体系统执行建模为动态依赖图，并在固定审计调用预算下优化审计点放置以最小化累积未检查暴露量，从而在保持防护性能的同时大幅降低token消耗（减少17.2%-40.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统中，智能体间的依赖关系会将幻觉或恶意输出传播为系统性失败。现有的审计策略存在效率困境：仅在最后审计会因轨迹过长而削弱审计效果并扩大回滚范围，而每轮审计所有智能体虽然检测定位效果好但token成本高昂。因此需要在保持防护性能的同时最小化token成本。

Method: 提出BRA-Audit框架：(1) 将MAS执行建模为动态依赖图；(2) 将审计调度形式化为在固定审计调用预算下的审计点放置问题，目标是最小化累积未检查暴露量；(3) 采用贪婪调度器，优先审计影响力大且长时间未被审计的区域；(4) 设置可信审计点以实现局部化恢复。

Result: 在结构化协调、复杂推理和开放式任务中，BRA-Audit能够将性能恢复到接近无干扰的干净设置水平，与重量级防护方法相比具有竞争力，并将端到端token消耗降低了17.2%-40.6%。

Conclusion: BRA-Audit证明了在预算约束下通过智能审计点调度，可以在多智能体系统中有效平衡防护性能与token成本，为LLM-MAS的安全运行时治理提供了一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) solve complex tasks through specialized collaboration, but inter-agent dependencies can propagate hallucinated or malicious outputs into system-level failures. Auditor agents mitigate these risks, yet existing strategies face an efficiency dilemma: end-only auditing reviews long trajectories and final outputs, potentially weakening audit effectiveness and enlarging rollback scope, while auditing every agent each round improves detection and localization at high token cost. How can guard performance be preserved while minimizing token cost? To address this problem, we propose BRA-Audit, a budget-aware runtime auditing framework that models MAS execution as a dynamic dependency graph and formulates audit scheduling as audit-point placement under a fixed audit-call budget to minimize cumulative unchecked exposure. Its greedy scheduler prioritizes influential and long-unaudited regions, while trusted audit points enable localized recovery. Across structured coordination, complex reasoning, and open-ended tasks, BRA-Audit restores performance close to the clean setting, remains competitive with heavy guard methods and reduces end-to-end token consumption by \(17.2\%\)--\(40.6\%\).

</details>


### [518] [Emergent Misaligned Communication in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent LLM Commerce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14825)
*Zeyuan Li,Lukas Petersson,Alessandro Acquisti,Michiel A. Bakker*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本研究通过在Vending-Bench Arena（一个包含13个前沿LLM的竞争性自动售货环境）中的20轮一年期模拟，分析了2,583封智能体间邮件，发现12.6%的邮件存在言语行为错位（含虚假陈述、操纵、合谋或威胁），且这种错位与操作资源稀缺和对手行为相关，而非仅由模型能力决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全文献主要通过对抗性诱导评估研究单智能体或风格化任务中的LLM不当行为，但在结合长时程、独立委托人、真实操作状态和智能体间自然语言交互的实际场景中，错位行为的普遍性和结构尚未得到充分测量。

Method: 在Vending-Bench Arena中运行20次一年期模拟，收集13个前沿LLM之间的2,583封邮件。将言语行为错位操作化为包含虚假事实陈述、操纵、合谋或威胁的邮件，结合消息内容、模拟器真值状态和推理轨迹进行分类和验证。并通过改变采样温度和更换裁判模型族进行稳健性检验。

Result: 主要分类器下12.6%邮件被标记为错位，出现在所有20轮运行和74.7%的智能体运行中。错位具有互惠性（收到错位邮件使回应错位概率提高1.65倍）和压力条件性（低库存状态提高1.58倍）。未发现能力不对称利用的证据，模型性能排名不能预测错位率。

Conclusion: 可测量的、状态依赖的错位行为可以在无需工程化诱导的竞争性多智能体环境中自然产生，其模式与操作稀缺性和对手行为相关，而非仅由模型能力决定。

Abstract: Frontier LLM agents increasingly transact on behalf of separate principals, often using natural language rather than structured APIs. Much of the safety literature studies misaligned LLM behavior through adversarial-elicitation evaluations on single agents or stylized tasks. Its prevalence and structure in settings that combine long horizons, separate principals, real operational state, and inter-agent natural-language exchange remain insufficiently measured. We study 2,583 inter-agent emails from 20 one-year simulation runs of Vending-Bench Arena, a competitive vending environment spanning 13 frontier LLMs. We operationalize speech-act misalignment as emails containing false factual claims, manipulation, collusion, or threats, combining message content with ground-truth simulator state and logged reasoning traces to classify and validate such behavior. Under our primary classifier, 12.6% of emails are labeled misaligned; misalignment appears in all 20 runs and 74.7% of individual agent-runs. Both the magnitude and composition of this misalignment are preserved under repeated classification at different sampling temperatures and under full-pipeline replication with judges from two other frontier-model families. Misalignment is also reciprocal and stress-conditioned: receiving a misaligned email from a counterparty raises the odds of a misaligned reply by 1.65x, and low-inventory conditions raise them by 1.58x. Across tests of capability-asymmetric exploitation, we find no evidence that higher-capability models differentially exploit weaker counterparties, and model performance rank does not predict misalignment rates. Together, these results indicate that measurable, state-dependent misalignment can arise in competitive multi-agent environments without engineered elicitation, in patterns associated with operational scarcity and counterparty behavior rather than model capability alone.

</details>


### [519] [Insurance as AI Risk Infrastructure: A Generative-Agent Simulation of AI Adoption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15181)
*Yixuan Yuan,Dedai Wei,Chudong Qian,Jielin Feng,Ziyue Lin,Yuheng Zhao,He Cao,Erasmo Purificato,Xinwu Ye*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出一个社会经济框架，通过保险机制来转移和吸收AI采用过程中残留的尾部财务损失，并开发了基于LLM的智能体社会模拟系统（LABSS）来评估这一框架的有效性，结果表明该保险框架能降低企业财务风险、加速AI工具的采用并改善企业偿付能力和总资本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统（尤其是LLM）具有不可靠性和不确定的操作后果，成为企业采用AI的主要障碍。现有技术保障措施主要降低AI工作流故障的可能性和严重性，但无法在残留的金钱尾部损失发生时提供事后财务保护，因此缺乏对企业的经济保障机制。

Method: 提出一个社会经济框架，通过保险来转移和吸收AI采用后的残余财务后果，与技术保障措施互补。为评估该框架，开发了基于LLM驱动的智能体社会模拟系统（LABSS），并利用既有的经济和社会学理论对模拟的行为有效性进行验证。

Result: 分析表明，所提出的保险框架能够降低企业层面的财务风险敞口，从而加速AI工具的总体采用，并改善企业的偿付能力和总体资本水平。

Conclusion: 保险作为一种社会经济机制，可以有效补充现有的技术保障手段，通过财务风险转移来促进AI技术在企业的深度整合与应用，为AI采用提供更具韧性的经济支撑体系。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) tools has demonstrated immense potential to enhance societal well-being and operational efficiency. However, the inherent unreliability and uncertain operational consequences of modern AI systems, typified by large language models (LLMs), have created a significant barrier to enterprise adoption. Many enterprises remain hesitant to integrate these tools deeply into their workflows due to concerns about unpredictable losses and liability exposure. While existing technical safeguards primarily seek to reduce the likelihood or severity of AI-enabled workflow failures, they do not by themselves provide ex post financial protection when residual pecuniary tail losses materialize. In this paper, we introduce a socio-economic framework that complements these safeguards by transferring and absorbing the residual financial consequences of AI adoption through insurance. To evaluate this framework, we develop an LLM-driven agent-based social simulation (LABSS) system. We assess the behavioral validity of the simulation using established economic and sociological theories. Our analysis demonstrates that the proposed insurance framework reduces firm-level financial exposure, thereby accelerating the aggregate adoption of AI tools and improving firm solvency and aggregate capital.

</details>


### [520] [ETHOS: Towards a Modular Ethics Framework for Clinical Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15424)
*Rakesh Sharma,Sydney Pugh,Cameron Beeche,Pankhuri Singhal,Rachel Wu,Margaret Eby,Jeffrey Duda,James Gee,Kyra O'Brien,Hersh Sagreiya,Marina Serper,Victoria Gershuni,Angela Bradbury,Anurag Verma,Eric Eaton,Kevin B. Johnson,Walter Witschey*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: ETHOS是一个模块化伦理治理框架，作为治理元代理集成到任何现有的临床多智能体系统中，通过分层治理（确定性检查、上下文审查、最终伦理批评）持续评估推理步骤和输出，将高层AI伦理原则转化为可执行的运行时监督，并在肝胆病学临床决策支持系统中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型驱动的临床多智能体系统虽然能力强大，但在真实医疗环境中的部署面临安全性、公平性、问责性、透明度和患者信任等关键伦理问题。尽管WHO、美国国家医学科学院和FUTURE-AI联盟等组织提出了伦理框架和治理原则，但这些努力大多停留在概念层面，缺乏可在运行时实际执行和监督的机制。

Method: ETHOS采用模块化治理元代理架构，无需改变底层多智能体系统的架构即可集成。它通过分层治理方法实现运行时监督：（1）确定性检查（deterministic checks）、（2）上下文审查（contextual reviews）、（3）最终伦理批评（final ethics critic）。这些组件持续评估中间推理步骤和最终输出，能够识别伦理风险、请求修订，或抑制未通过安全和可信度标准的响应。

Result: 在肝胆病学临床决策支持多智能体系统中验证ETHOS，结果表明它通过检测不完整、不一致或超出范围的证据来提高决策可靠性，并在无法支持安全建议时适当地增加弃权（abstention）行为。

Conclusion: 通过将伦理治理直接嵌入系统运行过程，ETHOS提供了一种实用且可审计的机制，将高层次的AI伦理原则转化为可部署的安全保障措施，弥合了伦理框架与实际系统部署之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: The rapid adoption of large language models has enabled the development of clinical multi-agent systems (MAS) capable of integrating multimodal patient data and supporting increasingly complex clinical decision-making. However, the deployment of these systems in real-world healthcare settings raises critical ethical concerns related to safety, fairness, accountability, transparency, and patient trust. While numerous organizations, including the World Health Organization, the National Academy of Medicine, and the FUTURE-AI consortium, have proposed ethical frameworks and governance principles for healthcare AI, these efforts remain largely conceptual. To address this challenge, we present ETHOS (Ethics and Trust through Hierarchical Oversight System), a modular ethics framework designed as a governance meta-agent that can be integrated with any existing multi-agent system without requiring changes to its underlying architecture. ETHOS translates stakeholder-informed ethical requirements into executable runtime oversight through a layered governance approach consisting of deterministic checks, contextual reviews, and a final ethics critic. These components continuously evaluate intermediate reasoning steps and final outputs, enabling the system to identify ethical risks, request revisions, or suppress responses that fail predefined safety and trustworthiness criteria. We demonstrate ETHOS within a hepatology clinical decision-support MAS. Results show that ETHOS improves decision reliability by detecting incomplete, inconsistent, or out-of-scope evidence and appropriately increasing abstention when safe recommendations cannot be supported. By embedding ethical governance directly into system operation, ETHOS provides a practical and auditable mechanism for transforming high-level AI ethics principles into deployable safeguards.

</details>


### [521] [KC-BFPRL: Knowledge-Guided Multi-UAV Collaboration for Grassland Restoration via Bilevel Formerpointer-Based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16326)
*Dongbin Jiao,Xianyi Wang,Yuchen Yuan,Weibo Yang,Peng Yang,Peng Zhao,Zhanhuan Shang,Shi Yan*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出一种知识引导的协作双层指针强化学习框架（KC-BFPRL），用于解决多无人机草原生态系统恢复中的恢复面积最大化问题（RAMP）。该框架采用分层范式将RAMP分解为全局任务分配和局部恢复规划，结合Transformer编码器与Pointer Network解码器，并通过嵌入生态优先级规则和启发式逻辑实现结构化冷启动。实验表明KC-BFPRL在复杂场景中达到0.00%最优性差距，运行速度比基线快近3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多无人机系统可扩展地服务于大规模环境任务（如草原生态恢复），但团队调度需要解决恢复面积最大化问题（RAMP）。该非线性组合优化挑战因载荷相关的能量动态和异质生态退化而变得复杂，现有方法难以有效求解。

Method: 提出KC-BFPRL框架，采用分层范式将RAMP分解为全局任务分配和局部恢复规划，其中局部规划进一步分为上层轨迹规划和下层恢复面积分配。架构包含Transformer编码器（融合静态环境特征与动态UAV状态）和Pointer Network解码器（通过鲁棒的actor-critic框架训练），并通过嵌入生态优先级规则和启发式逻辑实现结构化热启动，解决RL冷启动问题并保证严格约束满足。

Result: 大量实验表明KC-BFPRL持续优于最先进的基线方法，获得更优目标值和更高效率。在最复杂场景U8-R160中保持0.00%最优性差距，运行速度比MAPDP快近3倍，验证了其鲁棒性、可扩展性和实时适用性。

Conclusion: KC-BFPRL有效解决了多无人机生态恢复任务中RAMP的复杂性，在解质量和计算效率上都显著优于现有方法，为大规模自动化生态恢复提供了可靠的实时解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) systems provide scalable service platforms for large-scale environmental tasks, such as grassland ecosystem restoration. However, coordinating fleet operations requires solving the restoration area maximization problem (RAMP). This non-linear combinatorial optimization challenge is complicated by payload-dependent energy dynamics and heterogeneous ecological degradation. We propose a novel knowledge-guided collaborative bilevel formerpointer reinforcement learning framework (KC-BFPRL) to address this complexity. Using a hierarchical paradigm, KC-BFPRL decomposes RAMP into global task allocation and local restoration planning, with the latter further divided into upper-level trajectory planning and lower-level restoration area allocation. Our specialized architecture pairs featuring a Transformer-based encoder that fuses static environmental features with dynamic UAV states, and a Pointer Network decoder trained via a robust actor-critic framework. By embedding ecological priority rules and heuristic logic, KC-BFPRL achieves a structured warm-start, solving the RL cold-start problem while ensuring strict constraint satisfaction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KC-BFPRL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior objective values and efficiency. It maintains a $0.00\%$ optimality gap in the most complex scenarios U8-R160 and operates nearly three times faster than MAPDP, validating its robustness, scalability, and real-time applicability for large-scale automated ecological restoration.

</details>


### [522] [VCE-Skill: Enhancing Skill Self-Evolution with Version-Change Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16544)
*Jianming Chen,Xuanbin Ye,Yawen Wang,Junjie Wang,Qing Wang,Fanjiang XU*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: VCE-Skill是一种技能自进化方法，通过从公共技能版本历史中提炼可复用的版本变化经验，并与当前任务的执行轨迹证据自适应融合，从而提升技能进化效果（平均分数提升3.20-4.98分）并增强跨模型迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能自进化方法仅利用当前任务执行轨迹来修订技能，忽略了公共技能版本历史中积累的进化知识。作者通过试点研究发现，公共技能变化提供了可复用的进化先验，而轨迹提供了当前任务的接地证据，两者具有互补性。

Method: 提出VCE-Skill方法：1) 将嘈杂且实现特定的公共技能变化蒸馏为可复用的、结构化的版本变化经验；2) 将这种外部经验与基础进化器从轨迹中推导出的候选提议进行自适应融合，既利用外部经验又保留任务特定证据。

Result: 大量实验表明VCE-Skill提升了技能自进化效果，平均分数提高3.20-4.98分；迁移实验进一步表明生成的技能具有更强的跨模型迁移性能。

Conclusion: 公共技能版本变化是此前未被充分开发但有效的先验知识来源，该工作推进了轨迹驱动的技能自进化方向。

Abstract: Agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to encode task knowledge, tool-use procedures, and validation rules. Existing skill self-evolution methods primarily revise skills using execution trajectories collected from current tasks, leaving the evolution knowledge accumulated in public skill version histories largely untapped. Our pilot study reveals a clear complementarity between the two sources: public skill changes provide reusable evolution priors, whereas trajectories provide evidence grounded in the current task. Motivated by this, we propose VCE-Skill, which distills noisy and implementation-specific public skill changes into reusable, structured version-change experience and adaptively fuses it with trajectory-derived proposals from the base evolver, thereby exploiting external experience while retaining task-specific evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VCE-Skill improves skill self-evolution, increasing mean scores by 3.20--4.98 points; transfer experiments further show that the resulting skills achieve stronger cross-model transfer performance. Our work highlights public skill version changes as a previously underexplored yet effective source of prior knowledge and advances trajectory-driven skill self-evolution.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

### [523] [Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14556)
*Dongzhe Zheng,Christine Allen-Blanchette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了黎曼Hodge消息传递（RHMP），将物理场中拓扑与几何的分离作为架构原则：固定细胞余边界算子（拓扑），学习对称正定余链度量（几何），通过度量加权的Hodge模块实现传播，在七个物理基准上取得最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理场在网格上需要区分拓扑与几何：守恒律是拓扑性的且应精确成立，而几何、材料响应及各向异性耦合需要从数据中学习。现有的神经代理模型常通过无约束的消息传递混合这两者的角色，导致拓扑性质不精确。

Method: RHMP将拓扑与几何的分离转化为架构原则：固定由有向关联确定的细胞余边界算子d_k，学习对称正定余链度量H_k用于几何依赖的传播。引入余链框架等变性，使用度量加权Hodge模块(d_k^T H_{k+1} d_k)实现消息传递，确保精确的余链复形恒等式、非负Hodge能量、半正定算子及精确的阿贝尔曲率不变性。

Result: 在涵盖流体、电磁学、规范场和变网格CFD的七个物理基准上，RHMP取得最佳整体性能，在拓扑、学习几何与场结构相互作用的场景中提升最为显著。

Conclusion: 将拓扑与几何分离作为消息传递的架构性原则是有效的，RHMP通过固定拓扑算子并学习几何度量，在保持精确物理恒等式的同时取得了优越的经验性能，证明了这种结构化设计对于物理神经代理的价值。

Abstract: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies, positive-semidefinite operators, and exact Abelian curvature invariance. Across seven physical benchmarks spanning fluids, electromagnetism, gauge fields, and variable-mesh CFD, RHMP achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains when topology, learned geometry, and field structure interact.

</details>


### [524] [Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14563)
*Rivaan Patil,Simon Dennis,Hao Guo,Kevin Shabahang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种仅前向传播的MLP训练方法（FPO），无需通过模型主体进行反向传播，即可适配大型语言模型。FPO实现了标准微调2.7-3.2倍的吞吐量，峰值训练内存降低约40%，同时在非领域基准测试上保持在与基线仅差种子噪声以内的表现。该方法基于一个经验观察：在Transformer的后期层中，输出层预测误差与真实梯度的余弦相似度可达0.47-0.59。作者提出一个两分钟的诊断方法，可量化每一层的这种近似程度，从而确定后期层适配的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准全网络微调（Full-Network Fine-tuning）虽然有效，但需要完整的反向传播，计算成本高且内存开销大。同时，全网络微调可能对非领域基准测试产生不可靠的影响。作者希望找到一种更高效的替代方案，既能降低训练成本，又能保持模型在非目标领域的性能稳定性。

Method: 1. 提出关键经验观察：在大模型后期层中，输出层预测误差可作为梯度的近似替代（余弦相似度0.47-0.59）。\n2. 设计两分钟诊断方法，逐层量化这一近似的可行性。\n3. FPO在输出处计算单一误差信号，并将其应用于每个目标层，层间不传递信号，不构建任何autograd图。\n4. 在三个模型家族（OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-8B、Falcon3-7B）上进行评估。

Result: 1. FPO在三个模型家族上均产生域内困惑度的改善。\n2. MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag和Winogrande均保持在种子噪声以内的水平。\n3. 吞吐量为标准微调的2.7-3.2倍，峰值内存降低约40%。\n4. 将SFT局部化到FPO的目标层也能进入该状态，但墙钟时间成本是FPO的2.2倍。

Conclusion: FPO证明了仅依赖前向传播即可实现有效的大模型适配，大幅降低了训练资源需求，同时保持下游基准稳定性。该方法为大模型高效适配提供了新范式，尤其适合资源受限或需要快速迭代的场景。

Abstract: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. No signal is propagated between layers, and no autograd graph is constructed at any point. We evaluate FPO on three model families (OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B). Across all three, FPO produces in-domain perplexity improvement and leaves MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and Winogrande within seed-noise of baseline. Localizing SFT to FPO's target layers to enter this regime is also feasible, but at 2.2x the wall-clock cost of FPO.

</details>


### [525] [Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models for Trajectory Generation in Urban Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14570)
*Wen Ye,Muyan Weng,Chuizheng Meng,Hao Niu,Yizhou Zhang,Yan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出MR-Traj，一种多分辨率扩散框架用于大规模轨迹生成。它将轨迹建模为粗粒度节点与细粒度片段的组合，以捕捉多尺度的时空依赖。实验表明，MR-Traj在全局分布相似性上与前沿方法相当，同时在细粒度移动模式建模和下游任务支持上表现更优，并通过多分辨率随机性提升轨迹多样性、降低链接风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成轨迹生成方法主要关注匹配全局分布相似性，忽略了不同时空分辨率下的移动模式，而这些模式对实际应用（如交通管理、流行病控制、城市规划）至关重要。此外，大规模真实轨迹数据因隐私问题难以获取，亟需能生成高实用性轨迹的方法。

Method: 提出MR-Traj多分辨率扩散框架。核心思想是将轨迹显式地建模为粗粒度里程碑（milestones）与细粒度片段（segments）的组合，从而在不同分辨率层次上捕获复杂的时空依赖关系。通过引入多个分辨率层次上的随机性来增强轨迹多样性。

Result: MR-Traj在全局分布相似性方面与最先进方法性能相当，在细分辨率移动模式建模和支持下游城市移动任务方面持续优于现有方法。此外，多分辨率随机性使生成的轨迹更多样化，在种子引导的数据发布场景下有效降低了轨迹链接风险。

Conclusion: MR-Traj通过多分辨率建模有效解决了现有轨迹生成方法忽视多尺度移动模式的问题，在保持全局分布相似性的同时提升了轨迹的实用性与隐私保护能力，为大规模轨迹生成提供了新思路。

Abstract: Understanding human mobility is critical for a wide range of urban applications, including traffic management, epidemic control, and urban planning. However, due to privacy concerns, the availability of large-scale public trajectory data remains limited, posing challenges for downstream mobility analysis. Existing methods for synthetic trajectory generation primarily focus on matching global distribution similarity, while often overlooking mobility patterns across different spatial and temporal resolutions that are essential for practical utility.
  To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-resolution diffusion framework, MR-Traj, for large-scale trajectory generation. MR-Traj explicitly models trajectories as compositions of coarse-grained milestones and fine-grained segments, enabling the capture of complex spatial-temporal dependencies at multiple resolutions. Experimental results demonstrate that MR-Traj achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in terms of global distribution similarity, while consistently outperforming them in modeling fine-resolution mobility patterns and supporting downstream urban mobility tasks. In addition, by introducing stochasticity at multiple resolution levels, MR-Traj generates more diverse trajectories, which empirically reduces trajectory linkage risk under a seed-guided data release setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ray0202/MR-Traj.

</details>


### [526] [Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14594)
*Dhairysheel Durgule*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对PGD攻击的轨迹级诊断指标（损失演化、梯度对齐、失败步数）进行了系统研究，发现这些指标虽能描述优化几何特性，但并不能独立衡量对抗鲁棒性——损失轨迹和梯度对齐在鲁棒性不同的模型间表现相似，而失败步数分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性区间，轨迹级分析应作为标准鲁棒性测量的补充工具而非替代品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PGD攻击广泛用于评估对抗鲁棒性，但传统上仅使用最终对抗准确率，无法捕捉攻击过程中的模型行为。虽然近期有研究提出轨迹级诊断指标（如损失演化、梯度对齐、失败步数），但这些指标是否能可靠指示鲁棒性强弱仍不清楚，本文旨在验证这些诊断指标的有效性。

Method: 在Fashion-MNIST上对CNN模型进行实验，对比干净训练和对抗训练模型在多个鲁棒性区间下的表现。使用严格的20步PGD评估（随机初始化+多次重启）测量鲁棒性，使用单初始化轨迹记录进行诊断分析。对每个模型记录3000个干净正确样本的完整PGD轨迹，分析损失演化、梯度对齐和失败时序。

Result: 实验结果揭示了模型间清晰的鲁棒性层次结构，但轨迹指标对识别这个层次结构的贡献并不均等：平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐模式在鲁棒性差异显著的对抗训练模型间表现相似，而失败步数分布能更清晰地分离不同鲁棒性区间，直接反映对对抗扰动的功能性抵抗。

Conclusion: 轨迹级诊断指标描述的是优化几何特征而非鲁棒性本身，其可解释性依赖于鲁棒性区间、攻击强度和多重指标评估。轨迹级分析应作为补充诊断工具并结合上下文解读，而非替代标准鲁棒性测量方法。

Abstract: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, gradient alignment, and failure timing across attack iterations. Our results reveal a clear robustness hierarchy across models; however, trajectory metrics do not contribute equally to its identification. Mean loss trajectories and gradient alignment patterns appear quantitatively similar across adversarially-trained models with substantially different robust accuracies. In contrast, steps-to-failure distributions provide a clearer separation of robustness regimes, directly reflecting functional resistance to adversarial perturbation. These findings indicate that trajectory-level diagnostics describe optimisation geometry but do not independently measure adversarial robustness. Their interpretability depends on robustness regime, attack strength, and multi-metric evaluation. Trajectory-level analysis should be a complementary diagnostic tool, interpreted in context, rather than a replacement for standard robustness measurements.

</details>


### [527] [DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14614)
*Zeyu Cao,Xuan Guo,Cheng Zhang,Cheuk Hang Lau,Ilia Shumailov,Yiren Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了退役GPU（二手GPU）能否通过组建"DumpsterCluster"来服务于现代LLM推理。作者实际搭建了一个128-GPU的二手集群并运行一年，发现其在经济上极具优势（$22K vs $600K），并通过流水线并行优化在V100集群上实现了有竞争力的LLaMA-70B吞吐量。然而，由于老GPU每token能耗显著更高，只有在电价低廉且清洁能源充足的地区，这种回收利用才在经济和环境上可持续。在平均碳强度的电网下，二手系统每token碳排放可达新硬件的4倍（8B模型）乃至40倍（70B模型）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI数据中心大量退役仍具算力的GPU进入二手市场，作者希望探究这些被淘汰的加速器能否通过组建集群来继续服务于现代LLM推理需求，并明确在什么条件下这种"GPU回收再利用"在经济和环境上都是可行的。

Method: 作者从零开始使用纯二手组件物理搭建了一个128-GPU的DumpsterCluster，并运行了一年。通过流水线并行（pipeline-parallel）优化，在基于V100的集群上验证了LLaMA-70B的生产级推理吞吐量。同时比较了二手系统与新系统（8-GPU B200）在成本、能耗和碳排放方面的差异。

Result: 经济成本上二手集群（$22K）远低于新系统（$600K），且能实现有竞争力的LLaMA-70B吞吐量。但二手GPU每token能耗显著更高，在电网平均碳强度下，8B模型碳排放约为新硬件4倍，70B模型超过40倍。总拥有成本仅在电价低廉地区才有优势。

Conclusion: GPU的"死后重生"并非普遍可持续——硬件回收利用必须与低碳能源战略性地结合。在能源经济良好且电力清洁的地区，二手GPU为扩展AI算力提供了可行路径，同时兼顾可负担性、能源安全和环境责任。

Abstract: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.

</details>


### [528] [Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14617)
*Surya Saka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究在1,000个欧洲人权法院真实案件上测试了将多种不确定性工具（证据图+信念传播、贝叶斯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer组合、共形预测）融合进单一流水线以提升案件结果预测的可行性。结果发现：融合流水线在判别力上无改进（直接使用前沿LLM最强），且朴素组合导致校准误差翻倍，Dempster-Shafer融合在长链条上甚至不安全。该流水线的真正价值在于操作性：通过共形选择预测层可自动处理案件达96.8%准确率，其贡献是校准的信任而非更锐利的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律AI领域反复出现一种提议：将各种不确定性工具融合进单一流水线以改进案件结果预测。作者希望验证这一广为流传但缺乏系统检验的技术方案是否真的有效，以及其真实价值所在。

Method: 使用1,000个来自LexGLUE和FairLex的真实欧洲人权法院案件，从事实段落预测法院是否认定违反公约。对比三种途径（原始LLM、经融合流水线的LLM、经同一流水线的词频基线），使用两个前沿LLM（Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5）作为逐事实证据估计器，共约4,750项测试。

Result: 四项核心发现：(1)判别力上流水线无改进，原始LLM是最强判别器（歧视案件AUROC约0.83）；(2)朴素组合使校准误差从ECE约0.16上升至0.46，归因于先验失配机制；(3)Dempster-Shafer融合在长链条上不安全，以低于随机水平的准确率自信地选错标签；(4)流水线的真正价值在操作性：移除Dempster-Shafer、重校准并应用类条件风险控制后，自动处理案件准确率达96.8%，仅0.5%错误漏出，96.3%被捕获送审，远优于未调优基线（85.9/3.8/72.1）。

Conclusion: 此类流水线在法律领域的贡献是校准的信任（calibrated trust），而非更尖锐的预测能力。建议移除Dempster-Shafer融合，并强调应将其价值定位于操作决策支持（哪些案件自动化、哪些升级人工审查）而非预测精度提升。

Abstract: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.

</details>


### [529] [PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14619)
*Yuan Guo,Hanshu Chen,Zhuojia Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的可解释神经算子框架PIKFNO（物理信息核函数神经算子），通过将源自控制方程的物理信息核函数显式纳入神经算子架构，约束主干网络，使其算子结构与无网格配点法中的核展开对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且在小样本数据下的泛化能力有限。作者希望通过显式引入物理信息核函数来提升神经算子的可解释性和数据效率。

Method: 提出两种构建策略：(1)直接从数据中学习核函数，所学核可视为非奇异基本解；(2)通过解析基本解的变换来构建核函数。这些物理信息核函数用于约束主干网络，使PIKFNO的结构与无网格配点法中的核展开保持一致。

Result: 数值实验表明PIKFNO在有限训练数据下实现了高预测精度，显著提升了可解释性，并展现出优越的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该框架为发展高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了新途径。

Abstract: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.

</details>


### [530] [Explaining Reinforcement Learning Decisions in Self-adaptive Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14620)
*Jasmina Gajcin,Juan C. Rosero,Ivana Dusparic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了EARL，一个用于在强化学习环境中生成反事实解释的Python库，通过探索"假设"场景来澄清智能体行为，并在CitiBikes共享单车系统的仿真中展示了其适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习策略缺乏透明性，难以理解和验证，导致用户信任度降低。虽然心理学研究表明反事实解释直观易用，但在强化学习领域中的应用仍处于早期阶段，现有实现大多局限于玩具示例。

Method: EARL库通过探索What-if场景，比较多条路径的可能结果来生成反事实解释，从而阐明智能体行为。该库专门设计用于支持现实场景中基于强化学习的自适应系统。

Result: 在CitiBikes共享单车自适应系统的仿真中展示了EARL的应用，并提供了评估结果以说明其在真实应用中的表现。

Conclusion: EARL解决了深度强化学习策略缺乏解释性的问题，在现实场景的自适应系统中成功应用了反事实解释，而不仅仅局限于玩具示例。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been extensively used in autonomous and self-* systems, but RL policies, especially deep RL ones relying on neural networks, lack transparency and are difficult to understand. This can lead to diminished user trust, and makes for a more challenging verification of systems. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning (EARL), a Python library to produce counterfactual explanations in RL settings. This library allows the user to produce explanations by exploring What-if scenarios to clarify agent behavior by comparing possible outcomes. Counterfactual explanations have been shown to be intuitive and user-friendly in psychology research, but have only recently been explored in RL, with existing implementations usually limited to toy examples and benchmarks. EARL supports counterfactual explanation generation in realistic RL-based self-adaptive systems. To demonstrate its applicability, we demonstrate its use in a simulation of CitiBikes, a self-adaptive bike-sharing system, and we provide evaluations showing how it performs in real applications.

</details>


### [531] [Metaplasticity as adaptive gradient preconditioning for incremental learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14634)
*Isabelle Aguilar,Zayn Andre Zainal,Omid Kavehei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SynGAP是一个基于突触几何自适应预条件（adaptive gradient preconditioning）的任务无关持续学习框架，通过维护Fisher信息矩阵的指数移动平均来模拟生物突触可塑性，以有界乘法掩码调节梯度更新，从而在无任务标签和无大量记忆开销的条件下缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物智能通过互补学习系统（CLS）理论自然避免灾难性遗忘，其局部机制由突触元可塑性驱动。现有的人工神经网络解决方案在非平稳环境中面临稳定性-可塑性困境，且往往依赖任务标签或产生巨大的内存开销，与生物现实相悖。作者希望将这种局部的生物神经调制重新框架为优化驱动的过程，实现无需任务标签且内存高效的持续学习。

Method: SynGAP框架核心包括：(1) 维护Fisher信息矩阵的指数移动平均，在连续数据流上模拟实时的突触元可塑性，无需显式的情节触发；(2) 在每次优化步骤中，将动态元可塑性状态转换为有界乘法掩码，对原始梯度进行预条件处理；(3) 选择性地衰减对历史关键参数的更新，实现梯度的几何自适应调节。

Result: 在Split CIFAR-100基准上，SynGAP相比EWC++准确率提升4倍，比Experience Replay（ER）高近10%，且遗忘度量比两者均降低超过10%。在CORe50基准上，SynGAP达到约68%的准确率，相比优化器基线提升10%。

Conclusion: 通过将连续的生物元可塑性数学形式化为稳定的基于梯度的正则化，SynGAP提供了一种鲁棒且内存高效的持续学习方案，适用于边缘设备上的自适应智能实现。

Abstract: Biological intelligence naturally prevents catastrophic forgetting through Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory, a macroscopic consolidation process driven at the local level by synaptic metaplasticity: the continuous, history-dependent neuromodulation of individual synapses. While artificial neural networks struggle with the stability-plasticity dilemma in non-stationary environments, existing solutions often require task labels or incur massive memory overhead, diverging from biological reality. Re-framing this localized neuromodulation as an optimization-driven process, we introduce $\textbf{SynGAP}$: $\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning. SynGAP is a task-free continual learning framework based on adaptive gradient preconditioning. Rather than relying on explicit episodic triggers, SynGAP simulates real-time metaplasticity by maintaining an exponential moving average of the Fisher Information Matrix over a continuous data stream. During the optimization step, these dynamic metaplastic states are translated into a bounded multiplicative mask that preconditions raw gradients, selectively attenuating updates to critical historical parameters. Empirical evaluations demonstrate SynGAP's superior ability to mitigate catastrophic forgetting compared to established baselines. On the Split CIFAR-100 benchmark, SynGAP delivers a $4\times$ increase in accuracy compared to EWC++ and outperforms Experience Replay (ER) by almost $10\%$, while reducing the forgetting measure by over $10\%$ against both methods. Furthermore, on the CORe50 benchmark, SynGAP achieves about $68\%$, a $10\%$ improvement over optimizer baselines. By mathematically formalizing continuous biological metaplasticity as stable gradient-based regularization, SynGAP offers a highly robust and memory-efficient solution for adaptive intelligence at the edge.

</details>


### [532] [Fractional Optimizers Meet Fractal Activation Functions: An Empirical Study of Multi-Scale Optimization in Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14636)
*Sebastian Raubitzek,Georg Goldenits,Sebastian Schrittwieser,Philip König,Kevin Mallinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一实验框架下研究了分数阶优化方法与分形激活函数的相互作用，发现两者存在有用但具有选择性的配对关系：正则化式分数阶缩放与特定分形激活在神经网络训练中表现良好，而Grünwald–Letnikov记忆在扰动表面上最相关，自适应记忆在多种情况下优于普通记忆替代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分数阶优化方法和分形激活函数是两条独立的改进神经网络训练的研究方向，但此前缺乏对二者交互作用的系统研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索这两类方法组合时的协同或冲突效应。

Method: 构建统一实验框架：(1) 在Ackley和Himmelblau基准曲面上评估分数阶优化器族，包括标准形式和添加Weierstrass型扰动的变体；(2) 在前馈神经网络中结合常规与分形激活函数，在十个分类数据集上进行测试；(3) 比较标准方法、正则化式优化器、显式与自适应记忆分数阶优化器及其他代表性文献方法。

Result: 分数阶优化与分形激活存在有用但选择性的配对。正则化式分数阶缩放与选定的分形激活在网络训练中表现良好；Grünwald–Letnikov记忆在扰动表面上最为有效；自适应记忆在多个案例中优于普通记忆替代。

Conclusion: 受控的分数阶记忆是一个有前景的研究方向，但不应被视为通用的替代方案——它更适用于特定场景和特定激活函数的组合，而非普适性的改进手段。

Abstract: Fractional optimization methods and fractal activation functions are two independent directions for improving neural network training. Fractional optimizers extend first-order optimization through fractional derivatives and memory effects, whereas fractal activations introduce multi-scale nonlinear representations based on self-similar Weierstrass- and Blancmange-type functions. Here, we investigate their interaction within a unified experimental framework. We evaluate fractional optimizer families on Ackley and Himmelblau benchmark surfaces, in standard form and with additive Weierstrass-type perturbations, and then in feed-forward neural networks with conventional and fractal activations on ten classification datasets. The comparison includes standard methods, regularization-style optimizers, explicit and adaptive memory-based fractional optimizers, and other representative literature methods. Overall, fractional optimization and fractal activations show useful but selective pairings. Regularization-style fractional scaling performs well with selected fractal activations in network training, while Grünwald--Letnikov memory is most relevant on perturbed surfaces. Adaptive memory improves plain memory substitution in several cases, supporting controlled fractional memory as a promising direction rather than a universal replacement.

</details>


### [533] [Early Cycle Charge Trajectory Generative Prediction and Full Life Cycle Health Management of Iron-Chromium Flow Batteries Based on FlowBD-E1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14637)
*Suyang Zhuang,Zekun Jiang,Tianhang Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FlowBD-E1，一个面向工业级33 kW铁铬液流电池的早期循环生成式预测框架，仅用前9个循环即可预测完整生命周期内的充电电压/电流轨迹，联合MAPE低至0.731%，SOH估计误差低于1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时间固定储能需要能在容量显著损失前检测电池退化。铁铬液流电池活性物质丰富廉价但受慢铬动力学、析氢、膜交叉和电解液失衡等耦合过程影响，其退化轨迹复杂。现有大多数电池预测研究聚焦锂离子电池，或将老化压缩为标量容量/SOH标签，缺乏对完整V/I轨迹的早期预测能力。

Method: FlowBD-E1框架由三部分组成：多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期Transformer和年龄感知的FiLM解码器。同时比较了三种部署策略：单步隐空间外推(SLE)、递归隐空间预测(RLF)和教师强制更新(TFU)，并使用前9个循环预测剩余286个循环的完整V/I轨迹。

Result: 使用289个循环中的前9个，RLF策略实现全生命周期联合V/I平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)为0.731%，SOH估计MAPE低于1%。消融和独立序列测试表明该年龄感知生成架构优于LSTM和TCN基线，并在工业验证下保持亚百分比误差。

Conclusion: 早期循环轨迹生成可将短期的调试记录转化为液流电池管理的长期诊断信号，为铁铬液流电池的退化监测提供了一种可行的前沿方法。

Abstract: Long-duration stationary energy storage requires batteries whose degradation can be detected before substantial capacity loss has accumulated. Iron-chromium redox flow batteries are attractive for this role because they use abundant and low-cost active species, yet their operation is shaped by slow chromium kinetics, hydrogen evolution, membrane crossover and electrolyte imbalance. These coupled processes gradually reshape the full charge voltage/current (V/I) trajectory, but most battery prognostic studies either focus on lithium-ion cells or compress ageing into scalar capacity and state-of-health (SOH) labels. Here we study an industrial 33 kW Fe-Cr redox flow battery and introduce FlowBD-E1, an early-cycle generative forecasting framework that predicts complete future charge V/I trajectories from only the first few cycles. The model combines a multi-scale convolutional encoder, a lifecycle Transformer and an age-aware FiLM decoder, and we compare three deployment strategies: single-step latent extrapolation (SLE), recursive latent forecasting (RLF) and teacher-forced updating (TFU). Using the first 9 of 289 cycles, RLF achieved a joint V/I mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 0.731% over the remaining lifecycle and produced SOH estimates below 1% MAPE. Ablation and independent-sequence tests showed that the age-aware generative architecture outperformed LSTM and TCN baselines and retained sub-percent errors under industrial validation. These results suggest that early-cycle trajectory generation can turn a short commissioning record into a long-horizon diagnostic signal for flow-battery management.

</details>


### [534] [Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14638)
*Leonid Berlyand,Roman Sarapin,Yitzchak Shmalo,Victor Slavin,Sasha Sodin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究自编码器这一特殊深度神经网络的性能，通过其不动点的存在性、稳定性和吸引域来表征，并引入局部和全局的边沿混沌（Edge-of-Chaos）概念。局部EoC基于随机矩阵理论的谱技术分析，全局EoC则利用Sudakov-Fernique不等式研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自编码器的性能可以通过其不动点来表征，这自然引出了不动点的存在性、稳定性和吸引域等问题。EoC是深度神经网络理论中划分有序与混沌信号传播的关键概念，此前已通过均值场平均方法引入到广泛的神经网络类别中，但尚未专门针对自编码器进行修改和定义。

Method: 本文将EoC概念适配到自编码器，定义了局部和全局EoC分别控制输入的小扰动和任意扰动。局部EoC分析采用随机矩阵理论中的谱方法，而全局EoC则借助高斯过程的Sudakov-Fernique不等式进行研究。

Result: 通过自编码器的收缩性质，回答了不动点的存在性、稳定性和吸引域问题。局部和全局EoC分别使用随机矩阵理论谱技术和Sudakov-Fernique不等式进行了理论分析。

Conclusion: 自编码器的稳定性研究属于随机矩阵理论中非线性问题的范畴，本文通过引入局部和全局EoC概念，为自编码器的固定点分析和信号传播稳定性提供了新的理论框架。

Abstract: In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos.
  Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a randomly initialized network. Initialization at or near this critical regime offers several theoretical and practical advantages, including stability of the network w.r.t. perturbations of the input. EoC was previously introduced for broad classes of neural networks using mean-field averaging methods. In this paper we modify the notion of EoC for the study of autoencoders. Specifically, we introduce local and global EoC for autoencoders that control local (small) and global (arbitrary) perturbations of the input respectively.
  The study of stability of autoencoders falls within the scope of nonlinear problems in Random Matrix Theory (RMT). Our analysis of local EoC is based on spectral techniques of RMT, whereas global EoC is studied by employing Sudakov-Fernique inequality for Gaussian processes.

</details>


### [535] [Valid Per-Field Selective Risk Control for Document Extraction: Three Failure Modes, a Validity Ladder, and When Conditioning Pays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14639)
*Bhaskar Gurram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对文档抽取系统的"逐字段接受/审查"风险控制问题，在13,859个真实Claude-sonnet-5字段上诊断出三种失效模式（文档聚类、评分再拟合泄漏、平局质量病态），并提出"有效性阶梯"（validity ladder）框架，按层级提供不同保证形式：从期望选择性风险控制（fit/val分割协议）、到Mondrian Learn-then-Test的逐组PAC证书、再到支撑箱（support-bin）条件方法。实验表明分层条件化在池化方法无法给出证书时有效，但优势在不同模型上不具可复制性；冻结配置确认与三标注者人工金标审计验证了实际层级风险控制（1.3% vs 10%预算）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档抽取系统需要"逐字段接受/审查"的信任契约：只有在被接受字段中误差率受控（风险≤α）时才能接受字段。但自然的选择程序在真实文档上会默默违反这一契约，因此需要诊断失效模式并建立可靠的保证机制。

Method: 提出"有效性阶梯"（validity ladder）框架，按层级明确保证形式：1) fit/val分割协议恢复期望选择性风险控制（学习融合）；2) Mondrian Learn-then-Test结合精确二项尾部，给出逐组PAC证书（field-iid、cluster-corrected、doc-iid三种层级）；3) 预指定的来源分类法"支撑箱"（support-bin）用于分层条件化。配套冻结配置确认与多标注者人工金标审计。

Result: fit/val分割使覆盖率达0.318、风险0.096（名义α=0.10），但47.5%重分割超过α，非证书；Mondrian LTT给出field-iid 0.171@0.068、cluster-corrected 0.140、doc-iid 0.060，唯一与文档匹配但近乎空洞；支撑箱在每个严格性层级均获胜（p<1e-4，Bonferroni校正），但优势在haiku/qwen模型上不复现；在高准确率语料上池化阈值取胜。人工审计验证接受集实际风险1.3%对10%预算（Fleiss' kappa=0.83）。

Conclusion: 条件分层（支撑箱）恰好在池化方法无法提供证书的场景中有效，但可被学习评分所取代；不同严格性层级对应不同保证强度——点估计可超过α，只有PAC证书层级才真正匹配文档结构，但当前近乎空洞。方法以Apache-2.0开源，带种子固定与回归门控流程。

Abstract: Per-field accept/review with selective risk at most alpha -- accept a field only if the error rate among accepted fields is controlled -- is the trust contract document-extraction systems need, and the natural procedure silently violates it on real documents. On 13,859 genuine claude-sonnet-5 fields from 800 CORD receipts (49.0% correct) we diagnose three failure modes: document clustering (design effect 1.84-2.45), score-refit leakage (coverage 0.416 at risk 0.127, violating alpha=0.10 in 95% of splits), and a tie-mass pathology (a degenerate score collapses the threshold grid, 0.030 to 0.001). We organize the fixes as a validity ladder, guarantee form stated per tier. A fit/val split protocol restores expected-selective-risk control for a learned fusion: coverage 0.318 at risk 0.096 at nominal alpha=0.10, no tolerance band (production variant 0.326) -- an on-average point whose realized risk exceeds alpha in 47.5% of resplits, not a certificate. Mondrian Learn-then-Test with exact binomial tails yields per-group PAC certificates: field-iid 0.171 at risk 0.068, cluster-corrected 0.140, doc-iid 0.060 -- the only tier matching documents, honestly near-vacuous today. Support-bin, the pre-specified provenance taxonomy, wins every rigor tier on the sonnet CORD capture (p<1e-4, Bonferroni-corrected) -- a win that does not replicate on the same documents under haiku or qwen -- while on higher-accuracy corpora pooled thresholds win: conditioning helps exactly where pooled cannot certify, subsumed by a learned score elsewhere. A frozen-configuration confirmation on selection-untouched claude-haiku-4-5 held at both risk levels, and a blind three-annotator human-gold audit verifies the practical tier's accepted-set risk at 1.3% against its 10% budget (Fleiss' kappa=0.83; labels err one-sidedly pessimistic). Released Apache-2.0 with seed-pinned, regression-gated procedures.

</details>


### [536] [BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14640)
*An Vuong,Chen Zhao,Jin Hu,Shui-Qing Yu,Xintao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于堆叠双层材料高效构建与性质预测的机器学习框架，包含基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化流程和名为BDIP-Net的图神经网络，前者以极低成本生成DFT质量的双层结构，后者通过显式建模层内和层间相互作用来提升性质预测精度，在BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA数据集上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 堆叠双层材料具有丰富的堆叠依赖性质，但计算发现这类材料面临两大挑战：准确的结构生成依赖昂贵的DFT优化，而现有机器学习模型在性质预测时未能显式区分层内强共价键与层间弱范德华力这两种不同的相互作用类型。因此需要一个既能高效生成DFT质量结构、又能显式建模双层相互作用类型的机器学习框架。

Method: 该框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化工作流，从单层构建块和堆叠构型出发，以显著降低的计算成本生成DFT质量的双层结构；(2) BDIP-Net（双层双相互作用势网络），一种图神经网络，通过相互作用特定的势表示和自适应消息融合，显式建模层内和层间相互作用。在BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA数据集上分别涵盖同质双层、异质双层和扭转双层体系进行评估。

Result: MatterSim-D3优化流程生成的结构与DFT-PBE-D3优化结构高度吻合；BDIP-Net在双层材料性质预测上持续优于现有的图神经网络和基于势的方法。

Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了堆叠双层材料计算发现中结构生成昂贵和相互作用类型未显式区分的问题，为双层材料的快速发现与性质预测提供了高效且准确的工具。

Abstract: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion. We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.

</details>


### [537] [Training and Evaluating Ethical Reinforcement Learning Agents on Per-Episode Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14642)
*Prabhjyot Singh,Majid Ghasemi,Mark Crowley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较了四种在Craftax基准中训练RL代理伦理行为的方法（标量惩罚、线性多目标权重扫描、自适应拉格朗日约束、以及基于ESR准则的每集非补偿性效用优化），发现四种方法在均值前沿上不可区分，但在每集层面差异显著。ESR方法能够保持每集一个违规的预算保证，而其他方法存在违规泄露或最坏情况翻倍的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL代理在单一奖励信号下会利用设计奖励与预期行为之间的差距，尤其是在灌输伦理行为时。代理可能平均看起来符合伦理，但在少数恶劣回合集中违规，且环境中的生物在一个回合被伤害无法通过其他回合的良好行为来补偿。因此需要研究能够保证每集层面伦理约束的训练方法。

Method: 在Craftax开放世界生存基准中比较四种训练方法：1) 带终止的标量惩罚；2) 线性多目标权重扫描；3) 自适应拉格朗日约束；4) 在ESR准则下每集优化的非补偿性效用函数。所有方法使用统一的基于检测器的协议，对每个回合的每次违规进行计数而不删减。

Result: 在平均回报与平均违规率的边界上四种方法无法区分；但在每集层面差异显著。在匹配的平均回报下，ESR代理在几乎所有回合中保持一个违规的预算（最差十分位1.04±0.07），拉格朗日方法泄露超出预算（1.14±0.03），权重扫描的最差回合加倍违规（2.20±0.20）。观测增强对照实验表明差异来自训练目标而非观测内容，且每集保证在均值前沿上无成本。

Conclusion: 当伦理违规无法在回合间平均化时，训练和评估都必须针对每集分布而非均值。ESR方法提供了有效的每集伦理保证，而传统均值优化方法虽然均值表现相近，但在最坏情况回合中会违背伦理约束。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents trained on a single reward signal exploit the gap between the designed reward and the intended behavior. This is particularly a problem when we are trying to imbue ethical behavior into RL agents. An agent can look ethical on average while concentrating its violations in a few bad episodes, and a creature in the environment harmed in one episode is not restored by good conduct in another. We compare four ways of training ethical behavior in Craftax, an open-ended survival benchmark. The four are: scalar penalties with termination, a linear multi-objective weight sweep, an adaptive Lagrangian constraint, and a non-compensatory utility optimized per episode under the Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR) criterion. All are evaluated under a single detector-based protocol that counts every violation in every episode without censoring. On the frontier of mean return against mean violation rate, the four methods are indistinguishable; per episode they separate sharply. At matched mean return, the ESR agent holds its stated budget of one violation in effectively every episode (worst-decile 1.04 +/- 0.07 violations), the Lagrangian leaks past the same budget (1.14 +/- 0.03), and the weight sweep's worst episodes double it (2.20 +/- 0.20). An observation-augmentation control attributes the separation to the training objective rather than to what the agent observes, and the per-episode guarantee costs nothing on the mean frontier. When ethical violations do not average away across episodes, we argue both training and evaluation must target the per-episode distribution rather than the mean.

</details>


### [538] [DUET: Dual-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Same-Weight Disagreement for Prohibition Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14644)
*Zihan Li,Feifei Li,Wenhui Que*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DUET是一种面向实时注入禁令（如企业策略、PII红线、工具边界）的token级选择性在线蒸馏方法。它通过配对"看到禁令的老师"与"未看到禁令的同权重老师"，利用两者的token级分歧来隔离禁令的因果效应，从而产生干净的监督信号，并结合信号清洗与偏好导向学习两种机制，在不依赖离线偏好数据的情况下将DPO风格优化嵌入在线蒸馏中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的LLM部署越来越依赖运行时注入的禁令（每请求、每租户各不相同），但传统后训练方法结构上不适用：SFT将违规信号隐藏在合规标签中，而DPO的序列级偏好与token局部化的违规不匹配。

Method: DUET采用token级选择性在线策略蒸馏。核心思路是让一个看到禁令的老师（正向）与一个未看到禁令的同权重老师（负向）配对，两者仅在禁令可见性上不同，因此token级分歧能隔离禁令的因果效应。该分歧驱动两个互补机制：(1) 信号清洗——丢弃一致token（视为冗余或前缀污染）；(2) 偏好导向学习——在token粒度上将学生从负向老师推向正向老师，将DPO风格优化直接嵌入在线蒸馏。此外还构建了涵盖五个任务族的工业级禁令合规基准。

Result: 在1.5B-8B Qwen系列模型上，DUET实现了72.3-85.2%的违规合规率，同时保持88-93%的正常效用，大幅超越教师模型及其他蒸馏基线。外部SysBench评估证实安全对齐得到改善，且在GSM8K和MATH-500上性能退化极小。

Conclusion: DUET通过同权重双教师的token级分歧提供了一种干净、可扩展的禁令合规训练信号，解决了传统后训练方法在动态、多租户禁令场景下的结构性问题，在工业实际场景中展现出优异的合规性与效用保持能力。

Abstract: Real-world LLM deployments increasingly rely on runtime-injected prohibitions--enterprise policies, PII redlines, tool boundaries--that vary per request and per tenant. Conventional post-training is structurally ill-suited: SFT hides the violation signal in compliant labels, and DPO's sequence-level preferences mismatch token-localized violations. We propose DUET, a token-selective on-policy distillation method for prohibition compliance. DUET pairs a teacher that sees the prohibition (positive) with an identical-weight teacher that does not (negative). Because the two teachers differ only in prohibition visibility, their per-token disagreement isolates the prohibition's causal effect--yielding a clean supervision signal uncontaminated by model capacity or mismatch. This disagreement drives two complementary mechanisms: signal cleaning, which discards agreement tokens as redundant or prefix-corrupted, and preference-directed learning, which pushes the student away from the negative teacher and toward the positive one at token granularity, embedding DPO-style optimization directly into OPD without offline preference data. We construct an industrial Prohibition-Compliance benchmark spanning five task families covering explicit-refusal, paraphrase robustness, and over-refusal. Across 1.5B-8B Qwen variants, DUET achieves 72.3-85.2% violation compliance while preserving 88-93% normal utility, dramatically outperforming teacher model and other distillation baselines. External evaluation on SysBench confirms improved safety alignment with minimal degradation on GSM8K and MATH-500.

</details>


### [539] [Efficient Neural-Network-Based High-Resolution Radiative Transfer for CO___ Retrieval, and Application to Interferometric Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14645)
*Jordan Lontsi Tedongmo,Yann Ferrec,Laurence Croizé,Pablo Musé,Gabriele Facciolo,Andrés Almansa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出一种基于多层感知机（MLP）的辐射传输替代模型，用于高效预测CO2弱波段的星载大气顶辐射，并通过联合优化辐射值和Jacobian的MAE损失来保持光谱精度和地球物理参数敏感性，最终与NanoCarb成像干涉仪仪器响应耦合，实现高效精确的CO2浓度反演。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化研究需要降低CO2和CH4排放估算的不确定性，以更好区分人为源和自然源。天基测量虽有改进，但全物理反演算法依赖逐线辐射传输模型的重复杂高分辨率模拟，计算成本极高，难以满足高重访频率和大空间覆盖的监测需求。

Method: 构建一个前馈多层感知机（MLP）作为辐射传输替代模型，采用辐射值和RT Jacobian的联合平均绝对误差（MAE）作为损失函数，以同时保持光谱精度和对地球物理参数的灵敏度。该MLP替代模型再与NanoCarb仪器响应函数耦合，形成高效的NanoCarb测量前向模型。

Result: MLP辐射传输替代模型在CO2弱波段能够准确高效地预测星载大气顶辐射，且耦合NanoCarb仪器响应后，前向模型在CO2浓度反演中展现出有前景的结果。

Conclusion: 基于MLP的辐射传输替代模型为低成本卫星星座NanoCarb在大气CO2监测中提供了计算高效且精度可保证的前向建模方案，有望支撑高重访、大覆盖的温室气体观测需求。

Abstract: Studying climate change requires reducing uncertainties in CO2 and CH4 emission estimates to better distinguish anthropogenic from natural sources, which motivates spaceborne measurements with improved revisit frequency and spatial coverage. In this context, the Horizon Europe SCARBOn project assesses a low-cost satellite constellation featuring the NanoCarb imaging interferometer as its core sensor for monitoring CO2 and CH4 emissions in the atmosphere. However, estimating CO2 and CH4 concentrations with high revisit and spatial coverage poses significant challenges: full-physics retrieval algorithms commonly used rely on repeated high-resolution radiative transfer (RT) simulations, which are computationally expensive when using line-by-line RT models. As an alternative, we propose in this study a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) surrogate designed to accurately and efficiently predict top-of-atmosphere radiances in the CO2 weak band, using a combined mean absolute error (MAE) loss on radiances and RT Jacobians to preserve both spectral accuracy and sensitivity to geophysical parameters. Coupling the MLP-based RT surrogate with the NanoCarb instrumental response yields an efficient and precise forward model for NanoCarb measurements, which shows promising results for CO2 concentration retrieval.

</details>


### [540] [iFuzz-Meta: An Interpretable Fuzzy Learning Framework Bridging Top-Down and Bottom-Up Knowledge Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14646)
*Xiaowei Jiang,Daniel Leong,Beining Cao,Nan Zhou,Yingtao Ren,Yu-Cheng Chang,Thomas Do,Chin-Teng Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出iFuzz-Meta，一个可解释的模糊规则学习框架，在神经网络架构中保留人类可理解的推理结构。每个模糊规则对应原始特征空间中的语义和空间原型，通过元学习分析规则如何跨任务和域重组，并利用知识引导正则化实现自上而下与自下而上的整合。实验表明其实现了可解释推理和稳定的跨域泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经计算中，可解释表示学习仍是关键挑战，模型不仅要执行任务还需解释其推理过程。现有模型往往在性能与可解释性之间难以兼顾，缺乏既能保持人类可理解推理结构又能在现代神经架构中有效运行的方法。

Method: 1) 构建iFuzz-Meta框架，每个模糊规则对应原始特征空间中的语义和空间原型，实现透明推理。2) 采用元学习作为分析范式，研究可解释规则如何跨任务和领域重组。3) 设计知识引导正则化机制，实现自上而下（理论先验作为软归纳偏置）与自下而上（数据驱动学习）的双向整合。

Result: 评估显示iFuzz-Meta实现了可解释推理和稳定的跨域泛化，表明该方法可作为通往可解释和知识感知模糊系统的潜在通用路径。

Conclusion: iFuzz-Meta建立了可解释模糊推理与神经架构之间的桥梁，通过元学习分析规则重组、知识引导正则化实现语义和生理学意义上的适应性演化，为可解释和知识感知的模糊系统提供了通用路径。

Abstract: Interpretable representation learning remains a key challenge in modern neural computation, particularly when models are expected not only to perform but also to explain their reasoning. This paper introduces iFuzz-Meta, an interpretable fuzzy rule-based learning framework that preserves human-understandable reasoning structures within modern neural architectures. Each fuzzy rule corresponds to a semantic and spatial prototype defined in the original feature space, enabling transparent inference and direct interpretability. Meta-learning is employed as an analytical paradigm to examine how these interpretable rules reorganize across tasks and domains, providing a principled means to link algorithmic adaptation with cognitive representation. A knowledge-guided regularization mechanism further enables a top-down-bottom-up integration, in which theoretical priors act as soft inductive biases while data-driven learning refines and extends them. This dual process ensures that adaptation proceeds along semantically and physiologically meaningful trajectories, rather than arbitrary parameter shifts. Evaluations demonstrate that iFuzz-Meta achieves interpretable reasoning and stable cross-domain generalization, establishing a potential general pathway toward explainable and knowledge-aware fuzzy systems.

</details>


### [541] [SMOPD: Selective Token-Entropy Masking for Dirty-History Multi-Turn On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14647)
*Chenyang Jiang,Changhan Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SMOPD（Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation），一种仅作用于损失函数的轻量级稳定化方法，用于多轮自蒸馏（OPSD）中脏历史（dirty-history）场景。SMOPD根据学生模型的token熵对中间轮次回复进行排序，并从裁剪的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中移除最低熵的20% token；最终答案和FULL保留损失不变。该方法无需新增参数，推理时零开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）在脏历史场景下不稳定：一旦学生模型生成错误的中间回复，后续轮次会基于该错误回复进行条件生成，而统一的蒸馏损失会将这些错误传递到后续token上，从而浪费损失在缺乏纠正信号的token上。需要一个针对token级不确定性的稳定化机制。

Method: SMOPD方法核心为：对每个生成的中间轮次回复，按学生模型的熵对token位置进行排序，从裁剪的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中移除熵最低的20% token，而最终答案损失和FULL保留损失保持不变。此外还比较了一种正确性缩放变体，该方法使用最终答案正确性作为常见的分离可靠性代理来乘上标量。

Result: 在LiC基准上使用Qwen3模型，SMOPD在单种子1.7B、4B和8B对比中将SHARDED视图准确率提升了1.0-2.5个百分点；4B多种子检验显示比基线平均提升+1.7pp SHARDED（双尾p=0.022）。添加结果标量在无掩码情况下在1.7B有害（-4.0pp），结合掩码时仍依赖规模（4B时+1.3pp，1.7B时中性，8B时-0.5pp）。

Conclusion: 在这些评估的脏历史OPSD设置中，token级不确定性比标量最终答案正确性是更可靠的稳定化信号。但因果机制测试和更广泛的基准验证留待未来工作。

Abstract: Dirty-history rollouts make multi-turn on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) brittle: once a student emits an erroneous intermediate reply, later turns are conditioned on that reply, and uniform distillation can spend loss on tokens that carry little corrective signal. We introduce SMOPD (Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation), a loss-only stabilization method for multi-turn OPSD. For each generated middle-turn reply, SMOPD ranks token positions by student entropy and removes the lowest-entropy 20% from the clipped generalized Jensen-Shannon distillation loss; final-answer and FULL-preservation losses are unchanged. This design targets token-level uncertainty rather than coarse trajectory outcomes, adds no parameters, and has zero inference-time overhead. We compare SMOPD with a correctness-scaling variant that multiplies a common detached reliability proxy using final-answer correctness. On LiC with Qwen3 models, SMOPD improves SHARDED-view accuracy by 1.0-2.5 percentage points in single-seed 1.7B, 4B, and 8B comparisons, and a small 4B multi-seed check shows a +1.7pp mean SHARDED gain over baseline (two-tailed p = 0.022). Adding the outcome scalar is harmful without masking at 1.7B (-4.0pp) and remains scale-dependent when combined with masking (+1.3pp at 4B, neutral at 1.7B, and -0.5pp at 8B). These archived aggregate results suggest that token-level uncertainty is a more reliable stabilization signal than scalar final-answer correctness in this evaluated dirty-history OPSD setting, while leaving causal mechanism tests and broader benchmark validation to future work.

</details>


### [542] [Discrete Diffusion Language Models Are Training-Free Multi-Label Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14649)
*Pawan Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了dLLM-SetScore，一种基于离散掩码扩散语言模型的无需训练的多标签分类方法，通过为每个候选标签提出简短的是/否问题并比较掩码位置两个答案标记的概率来进行预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（如NLI模型、自回归LLM、SetFit等）在多标签文本分类中存在局限，且将多个标签放在同一提示词中会产生槽位位置不对称的伪影，影响预测公平性。

Method: 1) 每个候选标签构造独立的简短是/否问题，在单一掩码位置比较两个答案标记概率；2) 无需任务特定微调，仅用200个示例的验证集选择阈值、温度和提示措辞；3) 每个标签置于相同句法位置，实现标签顺序不变性；4) 证明排列不变性，表征加权汉明损失下的阈值决策。

Result: 在六个数据集上评估LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B，Instruct检查点在共享的五个数据集上优于基线（macro-F1为9/10，micro-F1为8/10）；LLaDA-Instruct在Reuters和ECtHR上取得最高训练免费指标；发现槽位位置不对称问题（第一个答案槽在GoEmotions上99.4%、Reuters上100%被预测为正向）。

Conclusion: 验证了训练免费策略的有效性，证明扩散语言模型可用于多标签分类，同时记录了局部联合集精炼步骤未能提升性能的负面结果，并提供了理论保证。

Abstract: We present dLLM-SetScore, a training-free method that uses discrete masked-diffusion language models for multi-label text classification. For each candidate label, it asks a short yes/no question and compares the probabilities of the two answer tokens at one masked position. The method uses no task-specific fine-tuning or training on textual-entailment datasets; a 200-example labelled validation slice selects thresholds, temperature, and prompt wording.
  We first show that placing all labels in one prompt creates a strong slot-position asymmetry: the first answer slot is predicted positive on $99.4\%$ of GoEmotions examples and $100\%$ of Reuters examples. Per-label scoring places every label in the same syntactic position, making predictions invariant to label order and avoiding this artifact. We evaluate LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B on six datasets against NLI models, an autoregressive LLM, SetFit, and supervised classifiers. On the five datasets shared by both diffusion families, Instruct checkpoints improve macro-F1 in 9 of 10 comparisons and micro-F1 in 8 of 10, although these comparisons do not identify the cause. Within our protocol, LLaDA-Instruct records the highest training-free values for both Reuters and ECtHR metrics. We prove permutation invariance, characterize thresholded decisions under weighted Hamming loss, and derive shortlist ceilings for recall and F1. An exploratory local Joint Set Refinement step lowers F1 from biased and unbiased initializations and is retained as a negative result.

</details>


### [543] [Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14650)
*Malo de Pastor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了一个聚焦问题：在配对的精确重置物理结果下，Medium预测接口能否判断何时切换到冻结的Full预测器，以改善任务特定决策损失并抵消顺序计算开销。作者贡献了一套配对评估与审计协议（而非通用路由规则），并在PushT基准上验证了该预测接口路由器的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应推断和世界行动模型系统通常利用廉价阶段输出或预测未来信息来分配额外计算，但缺乏在严格配对、精确重置条件下对路由决策价值的严谨评估。作者希望回答一个更窄的问题：在可比的物理结果下，预测接口能否提供足够的增量路由信息，从而证明切换到更强大预测器的顺序开销是合理的。

Method: 提出配对评估与审计协议：所有候选动作从相同重置状态执行，Medium和Full作用于相同候选集和任务，以二者配对的物理损失差异作为路由目标。在PushT V106（1600状态、39任务、三个检查点对）上训练冻结预测接口路由器，并在V107上以前瞻性密封方式验证，对照维度匹配的当前DINO特征投影控制。同时进行受控PyBullet审计。

Result: 预测接口将定价物理决策成本降低了0.002549（状态聚集95%区间[-0.002867, -0.002238]；单侧95%上界-0.002286），三个检查点对均为负效应。受控PyBullet审计独立支持复合任务-预测-制度路由器。但顺序路由器仍比固定策略慢，优势仅限低计算价格场景。

Conclusion: 证据表明测试的预测接口在超越刻意偏袒的当前DINO控制方面提供了增量路由信息，但不支持因果充分性、计算节省、闭环价值或跨家族泛化的主张。研究价值在于提供了严谨的配对审计框架，而非提出新的通用路由规则。

Abstract: Existing adaptive-inference and world-action-model systems use cheap-stage outputs or predicted futures to allocate additional computation. We study a narrower question: under paired exact-reset physical outcomes, can a Medium-derived interface predict when switching to a separately frozen Full predictor improves task-specific decision loss enough to justify sequential overhead? Our contribution is a paired evaluation and audit protocol, not a new generic routing rule: all candidate actions are executed from the same reset state, Medium and Full act on the same candidate set and task, and their paired physical-loss difference defines the routing target. On a fresh PushT bank (V106; 1,600 states, 39 tasks, three checkpoint pairs), a frozen prediction-interface router lowers overhead-inclusive decision cost relative to standalone Medium, standalone Full, and a latency-advantaged task-only router. We then prospectively seal a second 1,600-state PushT confirmation (V107) against a stronger current-state control using the task, a dimension-matched projection of current DINO features, and all five candidate actions, with no DINO encoder latency charged. The prediction interface lowers priced physical decision cost by 0.002549 (state-clustered 95% interval [-0.002867, -0.002238]; one-sided 95% upper bound -0.002286), with negative effects for all three checkpoint pairs. A controlled-PyBullet audit independently supports a composite task-prediction-regime router. The sequential router remains slower than fixed policies, and its advantage is restricted to low compute prices. The evidence supports incremental routing information in the tested prediction interface beyond one deliberately favoured current-DINO control, but not causal sufficiency, compute saving, closed-loop value, or cross-family generality.

</details>


### [544] [Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14652)
*Yang Zhao,Peisong Niu,Tian Zhou,Ziqing Ma,Guanlong Ma,Rong Jin,Huiling Yuan,Liang Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BaguanHR框架，通过变量级超分辨率（SR）将0.25°粗分辨率再分析数据合成为0.1°高分辨率数据，以解决ML全球天气预报模型高分辨率数据稀缺的问题。该框架在合成+真实数据集上的表现超过现有ML方法和IFS-HRES，并揭示数据规模与预测精度之间存在幂律缩放效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 0.1°精度的ML全球天气预报模型受限于高分辨率数据的稀缺性（数十年再分析数据仅提供0.25°分辨率）。现有方法直接微调0.25°模型到0.1°，但粗分辨率预测过程中的不可逆信息损失阻碍了这种迁移，因此需要新的思路来突破数据瓶颈。

Method: 1) 将研究重心从模型迁移转向数据迁移；2) 论证超分辨率（SR）比预测任务具有更低的条件熵和输入放大效应，因此更适合作为分辨率迁移的载体；3) 利用变量级SR从ERA5合成长时间跨度的0.1°高分辨率数据；4) 在合成+真实数据混合集上训练0.1°预测模型。

Result: BaguanHR在72小时内超过85%的预测时效上优于现有ML方法和IFS-HRES。同时发现数据规模幂律缩放效应：数据量翻倍可使72小时预报RMSE降低4.6%，120小时预报RMSE降低4.9%。

Conclusion: 高分辨率ML天气预报的规模化主要受数据瓶颈制约，变量级超分辨率提供了一种简单而通用的解决方案，能够解锁长期积累的粗分辨率再分析数据用于高分辨率训练。

Abstract: The development of 0.1$^{\circ}$ global weather forecasting models based on machine learning (ML) is constrained by the limited availability of high-resolution data, as decades of reanalysis are only available at 0.25$^{\circ}$ resolution. While existing approaches fine-tune 0.25$^{\circ}$ forecast models on limited 0.1$^{\circ}$ samples, we show that this transfer is hindered by the irreversible information loss inherent in coarse-resolution forecasting. Therefore, we propose BaguanHR, a framework that shifts the focus from transferring models to transferring data. We first show that super-resolution (SR) has lower conditional entropy and input amplification than forecasting, making it a more robust vehicle for resolution transfer. By leveraging this advantage through variable-wise SR, we synthesize extensive 0.1$^{\circ}$ data from ERA5. BaguanHR's performance on the synthetic-plus-real dataset exceeds both ML-based methods and IFS-HRES, achieving superior performance across over 85% of the lead times within 72 hours. Furthermore, our findings highlight a power-law scaling effect, as a twofold increase in data reduces RMSE by 4.6% for 72-hour forecasting and 4.9% for 120-hour forecasting. Our results demonstrate that scaling high resolution ML-based forecasting is primarily a data bottleneck, and that variable-wise super-resolution provides a simple yet general solution to unlock long coarse-resolution reanalyses for high-resolution training.

</details>


### [545] [Do Uncertainty Signals Help? A Systematic Study of Uncertainty-Aware Decoding with Rollback Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14653)
*Xianzong Wu,Xiaohong Li,Yuejun Guo,Xinyang Liu,Tianlin Li,Junjie Wang,Qiang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究不确定性感知的回滚解码策略，利用token级不确定性信号识别LLM代码生成中不可靠的生成区域并回滚到早期有效前缀，在七个代码LLM和五个基准上验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不确定性量化已被广泛用于模型解释、数据选择和预测回滚等场景，但其在增强LLM代码生成方面的潜力尚未被充分探索。作者旨在回答不确定性能否作为改进代码生成的有效信号这一关键问题。

Method: 提出不确定性感知回滚解码（uncertainty-aware rollback decoding），这是一种推理时策略：利用不确定性信号识别不可靠的生成区域，无需重新训练模型即可回滚到早期有效前缀。在统一的解码框架下，对七个代码LLM、五个代码生成基准和八种token级不确定性信号进行评估。

Result: 完整回滚框架在pass@1上最高提升0.26，在AvgTestPassRate上最高提升0.35，在Dsec-Python上Patch-Aligned Safe Rate绝对提升6.4%。信息论度量（token熵和负对数似然）整体表现最佳。消融实验表明反馈引导的回滚提供了主要改进，而不确定性定位在固定其他组件时提供额外增益。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知回滚解码是提升LLM代码生成的有效策略，其中token熵和负对数似然是最可靠的不确定性信号，反馈引导回滚是主要贡献来源，不确定性定位提供补充增益。

Abstract: Prediction uncertainty is a widely adopted metric for quantifying model confidence, with downstream applications spanning model explanation, data selection, and prediction rollback. Despite its demonstrated utility, the potential of uncertainty quantification to enhance code generation in large language models (LLMs) remains largely underexplored, raising a critical question: to what extent can uncertainty serve as an effective signal for improving LLM-based code generation?
  To answer this question, we study uncertainty-aware rollback decoding, an inference-time strategy that uses uncertainty signals to identify unreliable generation regions and roll back to earlier valid prefixes without retraining the model. We evaluate this framework on seven code LLMs, five code generation benchmarks, and eight token-level uncertainty signals under a unified decoding setup.
  Our results show that the complete rollback framework improves over equal-budget restart across the evaluated benchmarks and model settings, with gains of up to 0.26 in pass@1 and 0.35 in AvgTestPassRate on functional code generation benchmarks, and an absolute improvement of up to 6.4\% in Patch-Aligned Safe Rate on Dsec-Python. Among the evaluated signals, information-theoretic measures such as token entropy and negative log-likelihood show the most favorable overall trend, frequently achieving the best or near-best results on standard benchmarks. A component-controlled ablation further shows that feedback-guided rollback provides the main improvement, while uncertainty localization provides an additional gain when checking, budget, rollback, and branch decay are held fixed.

</details>


### [546] [FedImp: Enhancing Federated Learning Convergence with Impurity-Based Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14654)
*Hai Anh Tran,Cuong Ta,Truong X. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedImp算法，通过量化每个设备本地数据的信息含量（杂质加权）来计算聚合权重，以解决联邦学习中非独立同分布（non-IID）数据导致的训练效率低下和收敛缓慢问题。实验表明，FedImp在EMNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上显著减少了通信轮次（最高减少66.7%），并在高度不平衡的数据分布下取得了最高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习面临的核心挑战是设备间数据的非IID特性，这严重阻碍了训练效率和收敛速度。现有方法（如FedAvg、FedProx、FedAdp）在非IID场景下表现不佳，需要一种能够根据不同设备数据信息含量差异进行差异化加权的策略。

Method: 提出Federated Impurity Weighting (FedImp)算法：基于每个设备本地数据的信息含量（impurity）量化各设备的贡献，然后将这些贡献归一化，计算得到全局模型更新所需的差异化聚合权重。该方法通过数据分布的信息量特征来自适应分配聚合权重。

Result: 在EMNIST数据集上，相比FedAvg、FedProx和FedAdp，通信轮次分别减少64.4%、27.8%和66.7%；在CIFAR-10数据集上分别减少44.2%、44%和25.6%。在数据高度不平衡的情况下，FedImp在所有基线方法中表现最佳并达到最高准确率。

Conclusion: FedImp为非IID联邦学习场景提供了一种有效且高效的解决方案，通过数据信息含量驱动的加权聚合机制，显著提升了收敛速度，并在极端数据不平衡条件下保持了最优的模型性能。
